text.body:
n0. 4740 title. rāmārcana candrikā author. ānandavanaḥ mukundavana śiṣyaḥ extent. 69 patrāṇi age. saṃ0 1929 subject. taṃtram
saṃ0 1929 āśvinpra0 31 rāmārcanacaṃdrikāpatre 69 śloka 2300 vīrūlakhārihṛtthe
pṛ0 1a) oṃsvastiśrīgaṇeśāyanamaḥ śrīguravenamaḥ śrīrāmacaṃdrāyanamaḥ tarttuṃsaṃsṛtivāridhiṃtrijagatāṃnaunāmayasyaprabhoryetevedaṃsaka laṃvibhātisatataṃjātaṃsthitaṃsaṃhṛtaṃ yasminnonigamābhavaṃtinamanomānaścadhārāścanotaṃvaṃdesahajaprakāśamamalaṃśrīrāma caṃdraṃparaṃ 1 viśvavyāpitanoḥśubhāraghupatermūrtaivamūrtistuyovākyārthaprativodhanaikacaturaśāṃtyādiśīlaḥkaviḥ ajñānāṃdhyanivāraṇaikataraṇirvijñānaciṃtāmaṇinityānaṃdapadaikabhūrvijayateśrīmanmukuṃdomuniḥ 2 vedāṃtavā kyārthatarirvirājateyasminjaḥkāmapradādayonahi vudhāsadānaṃdapadaṃprapedirevaṃdemukuṃdākhyavataṃguruṃparaṃ 3 pū rvaṃcottaratāpanīyamakhilaṃkalpaṃvaraṃmāruterbrahmāgastivaśiṣṭavāsayujaḥkalpāstathāsaṃhitāḥ śāstraṃmaṃtramayaṃma hākuvalayenāloḍyasītādikaṃśrīrāmārcanacaṃdrikākalimalapradhvaṃsikāprocyate 4 tattadgraṃthagatainānāvākyaire vatakalpitaiḥsaukaryārthaṃkramaḥsamyaksaṃkṣepeṇapratanyate 5 ucyateprathamaṃtatralakṣaṇaṃguruśiṣyayoḥ śāṃtodāṃtaṃkulī naścavinītaḥśuddhaveṣamān 6 sadācāraḥsuprasiddhasucidakṣaḥsuvuddhimān āśramīdhyānaniṣṭaścamaṃtrataṃtravicakṣaṇaḥ nigrahānugraheśaktogururityabhidhīyate 7 itigurulakṣaṇaṃ śāṃtovinītaśuddhātmāśraddhāvāndhāraṇakṣamaḥ samartha ścakulīnaścaprājñaḥsaccaritodhanī 8 evamādiguṇairyuktaḥśiṣyobhavatinānyathā gurutāśiṣyatāvāpitayorvatsa ravāsataḥ tathācoktaṃsārasaṃgṛhe sadguruḥsrāśritaṃśiṣyaṃvarṣamekaṃparikṣapet ititatraivarājanyamānyajodoṣaḥpatnīpāpāni
pṛ0 1ba) bhartari tathāśiṣyārjitaṃpāpaṃguruṃprāpnotiniścitamiti devyāgameśivavākyaṃ gurusayyāsanaṃyānaṃpādukopānatpī ṭhakaṃ pādodakaṃtathāchāyāṃlaṃghayennakadācaneti tathātatraiva guroragrepṛthakpūjāmauddhataṃ tuparityajet dīkṣāṃvyā- khyāṃprabhutvādiguroragrevivarjayet itiśiṣyalakṣaṇaṃ dīkṣāṃvinopadeśasyaduṣṭatvātprathamaṃtusā pāpakṣayaṃdivya bhāvesādhakasyakarotyataḥ tatrāpisiddhasādhyādibhedaiḥsaṃśodhayenmanuṃ iṃdvagnirudranavanetrayugevadikṣutṛtvaṣṭaṣo ḍaśacaturdaśabhautikeṣu pātālapaṃcadaśavahnihimāṃśukoṣṭivarṇāṃllikhellipibhavānkramaśaḥsudhīmānajanma- rkṣākṣaratovīkṣyatatramaṃtrādimākṣaraṃ caturbhikoṣṭakastveka itikoṣṭacatuṣṭaye punaḥkoṣṭakakoṣṭeṣusavyatoja janmabhākṣarāt siddhasādhyastusiddhārikramājñeyaṃvicakṣaṇaiḥ siddhaḥsidhyatikālena sādhyastujapahomataḥ susiddhograhamātreṇaripuṃmūlanikṛṃtanaḥ siddhāṇīvāṃdhavāḥ proktāḥsādhyāstesevakāḥsmṛtāḥ susiddhāḥpoṣakājñeyāśatravopātakāḥsmṛtāḥ japenavaṃdhuḥsiddhasyātsevakodhikasevayā puṣṇātipoṣakobhīṣṭaṃghātakonāśaye ddhrūvaṃ siddhaḥsiddhoyathoktenadviguṇātsiddhasādhyakaḥsiddhasusiddhorddhajapātsiddhāri haṃtivāṃdhavān sādhyasiddhodviguṇakaḥsādhyasādhyonirarthakaḥtatsusiddhastrigu-
pṛ0 2a) ṇatātsādhyārihaṃtigotrajāt susiddhasiddhaṃjapātatsādhyodviguṇādhikāt tatsusiddhograhādevasusiddhāriḥsvagotrahā 3 arisiddhaḥsutānhanyādarisādhyastukanyakāḥ tatsusiddhastupatnīyastadarihaṃtisādhakaṃ mātāpitṛkṛtaṃnāmayaccāpyabhi janestathā viśleṣyatasyavaivarṇātsvaravarṇavibhedataḥ tathaivamaṃtravījānitataḥśodhanamārabhet viṃdurdvividukopadhmā nīyajihvāṃghrisaṃbhavaḥ saṃhatoccāraṇāprāptamadhikākṣaramevaca ayabhraṃśākṣaraṃlakṣautyaktākhaṃḍacatuṣṭayaṃ ṝḷḹ etekhaṃḍāḥmaṃtrākṣaraiḥsahaikaikaṃnāmavarṇaṃviśodhayet vyaṃjanairvyaṃjanānyevasvaraiḥsārddhaṃsvarāstathā māghamāghyatusaṃśo dhyaṃdvitīyenadvitīyakaṃ maṃtrevāpyathavānāmnivarṇāsyurviṣamāyadā tadāmaṃtraṃsamārabhyasamaṃyāvatprayojayet ādyaṃtayoḥsiddhavarṇaumaṃtreyasminvarānane acireṇaivakālenasabhavetsarvasiddhadaḥ sādhyātādiyutoyastuati kṛcchreṇasiddhyati ādāvaṃtesusiddhastusarvakāmavibhūtidaḥ ādāvaṃteripuryasyabhavetyājyaḥsamaṃtrakaḥsthānatraya gatāriryyomaṃtromṛtyusamomataḥ śatrurbhavatiyadādaumadhyesiddhastadaṃtikesādhyaḥkaṣṭenakāryasiddhistasyaphalaṃsva lpamevabhavet aṃteyadibhavatiripuḥprathamemadhyecabhavatisādhyayugaṃ kāryaṃvilaṃvitaṃsyātpraṇasyati sarvamevātike siddhaṃsusiddhamathavāripūṇāṃtaritaparīkṣayeyatnān vahvāyasaṃprajalitaṃmaṃtraṃvarjayenmatimān nṛsiṃhārkavarāhāṇāṃprāśāda praṇavasyaca sapiṃḍākṣaramaṃtrāṇāṃsiddhādīnnaivaśodhayet svapnelavdhestriyādattemālāmaṃtretrivījake vaidikeṣucasarveṣusi
pṛ0 2ba) ddhārinaivaśodhayet itisiddhasādhyādiśuddhaḥsvakulānyakulaṃbhedaṃvakṣyāmomaṃtriṇāmatha uūogajaḍadavaḷṣmā- rthivāḥ nṝaughaphaṭadhabhavaśābāruṇāḥ iiṃekheḍhaṭhathapharakṣāḥ āgneyāḥ āekacaṭatapāḥyasvāmārutāḥ ḷḹaṃṅañaṇanamasahānābhasāḥ sādhakasyākṣaraṃpūrvamaṃtrasyāpitadakṣaraṃ yadyekabhūtadaivatyaṃjātīyātsvakulaṃhitat bhaumasyavāruṇaṃmitramāgneyasyāpimārutaṃ mārutaṃpārthivāpyānāṃśatrugneyasyavāṃlasaṃ nābhasaṃsarvamitraṃsyādvi ruddhaṃnaivamelayet itisvakulākulacakraṃ vālādibhedopyaparomaṃtrāṇāmabhidhīyate ārabhyaikākṣaraṃmaṃtraṃvālāāṣoḍa śākṣarāt tatāviṃśateprauḍhāstatonyesthavirāmatāḥ svāhāṃtāḥstrīsvarūpāḥsyurnamoṃtāścanapuṃsakāḥkuṃphaḍaṃtā stuyemaṃtrāḥ puṃmāṃsasteprakīrtitāḥ śastāstetrividhāmaṃtrāvaśaśāṃtyabhicārake itivālādibhedāḥ rāśimelana mākhyāsyanakṣatrasthitimapyataḥ āiīmeṣaḥ uūṝvṛṣaḥ ḷḹmithunaḥ eaikarkaṭaḥ oausiṃhaḥ aṃaḥśaṣasa halakṣākanyāḥ kavargastulaḥ cavargovṛścikaḥ ṭavargodhanuḥ tavargomakaraḥ pavargaḥkuṃbhaḥ yādayomīnaḥ sādhyā khyākṣararāśyaṃtaṃgaṇatsādhakākṣarāt ekapaṃcanavavāṃdhavāsmṛtādvaucaṣaḍcadaśamāstusevakāḥ vahnirudramunayastupo ṣakādvādaśaṣṭacaturastughātakāḥ itirāśimelanaṃ āśvinīdevagaṇaḥ ibharaṇīmanuṣyagaṇaḥ īuūkṛti kārākṣasagaṇaḥ ṝḷḹrohiṇīṃmanuṣyagaṇaḥ emṛgaśīrṣodevagaṇaḥ aiārdrāmanuṣyagaṇaḥ oaupunarvasudeva
pṛ0 3a) gaṇaḥkaḥpuṣyodevagaṇaḥ khagaśleṣārākṣasaḥgaṃghaṅamaghārākṣasaḥcapūrvāmanuṣyaḥ chajuttarāmanuṣyagaṇaḥ jhañahastodevaḥṭaṭhacitrārā kṣasaḥ ḍasvātīdevaḥ ḍhaṇaviśākhārākṣasaḥ tathadaanurādhādevaḥ dhajyeṣṭārākṣasaḥ napaphamūlaṃrākṣasaḥ vapūrvāṣāḍhāmanuṣyaḥ bha uttarāṣāḍhāmanuṣyaḥ maśravaṇodevaḥyaradhaniṣṭārākṣasaḥlaśatabhiṣarākṣasaḥvaśapūrvābhādrapadāmartyaḥṣasahakṣuttarābhādra padāmanuṣyaḥ aṃaḥtuṃrevatīdevaḥprādakṣiṇyenagaṇayetsādhakākhyākṣarātsudhīḥjanmasaṃpadvipatkṣemapratyarīsādhakoba dhaḥmaitraṃparamamaitraṃvajanmādīnipunaḥpunaḥ vipaddadhaḥpratyaharaḥparityājyāmanīṣibhiḥ itinakṣatraprakāraḥ suptapravodhakālo yaṃmaṃtrāṇāmabhidhīyate agnīṣomātmakāmaṃtrāvijñeyāḥkrūrasaumyayoḥkarmaṇovahitārāṃtyaviyatprāyāḥsamīritāḥā gneyāmanavaḥsaumyābhūyiṣṭeghamṛtākṣarāḥāgneyāḥsaṃvudhyaṃteprāṇecaratidakṣiṇe prāgenyasminsthiteprāṇesaumyāvodhaṃpra yāṃtica nāḍīdvayaṃgateprāṇesarvevodhaṃprayātite prayachaṃtiphalaṃsarvepravuddhāmaṃtriṇāṃsadā yadvāprāṇāmānasamāyogā cchivaśaktostumelanaṃ pravodhakālovijñeyaḥsvāpakālastataḥparaḥ itisuprabodhakālaḥ saṃpuṭīkṛtyamaṃtreṇaśāṃtā nādyātsuviṃdukāt punaścasavisargāstātkṣakāraṃkevalaṃpatet evaṃyaptoyadiṣṭaścetpravuddhaḥśīghrasiddhidaḥ atharṇadhana śuddhiścakathyatesiddhidāyinī iṃdrarkṣenetraravipaṃcadaśartuvedavahnyāyudhāṣṭanavabhirguṇitāścāsādhyāt digbhūgiriśru tigajāgnimunīṣuvedaṣaṭvahnibhiścaguṇitātathasādhakārṇāt nāmāphalādakaṭavāhatavahniśeṣaṃjñātvābhayora
pṛ0 3ba) dhiśeṣṛṇaṃyutaṃsyāt asyārthaḥ iṃdrādyaṃkaiḥsādhyārṇātsvaravyaṃjanarūpeṇapṛthakṛtānguṇitānkṛtā tathāsādhakanāmākṣa rāṇyaṣidagādibhiraṃkairguṇayet nāmāphalāditisvaravyaṃjanasamudāyāt akaṭhavāditivargacatuṣṭayaprabhinnā n akārādiḥ aḥaṃtouṛḷeaioauaṃaḥ etadrūpaavargaḥ kādiṭāṃtaḥkavargaḥ vādihāṃtovavargaḥ etee kaidaśaikā daśākṣarāścatvārovargāḥ asmātakaṭhavādaṣṭabhirbhāgehatesatiubhayoḥsādhyasādhakavargayoḥśeṣa syādhikarūpasyṛṇaṃdeyamitiśeṣaḥ dhanaṃcajñātvāmaṃtraṃdadyāt maṃtraścaidṛṇībhavatitadāmaṃtraśubhadāyakaḥ dhanīce- nnamaṃtroyadyadhikāṃkaḥsyāttatmaṃtraṃtujapetsudhīḥ samepicajapenmaṃtraṃnajapetudhanādhike śūnyemṛtyuṃvijānīyātasmā cchūnyaṃvivarjayet rāśīnāṃśuddhatājñeyāyachechatrunṛtiṃvyayaṃ svarāśermaṃtrarāśyaṃtaṃgaṇanīyaṃvicakṣaṇaiḥ lagnodhanaṃbhrā tṛvaṃdhuputraśatrukalatrakāḥmaraṇaṃdharmakāmārthaṃdvyayādvādaśarāśayaḥ itirāśiśuddhiḥ itiṛṇadhanaśodhanaprakāraḥ 14 27 2 12 15 6 4 3 8 8 9 samāptaḥ anyepimaṃtradoṣāyejñeyāgraṃthāṃtarādvudhaiḥ likhyaṃtemaṃtrasaṃskārāśāra- o 3 u ṛ ḷ e ai o au aṃ aḥ dātilakāddaśaḥ jananaṃjīvanapaścāttāḍanaṃvodhanaṃtathā athābhiṣekovima ka kha ga gha ṅa ca cha ja jha ña ṭa līkaraṇāpyāyatepunaḥ tarpaṇaṃdīpanaṃguptidaśaitāmaṃtrasaṃskṛyāṃ maṃtrāṇāmā ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ta tha da dha na pa pha tṛkāmadhyāduddhārojananaṃsmṛtaṃ praṇavāṃtaritāṃkṛtvāmaṃtravarṇājjapetsudhīḥ eta va bha ma ya ra la va śa ṣa sa ha 10 1 7 4 8 3 7 5 4 6 3
pṛ0 4a) jjīvanamityāhumaṃtrataṃtraviśāradāḥ maṃtravarṇāsamālikhyatāḍayeccaṃdanāṃbhasā pratyekaṃvāyunāmaṃtrītāḍanaṃtadutadudāhṛtaṃ 3 vi likhyamaṃtraṃtanmaṃtrīprasūnaiḥkaravīrajaiḥ tanmaṃtrākṣarasaṃkhyātairdvavyādyauṃtenavodhanaṃ 4 svataṃtroktavidhānenamaṃtramaṃtrārṇasaṃkhyayā aśvatthapallavairmaṃtramabhiṣiṃcedviśuddhaye 5 saṃciṃtyamanasāmaṃtraṃjyotimaṃtreṇanirdahet(sāraṃvyomāgnimanuyudaṃḍījyotirmanu mataḥ kuśodakenajaptenapratyarṇaṃprokṣaṇaṃmato) maṃtremalatrayaṃmaṃtrīvimalīkaraṇaṃvidaṃ 6 tāraṃvyomāgnimanuyudaṃḍījyo- tirmanumataḥ kuśodakenajaptenapratyarṇaṃprokṣaṇaṃmanoḥ 7 tenamaṃtreṇavidhivadetadāpyāyanaṃsmṛtaṃ maṃtreṇevāriṇāmaṃtre tarpaṇaṃtarpaṇaṃsmṛtaṃḥ8 tāramāyāramāyogomanodīpanamucyate japyamānasyamaṃtrasyagopanaṃtvakāśanaṃ itimaṃtrasaṃ skārāḥ maṃtroddhāramathākhyāsyemaṃtrāṇāṃrāghavasyatu brahmākalpādiṣuproktaṃsādhakānāṃsusiddhidaṃ vahnisthaṃśayanaṃviṣṇo rarddhacaṃdravibhūṣitaṃ ekākṣaramanaḥproktomaṃtrarājaḥsuradramaḥ brahmāmuniḥsyādgāyatrīṃchaṃdorāmasyadevatā dīrghārddheṃduyujāṃ gānikuryādvrahmātmanāmanoḥ sarayūtīramadāravedikāpaṃkajāsane śyāmaṃvīrāsanāsīnaṃjñānamudroyaśobhanaṃ vāmoru nyastatadvrahmaṃsītālakṣmaṇasevitaṃ avekṣyamāṇamātmānamātmanyamatatejasaṃciṃtayanparamātmānaṃbhānulakṣaṃjapenma nuṃ vahnirnārāyaṇonāḍyojāṭharaḥkevalopivā dvyakṣaromaṃtrarājoyaṃbhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ ekākṣaroktaaṣpadisyā dādyenaṣaḍaṃgakaṃ tāramāyāramānaṃjñavāksvavījaistuṣaḍvidhaḥ akṣaromaṃtrarājaḥsyāsarvābhīṣṭaphalapradaḥ dvyakṣaraṃcaṃdrabhadrāṃ
pṛ0 4ba) todvividhaścaturakṣaraḥṛṣyādipūrvavadjñeyameteṣāṃtuvicakṣaṇaiḥ sapratiṣṭauramauvāyuhṛtpaṃcārṇomanuḥsmṛtaḥ viśvāmitromu niḥproktaḥpaṃktiḥchadosyadevatā rāmabhadrovījaśaktiprathamārṇanatīkramāt bhūmadhyahṛdinābhyadryaupādayorvinya senmanu ṣaḍagaṃpūrvavadyadvāpaṃcāṇaimanunāstrakaṃ madhyevanaṃkalpatarormūlepuṣpalatāsane lakṣmaṇenapraguṇitamakṣsā ṣkoṇenasāyakaṃavekṣyamāṇaṃjānakyākṛtavyaṃjanamīśvaraṃ jaṭābhāralasacchīrṣeśyāmaṃmunīgaṇāvṛtaṃ lakṣmaṇe nadhṛtachatramathadāpuṣpakoparidaśāsyamathanaṃprāgvatsasugrīvavibhīṣaṇaṃ vijayārthīviśeṣeṇavarṇalakṣaṃjapetmanuṃ sva kāmaśaktivāklakṣmītārādyapaṃcavarṇakaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥṣadvidhaḥsyāccaturvargaphalapradaḥ paṃcāśanmātṛkāmaṃtravarṇapra tyekapūrvakaḥlakṣmīvāṅmanmathādiścatārādiḥsyādanekadhāḥ śrīmāyāmanmathaikaikabījādyaṃtagatomanuḥ caturvarṇa sevasyātṣadvarṇovāṃchitapradaḥsvāhāṃtohuṃphaḍaṃtovānatyaṃtovābhavedayaṃ brahmāsaṃmohanaḥśaktirdakṣiṇāmūrtidevaka agastiśrīśivaḥproktāmunayonukramādime chaṃdogātryasaṃjñaṃcaśrīrāmaścaivadevatā athavākāmavījādeviśvāmitro munimanoḥ chaṃdodevyādigāyatrīrāmabhadrosyadevatāvījaśaktiyathāpūrvaṃṣadvarṇānvinyasetataḥ brahmaraṃdhrebhruvormadhyehṛnnā bhyaṃdhuṣupādayoḥvījaiḥṣaḍdīrghayuktairvāmaṃtrārṇairvāṣaḍaṅgakaṃ dhyāyetkalpatarormūlesuvarṇamayamaṃḍape puṣpakākhyāvi mānāṃtaḥsiṃhāsanaparichade padmecaturdaledevamiṃdranīlamaṇiprabhaṃ vīrāsanasamārūḍhaṃvyākhyāmudropaśobhitaṃ vā
pṛ0 5a) morunyastatadvastaṃsītālakṣmaṇasevitaṃ sarvābharaṇasaṃpannamṛtulakṣaṃjapenmanuṃ yadvāsmarādimaṃtrāṇāṃjapābhavāhariṃsmaret rāmaścacaṃdrabhadrāṃtoṅetonatidvidhā tārādisahitaḥsopimaṃtrastvaṣṭākṣaraḥsmṛtaḥtārādyaṃtagataḥsopinavārṇaḥsyādaneka dhātārarāmaścaturthyataḥkrodhāstraṃvahnitalpagā aṣṭārṇoyaparomaṃtraḥṛṣyādiḥsyāṣaḍarṇavat guṇavījaṃvadenmāyāṃrudrā māyapunaścatāṃśivomārāmamaṃtroyaṃvasvarṇastuvasupradaḥṛṣiḥsadāśivaḥproktogāyatrachaṃducyate śivomārā macaṃdrotradevatāparikīrtitā dīrghayāmāyayāṃgānitārayaṃvārṇayuktayā rāmaṃtrinetraṃsomārddhaṃdhāriṇaṃśūlināṃ varaṃ bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgaṃkaparditamupāsmahe rāmābhirāmāsaudaryyasīmāṃsīmāṃvataṃsinīṃ pāśāṃkuśadhanurvāṇa- dharāṃsītāṃtrilocanāṃdhyāyaṃtevaṃvarṇalakṣaṃjapetrimadhurāplutaiḥvilvapatraiḥphalaiḥpuṣpaistilairvāpaṃkajaihunet sva yamāyāṃtinidhayaścasurepsitāḥjānakīvallabhaṃḍentaṃvahnejāṃyāhumādikaṃ daśāṣṭaroyaṃmaṃtraḥsyādvaśiṣṭaḥsyā dṛṣiḥsvarāṭ chaṃdastudevatārāmaḥsītāpāṇiparigrahaḥ ādyobījadviṭhaḥśaktiḥkāmenāṃgakriyāmatāśiro lalāṭabhrūmadhyetālukaṃṭheṣuhṛdyapi nābhyaṃdhujānupādeṣudaśārṇānvinyasenmanoḥ ajodhyānagareratnacitresauva rṇamaṃḍapemaṃdārapuṣpairāviddhavitātetoraṇāṃcite siṃhāsanasamārūḍhaṃpuṣpoparirāghavaṃ rakṣomirharibhirdevaidi vyapānagataiḥśubhaiḥsaṃstūyamānairmunibhiḥprahvaiścaparisevitaṃ sītālaṃkṛtavāmāṃgaṃlakṣmaṇenopaśobhitaṃśyāmaṃ
pṛ0 5ba) prasannavadanaṃsarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃdhyāyennevaṃjapenmaṃtraṃvarṇalakṣaṃvicakṣaṇaḥ rāmaṅetaṃdhanuṣpāṇiyeṅetaṃsyādvahnisuṃdarī daśākṣaroyaṃmaṃtraḥsyānmunirvrahmāvirāṭsmṛtaṃ chaṃdaṃstudevatāproktārāmorākṣasamardanaḥ ādyobījaṃdviṭhaḥśaktistenai vāṃgānipūrvavat varṇanyāsaṃtathādhyānaṃpauraścaraṇikaṃvidhiṃ daśākṣaroktavatkuryācāpavāṇadharaṃsmaret oṃhṛdbhaga vaterāmacaṃdrabhadraucaṅeyutau arkārṇodvividhopyasyṛṣidhyānādipūrvavat śrīpūrvaṃjayamadhyasthaṃtadvidhārāṃmanāmaca trayodaśārṇoṛṣyādipūrvavatsarvakāmadaḥ padatrayaidvirāvṛtairaṃgaṃdhyānaṃdaśārṇavat satāraṃhṛdbhagavaterāmaṃṅetamahātataḥ puruṣāyapadaṃpaścāthṛdaṃtoṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ viśvāmitroniḥchaṃdogāyatraṃdevatāmanoḥ daśāsyadarpadalanorāmabhadraḥsamī- ritaḥ tāraṃvījanatiḥśaktiḥṣaḍaṃgaṃkalpayettataḥ mūlamaṃtraṃkauśaleṃdrasavyasaṃdhamanaṃtaraṃ rāvaṇāṃtakavāmānaṃsarvalo kahitetathā svāduprasannavadanaścaturthyānasamāvadet naṃdigrāmasyopavanebharatāyatakautuke ramyesugaṃdhipuṣpādyai rvṛkṣakhaṃḍaiścamaṃḍite niḥśāṇabherīpaṭhaṃhaśaṃkhatūryādiniḥsvanaiḥ pravṛttanṛtyeparitojayamaṃgalabhāṣite paṭīraghusṛṇo śīrakarpūrāgarugaṃdhitaiḥ nānākusumasaurabhyavāhigaṃdhavahāṃcite devagaṃdharvanārībhirgāyatrībhiralaṃkṛte siṃhā sanasamārūḍhaṃpuṣpakoparirāghavaṃ saumitrasītāsahitaṃjayamukuṭaśobhitaṃ cāpavāṇadharaṃśyāmaṃsasugrīvavibhīṣa ṇaṃ hatvārāvaṇamāyārtakṛtatrailaukyarakṣaṇaṃ rāmabhadraṃhṛdidhyāyandaśalakṣaṃjapenmunaṃ rāmabhadramahaṃpūrvaṃsāgniṃcadyatataḥ
pṛ0 6a) paraṃ vīraṃnarotamapadaṃdaśāsyāṃtakamītata tatorakṣavatodehipaścāddāpayemeśriyaṃ dvātriṃśadakṣaromaṃtroviśvāmitromunirmanoḥ chaṃdonuṣṭupadevatācarāmabhadraṃprakīrtitāḥ catuṣkaraṇavedāṃghrivasvaṃteraṃgakalpanā mūrddhnibhāledṛśauśrotregaṃḍayugmesanāmi ke āsyadosadhiyugalestanahantābhimaṃḍale kadyāṃmeḍhepāyupādasaṃdhiṣvarṇānnyasenmanoḥ pūrvoktadhyānamaṃtrāpi trilakṣaṃnipataṃjapet pītaṃvāciṃtayedrāmaṃdhanārtovāmanujapet satāraṃhṛdbhagavatecaturthyāraghunaṃdanaṃ rakṣoghnaviśadaṃ tadvanmadhuretivadettataḥ prasannavadanaṃkretuṃvededamitatejase balarāmaucaturthyaṃtauviṣṇuṃṅetaṃnatitataḥproktomālāma nuḥsaptacatvāriṃdbhirakṣaraiḥmuniḥpitāmahaḥśchaṃdobhavedanuṣṭapdevatāḥrājyābhiṣiktorāmaścavījaśaktiyathārāśi rasyānanavṛttevabhrūmadhyekṣiddhayorapiśrotrayoghrāṇayoścaivagaṃḍayoroṣṭayorapi daṃtayorāsyadeśecadoḥpatmadhyagrake ṣuca kaṃṭhehṛdistatiṃdrepārśvayoḥpṛṣṭhadeśatāḥjaṭharenābhyadhiṣṭāneguhyevarṇānyavinyaset saptartuṃsaptadaśaṣiṃdrasa ḍnaiḥṣaḍagakaṃ dhyānaṃdaśākṣaraproktaṃlakṣamekaṃjapenmanuṃ vilvaiḥphalaiḥprasūnaiścapatraistrimadhusaṃyutaiḥmadhutritayayukte napāyasenāthavāṃvujaiḥhomaṃdaśāṃśataḥkuryyāttathāsarvatratarpaṇaṃ sarveṣurāmamaṃtreṣumaṃtrarājaḥṣaḍakṣaraḥ ekadhācadvi- dhātredhācaturdhāpaṃcadhātathā ṣaḍsaptadhāṣṭadhācaivabahudhāyaṃvyavasthitaḥ rāmamaṃtrasyabhedastuśivojānātitattvataḥ samāsītācaturthyāṃtāsvāhāṃtoyaṃṣaḍakṣaraḥ sītāmaṃtraścakathitaḥsvataṃtroṃgaparopica janakosyṛṣiḥchaṃdogāya
pṛ0 6ba) traṃdevatāmanoḥ sītābhagavatīproktāśrīvījaṃśaktiraṃtajau dīrghasvarayutādyenaṣaḍaṃgāniprakalpayet pūjayedvaiṣṇevepīṭhedhyāyedrā ghavasaṃyutāṃ svavarṇāmaṃvujakarāṃrāmālokanatatparāṃ varṇalakṣaṃjapenmaṃtraṃmiṣṭārthaṃsādhayettataḥ maṃtrarājamagastoktaṃlakṣmaṇa syapratanyate rephapūrvasamudhṛtyaseṃduṃlakṣmaṇasaṃyutaṃ ṅetoyaṃlakṣmaṇamanurnamasācasamanvitaḥ agastiḥṛṣirasyāyaṃgā- yatraṃchaṃducyate lakṣmaṇodevatāproktālaṃbījaṃśaktirasyahi namastuviniyogehipuruṣārthacatuṣṭaye dīrghabhājāsvavī jenaṣaḍaṃgāniprakalpayet dvibhujaṃsvarṇaruciratanuṃpadmabhimaikṣaṇaṃ dhanurvāṇakaraṃrāmasevāsasaktamānasaṃpūjāpivaiṣṇavepī ṭhesāṃgāvaravarjite saptalakṣaṃpuraścaryātataḥsiddhastusādhayet bharasyaivamevasyāchatrughnasyāpyayaṃvidhiḥ ḍāhuḥtvenauditāhye- tepradhānyenāpisaṃmatāḥ ādauvāpyaṃtatovāpipūjāyāṃrāghavasyatu eteṣāmapikartavyābhuktimuktiphalepsubhiḥ prādhā nyenapṛthaktenaaṃgatverāmapīṭhake lakṣmaṇastusadāpūjyaḥprādhānyenaivanityasaḥyathārāmasyapūjāsyātathātasyāpi nityasaḥ sāphalaṃrāmapūjāyāyadīchenniyatabrataḥ tenayatnenakartavyālakṣmaṇasyāpivistarāt śrīrāmamaṃtrabhedāstuvaha vaḥsaṃtivaimune tatsādhakaisaṃdākāryāsaumitrerapinityasaḥaṣṭottaraśatasahasraṃvāśatavāsusamāhitaḥ lakṣmaṇasyamanu- rjapyomumukṣubhirataṃdritaiḥ ajaptvālakṣmaṇamatuṃrāmamaṃtrājapaṃtitetaḥjjayasyaphalaṃnaivaprayātikuśalāpi arimitravive kopinaivakāryobhaveddhiha yojapellakṣmaṇamanuṃnityamekāṃtāsthitaḥmucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥsakāmānśrutekhilān
pṛ0 7a) prayogāyaivamaṃtroyamupadiṣṭohiśārṅgiṇā arjunasyapurāsamyagetenaivajayaṃjayaḥ diśovijityasakalāḥsakurūneke vahi prātiṣṭipaddharmarājaṃpaitṛkerājyuttame japapradhānomaṃtroyaṃrājyaprāptyaikasādhanaṃ yojapenniyatomaṃtraṃlakṣamekaṃsamā hitaḥ socirānnaṣṭarājyaṃsvaprāpnotyevanasaṃśayaḥ abhiṣiktamathodhyāyāndhyāyedrāsamabhyadhīḥ paṃcāyutamimaṃjaptvāna ṣṭarājyamavāpnuyāt nāgapāśavinirmuktaṃdhyāyannekāṃtāsthitaḥ ayutaṃjapemuktaḥsyānnigaḍādyaistadaivahi āṃ janeyasamānītamahauṣadhīhṛtavyathaṃ dhyāyaṃtnayutajapyenaapamṛtyujapetnaraḥ iṃdrajitprāṇahartāraṃdhyāyannevaṃsamā śritaḥ durjacātivegenajapedarikulaṃvahaśūrpaṇastunāsāgrachedanoyuktamānasaṃdhyāyansahasrajāpyenapuruhūtādikā ñjñayet rāmapādābjasevārthaṃkṛtadvāramathasmaran japannayutamekāṃtemahārogānvahūnapikṣayāpasmārakuṣṭādi nnāśayetyevatatkṣaṇāt trimāsaṃniyatāhārojapasaptasahasrakaṃdinedinevidhānepūjayanvijiteṃdriyaḥ aṣṭottaraśatai puṣpairmichidraiḥśatapatrakaiḥpāyasaṃsarkaropetaṃnaivedyaṃvidhivanmuniḥghanasārasamāyuktacaṃdanenāvalipyaca devoddeśenasaṃ pūjyanityamevadvijotamaḥ kuṣṭārogātpramucyetaduścikitsyādanekasaḥ tvagoṣṭajābahuvidhāmaṃḍalāviprabhedataḥ tesarve nāśamāyāṃtiduścikitsyāpikṣaṇāt ekāṃteniyatāhāraḥṣaṇmāsaṃvijiteṃdriyaḥ japannevaṃvidhānenakṣayarogātpramu cyate māṣāpūpānnanaivedyaijapanmaṃtraṃsamāhitaḥvātarogāpramucyatebahutedādapikṣaṇāt abhimaṃtryajalaṃnityaṃmaṃtreṇatriḥsamāhitaḥ
pṛ0 7ba) pītvāsaṃdhyāsubhaktyāvaimucyatesarvarogataḥdāridraṃnāśayitvātuśriyamāpnotisubrataḥviṣādirogasaṃsparśonabhaveccakadācanaḥ prakṣālyai vapratidinaṃmukhaṃbhaktyāsamāhitaḥ mukhanetrādisaṃbhūtānjayedrogānsudāruṇāt pitvābhimaṃtritajalaṃkukṣirogājjayedvahū n devasyapratimādānaṃkṛtvābhaktyāvidhānataḥ sarvebhyopyatharogabhyomucyatenātrasaṃśayaḥ kanyārthīcormilāpāṇigrahaṇe śaktamānasaṃ dhyāyaṃlakṣaṃmanuṃjaptvāhutvālājairdaśāṃśakaṃ ipsitaṃprāptayātkanyāṃśīghramevatapodhana dīkṣitaṃjasraṇāstrā- ṇāmaṃtreṣuniyataḥbrataḥ saṃsmaranvidhivannityaṃmāsatrayamananyadhīḥ pūjāpuraḥsaraṃsaptasahasraṃvijiteṃdriyaḥ japannikhila vidyānāṃtatvajobhavatidhruvaṃ viśvāmitrakratuvarokṛtvādbhutaparākramaṃ dhyāyannayutajāpyenabhayebhyomucyatecirāt saṃdhyā copāśyavidhivanmūlamaṃtreṇamaṃtravit trikālaṃniyatobhūtvākṛtanityavidhiḥsvayaṃ dīkṣāyutoyathānyāyādgurvanujñāṃpuraḥsa raṃ mucyatesarvapāpebhyoyātiviṣṇoparaṃpadaṃ aihikānanapakṣaivaniṣkāmoyocayedvibhuṃ dīkṣāṃprāpyavidhānenagurorvigata- kalmaṣāt svācāraniratādāṃtādgṛhasthādvijiteṃdriyāt tadanujñānusāreṇapuraścaryyāyathāvidhi sarvānpuṇyapāpaughānda gdhvanirmalamānasaḥpunarāvatirahitaṃśāśvataṃpadamāpnuyāt sakāmovāchitaṃlavdhvāmuktābhogānmanoharāt jātismara ciraṃbhūtvāpātiviṣṇoḥparaṃpadaṃ yathāśrīrāmamaṃtrāṇāṃprayoktaḥpāpasaṃbhavaṃ tathonolakṣmaṇamanokiṃnuyāṃtiparāṃgatiṃ kiṃci dyūktyarthamevasyuḥkecidaṃhikaṃsādhanā bhuktimuktiphalaṃcāyamekevijñāyateparaṃ āṃjaneyamanuṃvakṣyebhuktimuktyaikasā-
pṛ0 8a) dhanaṃ prakāśitaṃśaṃkareṇalokānāṃhitamichatāḥbhūtapretapiśācādiḍākinībrahmarākṣasā dṛṣṭvācaprapalāyaṃtemaṃtrānuṣṭānatatparaṃ pradhānaṃcāṃgabhūtoyaṃmaṃtrarājohyanuttamaḥ pūrvaṃnamaḥ padaṃcoktātatobhagavatepadaṃ aṃjaneyapadaṃṅetemahāvalapadaṃtathā vahnijā jāyāṃtevasmānmaṃtrohanumataḥparaṃ pūrvasiddhikaraḥproktomaṃtraścaṣṭādaśākṣaraḥmālākhyoparamaṃtropimārutesarvasidaḥ praṇavepūrvamuccāryanamohanumataḥpadaṃṅetaṃprakaṭasaṃyuktaṃparākramapadaṃtathā tathākrāṃtapadopetaṃdigmaṃḍalamudīrayet ya śovitānadhavalīkṛtajagattritayetyatha vajradehiticoktāturudrāvatārapadaṃtathā saṃvudhyaṃtaṃpadaṃlaṃkāpurīdahanamīra yet udadherlaṃghanaṃcāpidaśagrīvakṛtāṃtakaṃ sītāśvāsanetipadamaṃjanāgarbhasaṃbhavaṃ śrīrāmalakṣmaṇānaṃdakārinkapisai nyaprakāśakasugrīvasādhāraṇapadaṃparvatotpāṭhanaṃtathā vālabrahmacārinnititathāgaṃbhīraśavdapadaṃtathā sarvagūhavinā śanasarvajvarachedanetica ḍākinīdhvaṃsanapadaṃtatastāramudīrayet māyāhātrayamuccāryyahatyāvehipadetataḥ sarvaṃviṣaṃharapara valaṃkṣobhayametica sarvākāryyāṇisādhayaṃtidvirucaret huṃphaṭsvāhetimaṃtroyaṃmālākhyassarvakāmadhuk ṛṣirīśvareva syādanuṣṭupchaṃducyate hanumāndevatāproktāhaṃbījaṃśaktirantajau kīlakahātrayaṃproktaṃvedhakaṃruhasaupunaḥ hanūmanprīṇanaṃ caivaphalamāghamudīritaṃ namobhagavatecāṃjaneyāyāṃguṣṭhayornyaset rudramūrtayityevaṃtarjanībhyāmanaṃtaraṃ vāyusutāyāpitathā madhyamābhyāmapisphuṭaṃ agnigarbhāyacatathānāmikābhyāṃpravinyaset rāmadūtāyacayutaḥkaniṣṭhābhyāṃvicakṣaṇaḥ brahmāstra
pṛ0 8ba) nivāraṇāyacāstramaṃtrassamīritaḥ evaṃṣaḍaṃgaṃcamunekṛtvādhyāyedananyadhīḥ sphaṭikāmaṃsvarṇakāṃtidvibhujaṃcakṛtāṃjaliṃ kuṃḍala dvayasaṃśobhisukhāṃbhojaṃmuhurmuhuḥ ayutaṃtupuraścaryyārāmasyāgreśivasyaca pūjāṃtuvaiṣṇavepīṭheśaivevāvidadhītavau āvṛti bhirvinānityaṃnaktāśīvijiteṃdriyaḥ kṣudraroganivṛttyarthaṃmaṣṭottaraśataṃmune japtvātridinamekāṃtetebhyomucyetatatkṣaṇāt kṣudrabhūtapraśāṃtyarthaṃśatamaṣṭottaraṃpunaḥ dinatrayamathojaptvābhūtānāṃmucyatebhayāt bhūtapretapiśācādiśāṃtayeṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ japtyaivatadbhayānmuktobhavedevanasaṃśayaḥ mahārogādiśāṃtyarthaṃmaṣṭotarasahasrakaṃ japtvātasmātpramucyetaniścitaṃ niyatāśanaḥ jayābhikāṃkṣiṇāṃrājñāmasmādanyatnavidyate dhyāyedrākṣasahaṃtāramayutaṃniyatāśanaḥ japatniyatamāṃścaiva jayedurjjayamapyariṃ saṃdhātāyatusugrīvasaṃdhātāraṃsmarannapi ayutenaivavalināsaṃdhimāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ laṃkāyādāha kaṃdhyāyajapannayutamaṃtrasā śatrurāṣṭraṃdahedevadugdhābdhimapicānagha jayārthīripusaṃghānāmasmādatyonavidyate yastu gehehanūmaṃtaṃsarvadevaprapūjayet taṃvaṃdetasyamaṃtreṇatasyalakṣmīracaṃcalā dīrghamāyurlabhedevasarbātmevijayībhavet māyādibhūtasaṃkṣobhannadeśenaivajāyateḥ śatravassarvadāmitrabhāvenaivāsatesadā śaivānāṃvaiṣṇuvānāṃcaṣaṭkarmātraprada rśitaṃ nānyatsādhanamasyaivamaṃtrādasmāddhanūmataḥ cauravyāghrādibhītānāmayamevaparāyaṇaṃ parāhṛtarājyānāṃdharṣi tānāṃparaiḥpunaḥ santādvabhājāṃyuddheṣuruddhānāṃparasainikaiḥ yātrākālāhanūmaṃtasmanyastusvagādgṛhān nirgacchati
pṛ0 9a) savegenadraṣṭārthamabhigacchati svāpakālesmarannityaṃcorabhūtādikāntayet yadvayavāsudevādyehanūmatapadaṃtataḥ phalaṃti phalitapadaṃdhagetidhagetica āyurāṣarudrāhetisadyaḥpratyayakārakaḥ caturviśatyakarakomaṃtroyaṃplīharogahṛt vāgalli dalaṃcailamaṣṭapraguṇitaṃśubhaṃ vaṃśajaṃsakalaṃsthāpyakramāstīhodaropari saprāraṇyopalāgnauvaivadarpyaṣṭiṃpratāpayet maṃ treṇānenābhimaṃtryasaptavāratathāpunaḥ tatrābhimaṃtrayedevaṃsaptabhistuvicaruṇaḥ sphoṭaddhārādbhavesnīhālakṣmībhūtonasaṃśayaḥ karpūrādyaṣṭagaṃdhenapuchākārepaṭelikhet kokilākṣasyalekhanyārūpahanūmatāmanu uddhṛtyāṣṭādaśārṇomaṃtramadhyebhidhā maraiḥ mūrddhnivaddhenatenaivatrailokyaṃjayatidhruvaṃ yadvāsenājayechāyāṃpātayāsamālikhet caṃdrasūryagrahejaptvāmātṛkā mokṣaṇāvadhi homayeccadaśāśenatilasarṣapakādibhiḥ yuddhakālepatākāṃtāṃgajośvoparisaṃsthitaṃ darśayanparasainya syabhaṃgobhavatiniścitaṃ mālāmaṃtraṃjapedyastuhanumaṃtaṃsmanṛṇe vajrāṃgojāyateyuddhehanūmatsamavikramaḥ atharakṣāprava kṣyāmisarvasiddhipradāyakāṃ staṃbhanīṃsarvasainyānāṃbhūtānāṃcavaśaṃkaro rocanākuṃkuṃmābhyāṃcabhūrjjapatresuśobhane suva varṇamayalekhanyāyaṃtramaṣṭadalaṃlikhet sādhyanāmacatanmadhyemūlamaṃtraṃdalāṣṭake mālāmaṃtraṃcatadvāhyetridhāhrīṃkā raveṣṭitaṃ veṣṭyayaṃtraṃtrilohenakaṭivāhuśirasthitaṃ dhārayedyimāṃrakṣāṃvighnastasyanajāyate raṇerājakuledyūtavyavahāre parābhava śastraṃnākramatetasyavajradehomahāvalaḥ upasargādidoṣāṃścaviṣaṃsthāvarajaṃgamaṃ nabhayaṃvidyatetasyastrīṇāṃcā
pṛ0 9ba) tīvavallabhaḥ tasyapīḍāṃnakurvaṃtigṛhāścaivupagrahāḥ jalavahnibhayaṃnāstivyāghrataskarajaṃtathā jvarāḥsarvevinaśyaṃtitryāhikā dyāmahāvalāḥ yekṣayādimahārogāyaṃtrarājaprabhāvataḥ tāraṃhakārogniśakhaḥṣaḍdīrghasvaraviṃdumān praṇavāṃtoṣṭākṣarakomūla maṃtrudāhṛtaḥ tārādyavajrakāyetivattuḍeticoddharet kapilapiṃgakṣaproktoūrddhakeśamahābalaḥ raktamukhataḍijjihvama hāraudrapadaṃtataḥ daṃṣṭotkaṃṭakahakahakarālinevadetataḥ mahādṛḍhaprahāriṃścalaṃkeśvaravadhāyatu mahāsetuvadhapadaṃmahāśai lapravāhavagaganacarehyehibhagavaśramahāpadaṃvalaparākramapadaṃbhairabājñāpayeticehyehitimahāraudradīrghapuchenave ṣṭaya vairiṇaṃbhaṃjayapadaṃdviruktaṃhuṃphaṭaṃtakaḥ paṃcaviṃśatyāhyadhikaḥproktomaṃtraḥśatākṣaraḥ mālākhyoyaṃjvarādīnāṃrogāṇā maṃtakaḥsmṛta itiśrīrāmamaṃtroddhāraḥ gaṇeśādicaturṇāṃturāmāṃgatvaṃpratīyate sarvedevāstuvaṃtītisāmānyaśrutibo danāt maṃtrarājāgatāsarvamaṃtrāṇāśruticoditā jñeyāsākṣādanuktāpiparabrahmatvavigrahāt tasyāgneyegaṇeśānaṃsūryyaṃ naiṛtyakoṇakevāyavyetvaṃvikāmīśamīśānyepūjayetkramāt śaśivisūgaviśaśigasaśaśivigavisūgaśā vyaṃtarenuktaḥkramaḥpaṃcasuvahnitaḥ svasthānarahitādevāduḥkhaśokāmayapradāḥ mukhyepuṣpāṃjaliṃdatvāgaṇeśādyarcanaṃ bhavet gaṇeśevamukhyaścetatrasūryakramādbhavet teṣāṃtvanekemaṃtrārasyujñeyāgraṃthāṃtarādvudhaiḥ saṃkṣepeaihikathyaṃtegraṃtha vistarabhītitaḥtāraśrīśaktismarabhūsvavījaṃgaṇapatiṃvadet ṅetaṃvarāṃtevaradaṃsarvayuktaṃjanaṃcame vasaṃcetivadetpaścādāna
pṛ0 10a) yegnivallabhāṃ aṣṭāviṃśatyakṣaroyaṃmahāgaṇapatermanuḥgaṇakosyṛṣiḥchaṃdogāyatrītṛvṛdanvitāḥmahāgaṇapatiḥpro ktodevobhuvanavaṃditaḥ ṣaṣṭaṃvījontajauśaktiḥśrīrmukhaṃhṛdayaṃsmaraḥ sarvābhīṣṭaphalaprāptyaiṃviniyogotrakīrtitaḥtārā dyādisvavījenadīrghabhāgakalpanā bījāpūragadekṣukārmukarujmacakrāvjapāśotpalavrīhyagrasvaviṣāṇaratnaka laśānhastevahaṃtaṃbhaje hastīṃdrānanamiṃducūḍamaruṇachāyaṃtrinetrarasādāśliṣṭaṃpriyayāsupadmakakhyāsvāṃgasthayāsaṃ tataṃ agrethavilvamabhitaścaramārameśotaddakṣiṇevaṭajuṣaugirijāvṛṣāṃkau pṛṣṭecapippalajuṣauratipuṣpavāṇau savyepriyaṃgumabhitaścamahīvarāhau savyāpasavyabhāgetasyadhyeyaucaśaṃkhapadmanidhīmauktikamāṇikyābhauvarṣaṃtau dhārayādhanānisadā nijapuṣkaradhṛtakalaśaśrṛtamaṇimuktāpravālavarṣeṇa aviratadhāraṃvikiratnabhitaḥsādhakasa magraṃsaṃpatyai tāraṃghṛṇiḥsūryapamādityamitiuddharet ityaṣṭārasūryasyamaṃtroyaṃsamudīritaḥbhārgavosyṛṣichaṃdogā yatraṃdevatāmanoḥ śrotyomunibhiḥproktodṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradaḥaṃgamaṃtrāḥpradarśyaṃtesatyāyahṛdayaṃpunaḥ brahmaṇecaśiraḥ proktaṃviṣṇavevaśikhāmatā rudrāyavarmanirdiṣṭamagnayenetramīsūryamaṃtraḥ oṃghṛṇisūryādityaṃtaṃ sarvādyāstraṃcavi jñeyamitisyādaṃgakalpanāraktābjayugmābhayadānaṃhastaṃkeyūrabhūṣāṃgadakuṃḍalāvyaṃ māṇikyamauliṃdinanātha mīḍe vaṃdhūkakāṃtiṃvilasattrinetraṃ sāṃto'nugrahasaṃyuktoviṃdubhūṣitamastakaḥ prāsādarakhyomanuḥproktobhaktānāṃsurapā
pṛ0 10ba) dayaḥṛṣisyādvāmadevosyapaṃktiṃchaṃdasamīritaṃ sadāśivodevatāvahaṃvījaṃśaktirausmṛtā dīrghasvarayujamūlavījenasyātṣaḍaṃgakaṃ muktāpīta payodamauktikajapāvarṇairmukhaiḥ paṃcabhikhyakṣairarcitamīśamiṃdumukudaṃpūrṇeṃdukoṭiprabhaṃśūlāṭaṃkakṛpāṇavajradahanaṃnāgeṃdraghaṭāṃ kuśānpāśābhītitaraṃdadhānamasitākalpajvalaṃciṃtayet lakuśīśognimāruḍhovāmanetrārddhacaṃdrayāna bhuvaneśīsamākhyā- tābhuktimuktyaikasādhanaṃ ṛṣiṃśaktirbhavechaṃdogāyatrīdevatāmano haṃvījaṃmīśaśaktirasyeṣṭārtheviniyojayet ṣaḍdīrghayukta vījenaṣaḍaṃgāniprakalpayet udyadādityasaṃkāśāṃtryakṣāṃsmeramukhīṃbhaje pāśāṃkuśābhayavarāndadhatīṃjagadaṃvikāṃ siddhādi śonānaiṣāmaṃgalesatirājavat pūjāprakāraḥprādhānyedraṣṭavyograṃthavistarāt ityaṃgadevatāmaṃtroddhāraḥ agastyoktaṃcamāhā tmyaṃprādhānyakāraṇaṃmahat vakṣyeśrīmaṃtrarājasyaśrutvāyadyātisadgatiṃ sarveṣumaṃtravaryyeṣuśreṣṭaṃvaiṣṇavamucyate gāṇapatyeṣuśaiveṣu śāktasaureṣṭamīṣṭadaṃ vaiṣṇaveṣvapisarveṣurāmamaṃtrāḥphalādhikāḥ gāṇapatyādimaṃtreṣukoṭikoṭiguṇādhikāḥ vinaivadī kṣāṃvipreṃdraṣuraścaryyāṃvinaivahi vinaivanyāsavidhinājapamātreṇasiddhidāḥ maṃtrasteṣvapināyāsaphaladoyaṃṣaḍakṣaraḥ ṣaḍakṣaro yaṃmaṃtrastusarvādyaupanivāraṇaḥ maṃtrarājitiproktaḥsarveṣāmuttamottamaḥ dainaṃdinaṃcaṭuritaṃpakṣamāsartupakṣajaṃ sarvadahatiniḥ śeṣamūrṇāvamivānalaḥbrahmahatyāsahasrāṇijñānājñānakṛtānica svarṇaṃsteyasurāpānagurutalpāyutānica koṭiko ṭisahasrāṇihyupapātakajānyapi sarvāṇyapipraṇaśyaṃtirāmamaṃtrānukīrtanāt ityādi tathācaśrutiḥevaṃtārakaṃbrāhma
pṛ0 11a) ṇonityamadhītesapāśrātaṃtaratisatpuṃtaratibhrūṇahatyāṃtaratisasarvahatyāṃtaratisamaṃsāraṃtaratilovimuktātmāśritobhavati sobhṛtatvaṃcagacchati anenasadṛśomaṃtrojagatsvapinavidyate anenārādhitorāmaḥprasīdatyevasatvaraṃ sāmānyenaivasarveṣāṃ maṃtrāṇāṃrāghavasyatu anuṣṭānavidhirjñeyoviśeṣāṃtatratatravai itimaṃtramāhātmyaṃrāmasya śrīrāmamaṃtrarājasyamabhyagarthobhi dhīyate saṃhitopaniṣatmūlaḥsarvakāryyārthasiddhidaḥrakārovahnivacanaḥ prakāśeparyyavaśyati saccidānaṃyosyaparamā tmārthucyate vyaṃjananniṣkalaṃbrahmaprāṇomāyeticasvaraḥvyaṃjanaiḥsvarasaṃyogovidvitatprāṇayojanaṃ rephejyotirmayetasmā tkṛtamākārayojanaṃ makārobhyudayārthatvātmāmārtheticakīrtyate ayamevātamutsṛjyākāramekākṣaromanuḥsoyaṃ vījasyaketusyātsamāyaṃbrahmucyatesaviṃduḥsopipuruṣaḥśivasūryyendurūpavān jyotisāsyaśikhārūpaṃnādasmaprakṛ tirmatā prakṛtiḥpuruṣaścobhausamāyābrahmaṇaḥsvataḥviṃdunādātmakaṃvījaṃvahniḥsomakalāmatā agniṣomātma kaṃviśvaṃrāmavījepratiṣṭitaṃ yathaivaṭabījasthaḥprākṛtaścamahādrumaḥ tathaivarāmavījasthaṃjagadetaccarācaraṃ itiśrutiḥ itivījārthaḥakṣarārthedhunāsyaivaviśadīkṛtemanoḥbījoktamubhayātmatvaṃrāmanāmanidṛśyate vījaṃmāyāvinirmuktaṃpa raṃbrahmetikīrtyatemuktidaṃsādhakānāṃtanmekāromuktidomataḥmārūpatvādatorāmobhuktimuktiphalapradaḥādyovā tatpadārthaḥsyātmakārastvaṃpadārthavān tayoḥstaṃyojaṃnamasītyātmatatvavidoviduḥ tatvamasyādivākyaṃtukebalaṃmuktidaṃ
pṛ0 11ba) yataḥmuktibhuktipradaṃcedaṃtasmādapyatiricyate ramaṃteyoginonityaṃyaddhāramayatisvakān nirguṇaṃsacidānaṃdaṃsaguṇaṃcotikī rtyate jīvavācinamonāmacātmārāmetigīyate tādātmikāyācaturthītathāvāyetikathyate maṃtroyaṃvācakorāmovā- cyaḥ syādyogetayoḥ phaladaścaivasarveṣāṃsādhakānāṃnasaṃśayaḥ yathānāmāvācakenanāmnāyobhimukhobhavet tathā jīvātmakomaṃtriṇobhimukhobhavet tathājīvātmakomaṃtrocinmayāḥsyādvitīyasyaniḥkalasyāśarīriṇaḥ upāsakānāṃkā ryārthaṃbrahmaṇorūpakalpanā rūpasthānāndevatānāṃpuṃstryaṅgāstrādikalpanā mananāttrāṇanānmaṃtromaṃtriṇākalpabhūhahaḥ mūla tvāsarvamaṃtrāṇāṃmūlādhārasamudbhavān mūlasvarūpamūlatvātmūlamaṃtradatismṛtaḥsaptakoṭimahāmaṃtrāupamaṃtrāśca tādṛśā varṇamātāḥsvarāḥsarvemūlamaṃtrāsamutthitāḥ tejādhītaṃtenasarvamanuṣṭitaṃmūlamaṃtraṃvijānātiyovidvānguruda rśitaṃ mūlavijānamātreṇajīvanmuktobhavennaraḥ aṇidikamaiśvaryyamaṃcirādevajāyate itimaṃtrarājārthaḥ manuṣketesarveṣā madhikārostidehināṃ mumukṣuṇāṃviraktānāṃtathācāśramiṇāṃsadā rāmodhyeyaḥpraṇavavadyatīnāṃtuviśeṣataḥ śrutyuktatvātā rakatvaṃmaṃtrarājasyayatsphuṭaṃ omarddhamātrāviṃduścanādovarṇāḥkrameṇaṣā tārakatvātārakaṃtachrutyuktādavadhāryatāṃ athahainaṃbhara dvājaḥpaprachayājñavalkyaṃkiṃtārakaṃkiṃtaratītisahovācayājñavalkyaḥ tārakaṃdīrghānalaṃviṃdupūrvakaṃdīrghānalaṃpunarṇāya namaḥcaṃdrāyanamaḥbhadrāyanamaḥityoṃtadvrahmātmakāsaccidānaṃdākhyāityupāsitavyaṃ akāraḥprathamākṣarobhavati ukārodvi
pṛ0 12a) tīyākṣarobhavati makārastṛtīyākṣarobhavati arddhamātrāścaturthākṣarobhavati viṃdupaṃcākṣarobhavati nādaḥṣaṣṭākṣarobhavati tā rakatvābhārakobhavati tadevatārakaṃbrahmatvaviddhītiśrutiḥ rāmetiparamaṃjapyaṃtārakaṃbrahmasaṃjñitaṃ tathācarāmarāmetieta ttārakamucyate ityādyāśrutayaḥsaṃtismṛtayaścasahasraśaḥ etadevāvimukteśrīrudraḥkathayatisvakaṃ mumūrkhomaṇikarṇikyā marddhodakanivāsinaḥ rudrastutārakaṃbrahmavyācaṣṭetiśruterapi sarveṣāmadhirovaijñātavyodeśakottamaiḥ agastisaṃhitāyāṃ tuetadevopapāditaṃśucibratatamāḥśūdrādhārmikādvijasevakāḥstriyaḥpativratāścānyepratilomānulomatāḥlokāścāṃḍā laparyyaṃtaṃsarvepyatrādhikāriṇaḥ śrutirbrahmāhaṣadvarṇaṃsmṛtirvarṇaddvayātmakaṃ dvayorvirodhaḥsaṃproktonāśyatetadvyavasthayāśruti smṛtivirodhenaśrutirevalīyasī vyavasthābhāvamāśrityavākyametanniyāmakaṃ ṣadvarṇaṃbrāhmaṇādīnāṃtrayāsāṃtudvivarṇakaṃ anyeṣāṃdeśikeṃdreṇavaktavyaṃtārakaṃparaṃ vinātupraṇavaṃmaṃtrānagāyatrīṃśrutivāraṇāt sāvitrīṃlakṣmīṃyajuṣpraṇavaṃyadijānī yānstrīśūdrasyasamatodhoracharati tasmātsarvacaṣṭeyadyācaṣṭesācāryastenaivamṛtobhavatītitāpanīyaśruti tathācāhāgastya maṃtroyamupadeṣṭavyobrahmaṇādyanurūpatiti nanyūnaṃdvyakṣaraṃvācyaṃnavapūrṇaṣaḍakṣaraṃṅetādyapekāhīnatvāchrutirapyāhanibhraṃmaṃ ramaṃteyoginonityaṃsatyānaṃdecimonāmacātmārāmetigīyate tādātmikāyācaturthītathācāyetikathyate maṃtroyaṃ*? cakorāmovācyaḥsmādyogetayoḥ phaladaścaivasarveṣāṃsādhakānāṃnasaṃśayaḥyathānāmāvācakenanāmnāyobhimukho
pṛ0 12ba) bhavet cinmayāḥsyādvitīyasyaniḥkalasyāśarīriṇaḥ upāsakānāṃkāryārthaṃbrahmaṇorūpakalpanā rūpasthānāndeva tānāṃpuṃstryaṅgāstrādikalpanā mananāttrāṇanānmaṃtromaṃtriṇākalpabhūruhaḥ mūlatvāsarvamaṃtrāṇāṃmūlādhārasamudbha vān mūlasvarūpamūlatvānmūlamaṃtritismṛtaḥsaptakoṭimahāmaṃtrāupamaṃtrāścatādṛśā varṇamātrāḥsvarāḥsarvemū- lamaṃtrāsamutthitāḥtenādhītaṃśrutaṃtenatenasarvamanuṣṭitaṃmūlamaṃtraṃvijānātiyovidvāngurudarśitaṃ mūlavijñānamā treṇajīvanmuktobhavennaraḥ aṇidikmaiśvaryyamatrirādevajāyate itimaṃtrarājārthaṃḥ manuṣvetesarveṣāmadhikārostidehi nāṃ mumukṣaṇāṃviraktānāṃtathācāmiṇāṃsadā rāmodhyeyaḥpraṇavavadyatīnāṃtuviśeṣataḥ śrutyuktatvātārakatvaṃmaṃtrarāja syayatsphuṭaṃ omarddhamātrāviṃduścanādovarṇāḥkrameṇaṣā tārakatvāttārakaṃtachrutyuktādavadhāryatāṃ athahainaṃbhāradvājaḥpa prachayājñavalkyaṃkiṃtārakaṃkiṃtaratītisahovācayājñavalkyaḥtārakaṃdīrghānalaṃviṃdupūrvakaṃdīrghānalaṃpunarmmāyanamaḥ caṃdrāyanamaḥ bhadrāyanamaḥ ityoṃtadvrahmātmakāsaccidānaṃdākhyāityupāsitavyaṃ akāraḥprathamākṣarobhavatidātmani iti rāmapadenāśauparaṃbrahmābhidhīyatiti ityadhikāranayaḥ athābhiṣekaṃvakṣyāmidīkṣāvidhimanuttamaṃ upāsanaśatenāpi vināyenanasiddhyati madhumāsebhaveduḥkhaṃmādhaveratnasaṃcayaḥmaraṇaṃbhavatijyeṣṭeāṣāḍhevaṃdhunāśanaṃ samṛddhiḥśrāvaṇe nūnaṃbhavedbhādrapadekṣayaḥ prajānāmāśvinemāsisarvataḥśubhamevahi jñānaṃsyātkārtikesaukhyaṃmārgaśīrṣebhavatyapi pauṣe
pṛ0 13a) jñānakṣayomāghebhavenmedhāvivarddhanaṃ phālgunepisamṛddhiḥsyātmalamāsaṃvivarjayet itimāsaśuddhiḥ ravaugurusitesomekarta vyaṃvudhuśukrayoḥ itivāraśuddhiḥ aśvinīrohiṇīsvātīviśākhāhastabheṣuca jyeṣṭottarātrayeṣvevaṃkuryyābhmaṃtrābhiṣecanaṃ nāradataṃtre rohiṇīśravaṇārdrācadhaniṣṭhāuttarātrayaṃ puṣyaḥśatabhiṣaścaivadīkṣānakṣatramucyate itinakṣatraśuddhiḥ pūrṇi- māpaṃcamīcaivadvitīyāsaptamītathā trayodaśīcadaśamīpraśastāḥsarvakāmadāḥ maṃtrasārasaṃgrahe dvitīyāpaṃcamī cāpiṣaṣṭicāpiviśeṣataḥdvādaśyāmapikartavyaṃtrayodaśyāmathāpivā ititithiśuddhiḥ paṃcāgaśuddhidivase svodayeśaśitārayoḥguruśukrodayeśuddhalagnedvādaśasādhitecaṃdratārānukūlevaśasyasarvakarmasu itikālaśuddhiḥ sū ryagrahaṇakāletunānyadanvesitaṃbhavet sūryyagrahaṇakālenasamānonāstikaścanaḥtatrayadyatkṛtaṃsarvamataṃtaphaladaṃ bhavet namāsitithivāradiśodhanaṃsūryyaparvaṇidadātīṣṭaṃgṛhītaṃyatasminkālegurortṛṣusiddhirbhavatimaṃtrasyavi- nāyāsenavegataḥatastatraivarāmasyamaṃtratīrthābhiṣecanaṃ kartavyaṃsarvayatnenamaṃtrasiddhimabhīpsubhiḥ satīrtherkavidhugrāse tantudāmanaparvaṇoḥ maṃtradīkṣāṃprakurvāṇomāsarkṣādinnaśodhayet ityāpavādakālaḥ upāsakastuśuddhātmāguruṃyatne natoṣayet svacitacitrakāyaiścabhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ yathādadātisaṃtuṣṭāḥprasannovaradomanuṃ svayamevatathācaiva- mitikartavyatākramaḥgururviśuddhaḥprāgevaśuddhāhātsaptamehani saṃkalpopoṣyakartavyamaṃkurāropaṇaṃśubhaṃ kuryyānnāṃ
pṛ0 13ba) dīmukhaṃśrāddhaṃpūrvedyussvastivācanaṃ svagṛhyoktaprakāreṇatadetaddhiradhītavai caturbhirvarṇakaiḥsamyaṅnīlapītasitāsitaiḥsarva tobhadramālikhyatatradhānyāṃjalidvayaṃ nidhāyakalaśaṃtatratīrthatoyasupūritaṃ veṣṭitaṃvastrayugmepaṃcaratnasamanvitaṃ āmrāśvatthaprasūnāḍhyaṃśākhābhirupaśobhitaṃ nārikelaṣkalopetaṃmaṃgalaiḥparitoḥjvalaṃ sarvotsavaṃsamāyuktaṃkṛtvā tatrārccayeddhariṃ ṛgyajuḥsāmasūktaiścasmārtaiḥpaurāṇikairapi maṃtrairāgamikaiścaivavaiṣṇavairdevamarcayet varayedvrāhmaṇā nvāsaḥkuṃḍalāṃgulībhūṣaṇaiḥ śrāvayetaistusūktānimaṃtravidhyutasaveśubhe gurustatkalpavidhinābhūtaśuddhyādyathāca ret nyāsajālaṃvavinyasyavidhivataṃtrapūjayet pūjanīyaiścapūrvoktasādhanaiḥpuruṣotamaṃ pūrvoktanṛtyagītādyairutsavaṃta trakārayet puṇyaśrībhyogṛhasthebhyodadyādvakusuvistaraṃ gaṃdhapuṣpāṃvutāṃvūlasadvāsobhūṣaṇādikaṃ bhojanaṃcānnapā nīyairanyebhyopipradīyate evaṃtatrotsavaṃkṛtvārātraujāgaraṇaṃcaret evaṃdivācarātrauvatrikālaṃpūjayetprabhuṃ ṣaṅsahasraṃjapeta trapūjāteharnniśaguruḥ parehanitathāprātaḥpūrvavatsarvamācaret saṃpūjyavidhidrāmamagnikāryamathācaret vaśiṣṭasaṃhitāyā tatkuṃḍalakṣaṇamīritaṃ gṛhasyeśānabhāgenumaṃḍapaṃkārayedvudhaḥ ṣadvādaśāṣṭabhirhastauṣoḍaśaivāsamaṃtataḥ caturdvārasamāyu ktaṃtoraṇādyairalaṃkṛtaṃ kuṃḍaṃtanmadhyabhāgetukārayecaturasrakaṃvitastidvayakhātaṃyatkuṃḍaṃsacaturaṃgulaṃ viprāṇāṃkṣatri- yāṇāṃtadaṃgulatrayasaṃyutaṃ vaiśyānāṃdvyaṃgulādhikyaṃśūdrāṇāṃhastamātrakaṃ prathamāmekhalātatradvādaśāṃgulavistṛ
pṛ0 14a) tā caturbhiraṃgulaiḥtasyāśconnataṃtusamaṃtataḥ tasyāścoparivaprasmyācaturaṃgulamunnataḥ aṣṭābhiraṃgulaiḥsamyagvistīrṇaṃtu samaṃtataḥ tasyoparipunaḥkāryovapraḥsopitṛtīyakaḥcaturaṃgulavistīrṇaśconnataścatathāvidhaḥyoniścapaścimebhāge prāṅmukhīmadhyasaṃsthitā ṣaḍaṃgulaiścavistīrṇācāyatādvādaśāṃgulaiḥpṛṣṭonnatāgajauṣṭevasachidrāmadhyamonnatakaṃṭho- ṣṭayavamātraḥsyātkuṃḍecakaramātrake kaṃṭhoyatnenakartavyobhuktimuktiphalepsubhiḥnābhirapyathavākuṃḍamekamekhalakaṃbha vet evaṃlakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃkuṃḍamiṣṭārthasiddhidaṃ anekadoṣadaṃkuṃḍaṃyatranyunādhikaṃyadi tasmāsamyakparīkṣyaivaṃkartavyaṃśubhami cchatā iṣumātraṃsthaṃḍilaṃvāsaṃkṣiptehomakarmaṇi itikuṃḍalakṣaṇaṃ vāyavyevāthīśānyepūjāvedīṃprakalpayet hastonta tāṃtravistīrṇāṃcaturasrāṃsamaṃtataḥśālitaṃḍulacūrṇaiścanīlapītasitāsitaiḥraktāruṇaidhūmragaurairvarṇairyyaṃtraṃsamālikhet rājñodīkṣāyadānyatravasupatranirūpitaṃ ādaurekhāścatudikṣudaśasaptacakārayet tatrāṣṭapatraṃkamalaṃvṛttatrayaparīvṛ taṃ somasūryāgniviṃvānitathākuryyādvicakṣaṇaḥcaturasraṃvahistasyaṣaḍkoṇaṃkarṇikāṃtare pītaṃpūrvesitaṃdeyapaści- mepyutaretathā raktastudakṣiṇekṛṣṇaṃpāṭalaṃvahnisaṃsthitaṃ naiṛtenīlavarṇaṃtuvāyavyedhūmravarṇakaṃ aiśegauraṃvini rdiṣṭamaṣṭapatreṣvayaṃkramaḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhanurvāṇāṃścamaṃḍale vilikhyavarṇakaiḥsamyaktatrarāmaṃsamarccayet nyāyārjjitaiḥsādhanaiścadānahomārcanādikaṃ kuryānnacedadhoyātibhaktyākurvannapidvijāmadhyeṣoḍaśakoṣṭāni
pṛ0 14ba) yaṃtrārthaṃparimārjayet tataḥpaṃktīdvayaṃmārjjāṃdikṣukoṇaṃdharāgṛhaṃ vidikṣucasamārekhāstatradvādaśarāśayaḥ kṛtvāyaṃdvayaṃvāhyaṃ valyarthaṃmārjayettataḥ śeṣapaṃktidvayeṣadbhiṣkoṣṭhairdvārāsamaṃtataḥ śobhopaśobhāvahvoṣṭairarddhaṃcaṃdrāstribhistribhiḥ paṃcāya tanadīkṣāsuhyeṣasādhāraṇakramaḥ kuṃḍāṃtarepyevamevamārādhyaṃjuhuyānmune itivedikālakṣaṇaṃ śruvaṃvāhupramāṇe nahomārthaṃvidadhītavai caturasraṃvidhāyādausaptapaṃcāṃgulaṃkramāt tṛtīyāṃśenagarjasyātadaṃtanṛtaṃśobhitaṃ khā tvāsamaṃtiryyagūrddhaṃtadadhaḥśodhayedvahiḥ caturthāśaṃpaṃcāṃgulasyaśeṣāccārddhaṃtadaṃtataḥ ramyāṃcamekhalāḥkhāteśiṣṭenā rddhenakārayet kuryyāccibhāgavistāramaṃṅguṣṭenasamāyataṃ sārddhamaṃguṣṭakaṃvāsthāttadagretumukhaṃbhavet caturaṃgulavistā raṃpaṃcāṃgulamathāpivā tridvayāṃgukaṃtasyamadhyāntantusuśobhanaṃ sukhiraṃkaṃdeśesyādviśedyāvatkanīyasī śeṣaṃ daṃḍaṃtukartavyaṃyathārucivicitrakaṃ catuḥkoṇasamāyuktohastamātraḥśruvobhavet catuṣkaṃśobhanaṃvṛtaṃdvyaṃgulaṃvida dhītavai yathālpayaṃkegoṣpādaṃruciraṃdṛśyatetathā pālāśapatrenichidreruciresraksruvaumune vidadhyādvāśvattha patresaṃkṣiptehomakarmaṇi itisruksruvau tataḥkuṃḍasthūlaṃsamyaggomayonopalipyaca ādaubahnimakhaṃkuryādu paviṣṭasuviṣṭare prāṇānāmamyamanasājapanmaṃtramananyadhīḥyāvanmarutsaṃcatisarvāṃgeṣvapiniścayaḥ saṃkalpasthaṃ ḍilekuṃḍekṛtvālekhāmadhyataḥṣaṭṣaṭkoṇaṃtrikoṇaṃvāvahnimatrādadhītavai prokṣopasāryatatpaścadatvāviṣṭaramādarāt
pṛ0 15a) lakṣmīmṛtumaṃtītatraprabhonārāyaṇasyaca grāmyadharmeṇasaṃjātamagniṃtatraviciṃtayet pramathyavidhinaivāgnimāhitāgnegṛhā dapi ānīyavādadhītātrakuśaiḥprajvālyayatnataḥ saṃprokṣyayājñakaiṣkāṣṭaiḥpunaḥprajvālayedapi prāṇāyāmaṃtataḥkṛtvā paristīryyakuśāṃkuraiḥsvagṛhyoktavidhānenavāsudevādibhirmune pātrāṇyāsādyavidhivadidhmamaṃtravit tānyavekṣya pavitreṇacotānānividhāyaca punaprokṣyānayetpātraṃparipūryyaśubhāṃvunā datvākṣatānpavitraṃcatatrotpūyanidhāyatat diśyutarasyāṃtatpātraṃpraṇītetyucyatevudhaiḥtatrārcayetprabhuṃviṣṇuṃvrahmāṇaṃvrāhmaṇairyutaṃājyaṃsaṃskṛtyavidhivasruksravā- vomitibruvan garbhādhānādikaṃvahnevivāhāṃtaṃsamācaret aṣṭāvaṣṭauvatāreṇavaikekasyatukarmaṇaḥjuhuyādarciteva hnauvauṣaḍaṃtaṃsamāpyaca karmāṃtaraṃsamārabhyatadapyevaṃsamāpayet idhmādhānādyagnimukhājyabhāgaujuhuyātpunaḥ itya gnimukhaṃ evamagnaususaṃpannevaiṣṇavaṃśrapayeccaruṃ sāṃgāhavānamaṃtrāgnaupūjayedraghunāyakaṃ samidājyavarūṇāṃcapratyekaṃṣo ḍaśāhutīḥ juhuyānmūlamaṃtreṇaparivārebhyevaca tisrovaināyakādibhyasarvebhyopyāhutīrmune dvārāṃgaparivārebhyaḥ surebhyojuhuyātpunaḥhutvājyenāhutīstatrapradadyātatadāptaye tatadravyaiścajuhuyāsarvaccarumanohare dvārapīṭhasurebhya ścahutvādaujuhuyāttataḥ agādivaiṣṇavāṃtebhyatisrātyāhutīpṛthak tataḥsriṣṭakṛtaṃhutvāghṛtenamunisattamaḥ jalenavidhināsamyakpariṣicyasamaṃtataḥ praṇītāmārjanaṃhutvādadyāccabrahmadakṣiṇāṃ svasvavitāusāreṇalobha
pṛ0 15ba) mohavivarjitaḥ tatobrahmaṇamuddhāsyabrāhmaṇānbhojayedatha agnimadhyagataṃdevaṃpunaḥsvātmaniyojayet ekībhūtaṃviciṃtyaivaṃvā cayansvastivācanaṃ āsīrvacobhirviduṣāmedhyamānaḥsukhībhavet hutaśeṣaṃtataḥprāśyaḥkuṃkuyaṃḍapramāṇakaṃ maṃtritaṃrāma gāyatryātatastasmaivaliṃharet sannivapiṃdevasyavāhyāṃtardikṣuvāndhasā nityenaimitrikekāmyepyedagnimukhaṃsmṛtaṃ sarvatrā- bhyudayaśrāddhamaṃkurāropaṇaṃtathā ādāvevaprakurvītakarmaṇobhyudayārthataḥ itihomavidhiḥ kalaśasthāyarāmāyadadyā- tpuṣpāṃjaliṃpunaḥ tataḥśiṣyamupānīyabhaktinamramakalmaṣaṃprāṇānāyamyavidhivadbhūtaśuddhiṃvidhāyacasurāstvāmabhiiti maṃtraistubahubhibrāhmaṇaiḥsaha abhiṣiṃcecatanmūrddhitadetatkalaśodakaiḥ surāstvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃtubrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ vāsudevojagannāthastathāsakarṣaṇovibhuḥpradyumnaścāniruddhaścabhavaṃtuvijayāyate ākhaṃḍalognirbhagavānayamo vauniṛtistathā varuṇaḥpavanaścaivadhanādhyakṣastathāśivaḥbrahmaṇāsahitaśeṣodikpālāḥpāṃtutesadā kī rtirlakṣmīrdhṛtirmedhāpuṣṭiḥśraddhākriyāmatiḥ vuddhirlajjāvapuḥśāṃtirmāyānidrācabhāvanā etastvāmabhiṣiṃ- caṃtupuṣṭiḥkāṃtikṣaṃmātathā ādityaścaṃdramābhaumovudhajīvasitārkajāḥ grahāstvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃturāhuketuścapūjitāḥ devadānavagaṃdharvāyakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ ṛṣayomanavogāvodevamātarevaca devapatnyodrumānāgādaityāścāpsa rasāṃgaṇāḥ astrāṇisastrāṇirājānovāhanānica auṣadhānivaratnānikālasyāvayavāścaye saritaṃsāgarāḥ
pṛ0 16a) śailāstīrthānijaladānadāḥetestvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃtusarvakāmārthasiddhaye itivaśiṣṭasaṃhitāyāṃabhiṣekamaṃtrāḥnārāya ṇaḥsvayaṃrāmaḥśiṣyesannidadhātavai sarvagaḥsarvatopyastiprasīdatudayānidhiḥitisaṃsmṛtyasaṃsmṛtyatajjalairabhiṣeca yet paridhāpyasuvāsaścacaṃdanādyakaropyaca kuṃḍalecāṃgulīyaṃcabhārayitvānyasetataḥ vaiṣṇavīmātṛkāṃcaivatatvanyā saviśāradaḥtanmūrtipaṃjaranyāsamṛṣyādinyāsamevaca pūrvavadvidhivaṣṭiṣyatanāvevaṃpravinyaset tatastachirasi svasyahastaṃdatvāśataṃjapet aṣṭotaraṃtatomaṃtrāṃdadyādudakapūrvakaṃāvayostulyaphaladobhavetvevamudīvayet pra sannavaradastasmaiśiṣyāyamunipuṃgavaḥsvatojyotirmayīṃvidyāṃgachaṃtīṃbhāvayedguruḥāgatāṃbhāvayechiṣyodhanyo smītiviśeṣataḥkṛtakṛtyastathāśiṣyaḥsarvaṃtasmainivedayet yaccayāvaccatadbhaktyāguraveruṣṭacetanaḥgobhūhira ṇyavipinagṛhakṣetrādikaṃbahunacedarddhaṃvātaddaśāṃśamathāpivā akleśādannavastrādidadyāvitānusārataḥ śrī bhāgavate iyadehisachiṣyaiḥkarttavyaṃguruniṣkṛtaṃyadvaiviśuddhabhāvenasarvārthātmārpaṇaṃgurāviti prakārāṃtaranālaṃ vyaguruṃyatnenatoṣayet guruputrakalatrādīṃstoṣayetkanakādibhiḥarhaṇābhiścavahudhābhaktyāchādanabhūṣaṇaiḥe vamuktaprakāreṇaguravedatadakṣiṇaḥkṛtakṛtyaṃtathātmānaṃmatvāviprāṃścabhojayet tebhyopidakṣiṇādatvāsarvaṃtatpari pūrayet brāhmaṇāśīrvacobhiścagurvāśīrbhiḥsamedhitaḥvisarjjayeccagurvādīstatobhuṃjītamaṃtravit evaṃladhvaṃmanu
pṛ0 16ba) rvipraḥkṛtārthasyānnasaṃśayaḥ itidīkṣāprakāraḥdīkṣāṃvakṣyethasaṃkṣepānprasaktācāryyasamyatāṃtatvasmare madaivekṣātadā dīkṣāgurorājñānurūpataḥ natithinārcanaṃhomonasnānaṃnajapakriyāḥdīkṣāyākāraṇaṃkiṃtusvekṣāvāptetusadgu- rāviti tadevalagnaṃsudinaṃtadevatārāvalaṃcaṃdravalaṃtadeva vidyāvalaṃdaivabalaṃtadaivalakṣmīpateteṃghriyugaṃsmarā mi itidīkṣāmānyakālaḥ muhurtesarvatobhadrenavaṃkuṃbhaṃnidhāyaca sodakaṃgaṃdhapuṣpābhyāmarcitaṃvastrasaṃvṛtaṃ sarvauṣadhīpaṃcaratnapaṃcapallavasaṃyutaṃ tatodevārcanekṛtvāhunedaṣṭottaraṃśataṃ śiṣyaṃsvalaṃkṛtaṃvedyāmupagnimupave śayet maṃtritaṃprokṣiṇītoyaiśśāṃtikuṃbhajalaistathā mūlamaṃtreṇāṣṭaśataṃmaṃtriterabhiṣecayet athasaṃpādayenmaṃ traṃhastaṃśirasidhārayet samostvityakṣatāndadyādathaśiṣyocaṃyedguruṃ itisaṃkṣepadīkṣāḥ atropyaśaktaḥkaści ccedavjamadhyarvyamākṣataṃ tadaṃvunābhiṣicyāṣṭavāraṃmūlenakekaraṃ nidhāyāmuṃjayetkarṇupadeśotvayaṃvidhiḥcaṃ drasūryyagrahetīrthesiddhakṣetreśivālaye maṃtramātraprakathanamupadeśaḥsucyate ityupadeśaḥ dvividhaṃsyālladhvama norbāhmāṃtaramupāsunaṃ nyāsināṃcāṃtaraṃproktamanyeṣāmubhayaṃsmṛtaṃ paṃcavarṇātmikāśaktividyākhyāsamudā- hṛtā nādātmikośiṣaṣṭesaṃhṛtyātmānaciṃtanaṃ ātmanastatvaciṃtānusyādapyātmānuciṃtanaṃ ubhayoraikyaciṃtā tutadbhavāṃtakamāntaraṃdravyādyārādhanaṃvāhyuṃ?gṛhasthasyatadapyatha tadaivoktaṃsaṃhitāyāṃśaṃbhunāśāṃbhavīṃprati nagṛ
pṛ0 17a) hījñānamātreṇaparatrehacamaṃgalaṃ propnoticaṃdravadanedānahomādibhivinā gṛhasthoyadidānādidadyānnajuhuyāda pi pūjayeddidhinānaivakaṣkuryādetadatvahaṃ nabrahmacāriṇodātumadhikārostibhāminī gurubhyonputrasarvebhyaḥko vādāsyanyupekṣitaṃ nāraṇyavāsināṃśaktinātrasaṃtikalauyuge parivradjñānamātreṇadānahomādirbhivinā sarvaduḥkhapiśācebhyomuktobhavatinānyathā parivrāḍyoviraktaścaviraktastugṛhītathā kuṃbhīpākenimajyete tāvubhaukamalānane puṇyastriyogṛhasthāścamaṃgalairmaṃgalārthinaḥpūjopakaraṇaiṣkuryyuraghudāṃnānicārhaṇaṃ vā naprasthāścayatayoyadyevaṃkuryyuranvahaṃsaṃsārānnanivartuṃtevidhyitikramadoṣataḥ ārūḍhapatitāṃhyetebhaveyuduḥkhabhāja naṃ ahiṃsāparamodharmastevāmeṣānapaddhatiḥnahiṃsānpatirekeṇalabhyaṃtetānitānivai bhāvanākalpitaiḥpūjāsā dhanairevayujyate navahiryyogayuktānāmaṃtasteṣāṃpraśasyate ātmānaṃśasataṃrāmaṃsaṃbhāvyaviharaṃtiyaṃ nateṣāṃduṣkṛ taṃkiṃciṃduṣkṛtothānacāparaḥ paribhirbhvāvitaidravyaiḥpūjyorāmotvahaṃtataḥsaṃpāditairgṛhasthaiścasevakramucyate ityupāsanaciṃtā itiśrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryyaśrīmanmukuṃdavanaśrīcaraṇaśiṣyānaṃdavanaviracitā yāṃśrīrāmārcanacaṃdrikāyāṃprathamaḥpaṭalaḥvadaṃtitaṃtatvavidastatvaṃyadjñānamadvayaṃ brahmetiparamātmetibhagavāni- tiśadyate nachadadhānāmunayojñānavairāgyayuktayā paśyaṃtyātmanicātmānaṃbhaktyāśrutagṛhītayā ataḥpuṃbhidvi

pṛ0 27ba) kuṃḍanībhyāṃnamaḥ 3 baṃgalagaṃḍeśakapardinībhyāṃnamaḥ 3 bhaṃdviraṃḍeśavijayābhyāṃnamaḥ 3 maṃmahākālajayāṃbhyāṃnamaḥ yaṃbālīśasumukheśvarībhyāṃnamaḥ 3 raṃbhujaṃgeśarevatībhyāṃnamaḥ 3 laṃpinākīśamādhavībhyāṃnamaḥ 3 vaṃkhaḍgīśavā ruṇībhyāṃnamaḥ 3 śaṃvakeśavāyavībhyāṃnamaḥ 3 ṣaṃśveteśarakṣopadhāriṇībhyāṃnamaḥ 3 saṃbhṛgvīśasahasābhyāṃ namaḥ 3 haṃlakulīśalakṣmībhyāṃnamaḥ 3 laṃśiviśavyāpinībhyāṃnamaḥ 3 kṣaṃsaṃvartakeśamahāmāyābhyāṃnamaḥ3 itivyāpakaṃ itiśrīkaṃṭhādinyāsaḥ śuddhaḥsaviṃdukāyukākalābhiḥkeśavādibhiḥ śrīkaṃṭhamātṛkācātranyā sāṃgepaṃcamīsmṛtā rudrairyuktāṃkevalāṃvāmanūnāṃkarmāraṃbhemātṛkāṃvinyasedyaḥmaṃtrāḥsadyaṣkurvatetasyasiddhiṃ doṣaiḥsārddhaṃyātināśaṃjarāca athatatvaṃpravakṣyāmitatvanyāsaṃtadarthināṃ yattatvanyāsamātreṇatatvamevaprajāya te oṃmaṃnamaḥparāyajīvātmanenamaḥ oṃbhaṃnamaḥparāyaprāṇātmanenamaḥ etadvayaṃsarvāṃge oṃbaṃnamaḥparāyravu ddhyātmanenamaḥ oṃphaṃnamaḥparāyaahaṃkārātmanenamaḥ oṃpaṃnamaḥparāyamanātmanenamaḥ etattrayaṃhṛdaye oṃnaṃ namaḥparāyaśavdātmanenamaḥ itimūrddhni oṃdhaṃnamaḥparāyasparśātmanenamaḥ itimukhe oṃdaṃnamaḥ parāyarūpātmanenamaḥ itihṛdaye oṃthaṃnamaḥparāyarasātmanenamaḥ ityupasthe oṃtaṃnamaḥparāyagaṃdhātmanenamaḥ itipādayo oṃṇaṃnamaḥ parāyaśrotrātmanenamaḥ śrotrayoḥ oṃḍhaṃnamaḥparāyatvagātmanenamaḥ ititvaci oṃḍaṃnamaḥparāyacakṣurātmanenamaḥ
pṛ0 28a) iticakṣuyoḥ oṃṭhaṃnamaḥparāyajihvātmanenamaḥ itijihvāyāṃ oṃṭaṃnamaḥparāyaghrāṇātmanenamaḥ itighrāṇe 3 oṃtraṃnamaḥ parāyatrāgātmanenamaḥ itivāci oṃjhaṃnamaḥparāyapāṇyātmanenamaḥ itipāṇyau oṃjaṃnamaḥparāyapāyvātmanenamaḥ itipāyau oṃchaṃnamaḥ parāyapādātmanenamaḥ itipādayo oṃcaṃnamaḥparāyupasthātmanenamaḥ ityupasthe oṃṅaṃnamaḥ parāyākāśātmanenamaḥ itimūrddhni oṃghaṃnamaḥparāyavāyvātmanenamaḥ itimukhe oṃgaṃnamaḥparāyatejātmane namaḥ itihṛdaye oṃkhaṃnamaḥ parāyasalilātmanenamaḥ itiguhye oṃkaṃnamaḥparāyapṛthivyātmanenamaḥ itipā dayoḥ 5 oṃśaṃnamaḥparāyahṛtpaṃḍarīkātmanenamaḥ oṃhaṃnamaḥparāyasomamaṃḍalātmaneṣoḍarīkalāyanamaḥoṃsaṃna kalāyanamaḥoṃsaṃnamaḥparāyasūryyamaṃḍalātmanedvādaśakalāyanamaḥoṃraṃnamaḥparāyavahvimaṃḍalātmanedaśaka lāyanamaḥ etacatuṣṭayaṃhṛdioṃṣaṃnamaḥparāyaparameṣyātmanevāsudevāyanamaḥitimūrddhni oṃyaṃnamaḥparāyapuru ṣātmanesaṃkarṣaṇāyanamaḥitimukhe oṃvaṃnamaḥparāyaviśvātmanepradyumnāyanamaḥ itihṛdi oṃlaṃnamaḥparāyanivṛ tyātmaneaniruddhāyanamaḥ itiguhye oṃkṣaṃnamaḥparāyasarvātmanenārāyaṇāyanamaḥ itipādayoḥ oṃkṣauṃnamaḥparā yakopātmanenṛsiṃhāyanamaḥ itivyāpakaṃ itiatanvasyāpyapūjyasyatatprāpterhetunāpunaḥtatvanyāsamitiprā hurnnyāsatatvavidovudhāḥyaḥkuryyāktatvavinyāsaṃsapūtobhavatidhruvaṃ tadātmanānupraviṣṭobhagavānihatiṣṭhati
pṛ0 28ba) yataḥsevatatvānisarvaṃtasminpratiṣṭhitaṃ ititatvānyāsaḥ tanmūrtipaṃjaranyāsaṃkathayiṣyedhunāparaṃ yasmātphalāṃtaraṃnāsti pusastanmūrtisiddhaye oṃaṃoṃśaṃkeśavāyadhātrenamaḥ itilalāṭe oṃāṃoṃnārāyaṇāyaayyamṇenamaḥitinābhau oṃ iṃoṃmoṃmāṃmādhavāyamitrāyanamaḥ itihṛdaye oṃiṃoṃbhaṃyaṃgoviṃdāyavaruṇāyanamaḥ itikaṃṭhe oṃuṃoṃgaṃnaṃviṣṇa veaṃśāyanamaḥ itidakṣiṇapārśve oṃūṃoṃbaṃmaṃmadhusūdanāyabhagāyanamaḥ itidakṣiṇāṃśe oṃeṃoṃtaṃrāṃtrivikra māyavivasvatenamaḥ itidakṣiṇakaṃdhare oṃaiṃoṃvāṃrāṃvāmanāyiṃdrāyanamaḥ itivāmapārśve oṃoṃoṃsuṃmāṃśrīṃ dharāyapūṣṇenamaḥ itivāmāṃśe oṃauṃoṃdeṃyaṃhṛṣīkeśāyaparjjanyāyanamaḥ itivāmakaṃdhare oṃaṃoṃvāṃnepadma nābhāyatvaṣṭrenamaḥitipṛṣṭe oṃaḥoṃyaṃmaṃdāmodarāyaviṣṇuvenamaḥ itikakudi oṃnamobhagavatevāsudevāyeti mūrddhnivinyaset iti tanmūrtipaṃjaranyāsobhihitaḥparameṣṭinā sakṛnnyāsādbhavenmaṃtrīrāmamūrtiranuttamā iti mūrtipaṃjaranyāsaḥ oṃkirīṭakeyūrahāramakarakuṃḍalacakraśaṃkhagadāṃvujahastapītāṃvaradharaśrīvatsāṃkitavakṣya- sthalaśrībhūmisahitātmajyotidvayaṃdīptikarāyasahasrādityatejasenamaḥ itimaṃtraṃsvaśarīreparatejovyāptiṃsmara nkirīṭamudrayāmūrddhivinyaset itikirīṭanyāsaḥ vakṣyehamiṃdriyanyāsamiṃdriyāṇāṃviśuddhaye yathāsaṃprāpya terāmodeśikeṃdriyadhīmatā oṃdigbhyonamaḥ itiśrotrayoḥ oṃvāyavenamaḥ ititvaci oṃādityāyanamaḥ itica
pṛ0 29a) kṣuṣoḥoṃvaruṇāyanamaḥ itijihvāyo oṃaśvibhyāṃnamaḥ itighrāṇe oṃagnayenamaḥ itivāci oṃiṃdrāyanamaḥ itipā ṇau oṃviṣṇavenamaḥ itipādayoḥ oṃmitrāyanamaḥ itipāyau oṃprajāpatayenamaḥ ityupasthe oṃcaṃdramasenamaḥ itimanasi oṃbrahmaṇenamaḥ itivuddhau oṃrudrāyanamaḥ ityaṃhaṃkāre oṃkṣetrajñāyanamaḥ iticite oṃīśvarāyanamaḥ itimanasi itīṃ driyanyāsaḥ nyāsamasyapravakṣyāmimanoḥsarvaphalapradaṃ nyāsaṃvinājapaṃprāhurāsuvaṃviphalaṃvudhāḥ ṛṣirvrahmāsyamaṃtra syagāyatraṃchaṃdamucyate śrīrāmākhyaṃvaiṣṇavaṃdhāmadevatāparikīrtitāḥādyaṃvījaṃnatiḥśaktirāmāyeticakīlakaṃ ṛ ṣirgurutvāchirasaivadhāryyaḥchaṃdokṣaratvādrasanāgataṃsyāt dhiyāvagaṃtavyatayāsadaivahṛdipratiṣṭhāmanudevatāyāḥbījaṃ suguhyaṃbhavatītiguhyenatiḥpadomādhavasaṃśritatvāt athavābījaśaktīstatstanayoḥhṛdikīlakaṃasyāyamarthaḥṛṣayebrahma ṇenamaḥitiśirasi gāyatrīchaṃdasenamaḥitimukhe śrīrāmāyaparamātmanenamaḥ itihṛdi vījātmanenamaḥitiguhye śakta yenamaḥitipādayoḥ itiṛṣyādinyāsaḥ oṃrāṃhṛdayāyanamaḥ oṃrīṃśirasesvāhā oṃruṃśikhāyaivaṣaṭ oṃraiṃkavacāyahuṃ oṃrauṃnāmikābhyāṃnamaḥ oṃrauṃkaniṣṭakābhyāṃnamaḥ oṃraḥkaratalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃnamaḥvyastaiḥṣadvarṇairvānyāsaḥ ityaṃguliṃnyā saḥhṛdayādinyāsaścaśirobhrūmadhyahṛdayanābhiguhyapadasthale mūlamaṃtrākṣarairnyāsaḥakṣaranyāsucyate ityakṣaranyāsaḥ rāṃnamaḥ itiśirasi rānamaḥitibhrūmadhye mānamaḥitihṛdaye yanamaḥitinābhau nanamaḥitiguhye manamaḥitipādayoḥ
pṛ0 29ba) itipadanyāsaḥ maṃḍūkāyanamaḥityādhārekālāgnirudrāyanamaḥ itisvādhiṣṭāne kacchapāyanamaḥ itinābhau ādhāraśakta yenamaḥ itihṛdaye dharmāyanamaḥ itidakṣiṇaskaṃdhejñānāyanamaḥ itivāmaskaṃdhe vairāgyāyanamaḥ itivāmapādamūle aiśvaryāyanamaḥ itidakṣiṇapādamūle adharmāyanamaḥ itivaktreajñānāyanamaḥ itiliṃgamūle avairāgyāyanamaḥ itidakṣiṇapārśve anaiśvaryyāyanamaḥ itivāmapārśve saptativalayopetāyasahasrakvaṇāyaanaṃtāyanamaḥ itihṛdiya kamalamadhyenyaset tanmadhyephaṇopari ānaṃdakaṃdāyanamaḥ saṃvinnālāyanamaḥ saṃvinnālāyanamaḥ sarvatatvaka malāyanamaḥ prakṛtimayapatrebhyonamaḥ vikāramayakeśarebhyonamaḥpaṃcāśadvarṇāḍhyakarṇikāyainamaḥ oṃarka maṃḍalāyadvādaśakalātmanenamaḥ śaṃsomamaṃḍalāvaṣoḍaśakalātmanenamaḥmaṃvahnimaṃḍalāyadaśakalātmanenamaḥ saṃsa tvāyapravodhātmanenamaḥ raṃrajaseprakṛtyātmanenamaḥ āṃātmanenamaḥ ititasyadakṣiṇe aṃaṃtarātmanenamaḥ ititasyāpaścime yaṃparamātmanenamaḥ ititasyuttare hnīṃjñānātmanenamaḥ ititasyapūrve madhyemāyātatvāyanamaḥ kālātatvāyanamaḥ vidyātatvā- yanamaḥparatatvāyanamaḥ ityekaikoparipraṇavādisarvamaṃtrānsanyasyaprāgādidaleṣumadhyecanavaśaktīrnyaset tathāhi vimalāyai namaḥ utkarmiṇyainamaḥ jñānāyainamaḥ kriyāyainamaḥ yogāyainamaḥ prahvyainamaḥ satyāyainamaḥ īśānāyainamaḥ anugrahāyainamaḥ oṃnamobhagavatesarvabhūtātmanevāsudevāyasarvātsasaṃyogayogapadmapīṭhātmanenamaḥ itimadhye tasminpīṭhesahasrāddhityasaṃ
pṛ0 30a) kāśaṃmaṃtraṃdhyātvāśvāsamargiṇāṃjalāvānīyavyāvakaṃnyaset itivyāpakonyāsaḥ evaṃvinyasyavidhitsākṣānnārāyaṇobhavet jvararo gābhicārādyāḥpralayaṃyāṃtinānyathā bhūtapretapiśācāścatathaivabrahmarākṣasāḥ kūṣmāṃḍāścaivaḍākinyonaivadraṣṭumapikṣamāḥyevaṃvi nyaseddhīmānrāmaḥsākṣātsvayaṃbhavet nātaḥparataraṃkiṃcitpāvanaṃpuṇyamastihi itiśrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryaśrīma tmukuṃdavanaśrīcaraṇaśiṣyānaṃdavanaviracitāyāṃrāmārcanacaṃdrikāyāṃdvitīyaḥpaṭalaḥ athadhyānaṃ ayodhyānagareramyeratnamaṃḍa pamadhyage dhyāyetkalpataromūleratnasiṃhāsanaṃśubhaṃ tanmadhyeṣṭadalaṃpadmaṃnānāratnapraveṣṭitaṃ tatraśrīrāmacaṃdrākhyaṃdhyāyete japaṃrātparaṃ prakṛtyāmītayāśyāmaṃsthityutpatikṣayāpahaṃ devāsuramunīṃdraiścayogivṛṃdaiścasevitaṃ caturbhujaṃśaṃkhacakragadāpaṃ kragadāpaṃkajadhāriṇaṃ kirīṭahārakeyūraratnakuṃḍalaśobhitaṃ devatāgurumaṃtrāṇāṃbhāvayaidaikyamātmanā gadāriśaṃkhāvja dharaṃbhavāriṃsadyodhyāyenmokṣamāpnotisarvaśruteḥ evaṃdhyātvājapenmaṃtraṃṣaṭsahasraṃdinedinai vācaḥśriyaḥpatibhūtvākavirbhavativatsa rāt ehikānakhilābhogānbhuktāvāṃtepadaṃvrajet yadvāsiṃhāsanetasminvīrāsanasamāśritaṃ satyāgjñānamayīṃmudrāṃdadhā naṃdakṣiṇekare tejaḥprakāśanaṃvāmaṃjānumūrddhanicāparaṃ jānakīvallabhaṃdevamiṃdranīlamaṇiprabhaṃ vyākhyānanitaraṃdevadvibhajaṃ raghunaṃdanaṃ basiṣṭavāmadevādimunibhiḥparisevitaṃ vāmabhāgesamāsīnāṃsītāṃkāṃcanasaṃnibhāṃ bhajanāṃkāmadāṃnityaṃ raktotpalakarāṃvujāṃlakṣmaṇaṃpaścimebhāgedhṛtachatraṃsacāmaraṃ pārśvebharataśatrughnautālavṛṃtadharāvubhau evaṃdhyātvājapenmaṃ
pṛ0 30ba) traṃjñānalakṣmyoḥsabhājanaṃjapatāṃmaṃtriṇāṃmevaṃdhyānayogenadhīmatāṃ puraścaraṇakṛtyenavināpiphaladomanuḥ iti vakṣamāṇemahāca krekarṇikāyāṃniraṃjanaṃ sarvesaṃvyāpyasakalaṃsarpidānaṃdavigrahaṃ catuṣpādvrahmaṇorūpaṃrāmasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥsevaṃteyoginonityaṃso haṃbhāvesiddhayaḥ tathācaśrutiḥ athaiteślokābhavaṃti akārākṣarasaṃbhūtaḥ saumitriviṃśvavarddhanaḥ ukārākṣarasaṃbhūtaḥśatrughnastai jasātmakaḥ prajñātmakastubhūratomakārākṣarasaṃbhavaḥ arddhamātrātmakorāmo brahmānedaikavigrahaḥ śrīrāmasānvidhyavaśājjagadā naṃdakāriṇā utpatisthitisaṃhārakāriṇīsarvadehināṃ sāsītābhavatijñeyāmūlaprakṛtisaṃjñitā praṇavatvātprakṛtiriti vadaṃtibrahmavādititi oṃmityetadakṣaramidaṃsarvaṃtasyopakhyānaṃbhūtaṃbhavadbhaviṣyaditi sarvamoṃkārevayaccānyatikālā- tīṃtaṃtadayyoṃkārevasarvaṃhyetadvrahmāyamātmābrahmasoyamātmācatuṣpājjājjāgaritasthāṇovahiḥprajñaḥsaptāṃgeko naviṃśatimukhaḥsthūlabhūgvaiśvānaraṣprathamaḥpādaḥsvapnasthānāṃtaḥprajñaḥsaptāṃgekonaviṃśatimukhaḥpraviviktabhuktaijaso dvitīyaḥpādaḥnayasuptonakaṃcanakāmaṃkāmayate nakaṃcanasvapnaṃpaśyatitatsuṣuptaṃsuṣuptasthānekībhūtaḥprajñānadghanevānaṃ damayohyanaṃdabhuṣketomukhaḥprājñastṛtīyaḥpādaḥeṣaḥsarveśvareṣaḥsarvajñeṣoṃtaryyāmyeṣayoniḥsarvasyabhavāṣyayauhibhū tānāṃnāṃtaḥprajñaṃnavahiḥprajñaṃnobhayataḥ prajñaṃnaprajñaṃnāprajñaṃnaprajñānayanamadṛṣṭamavyavahāryyamagrāhyamalakṣaṇamaciṃtya mavyapadeśyamaikātmyapratyayagamyaiprapaṃcopaśamaṃśivamadvaitaṃcaturthemanyaṃtemātmāvijñeyaḥsadojvalovidyātatkāryya

pṛ0 32a) paramīkaraṇaṃnāmamudreyaṃsarvakāmadā devasyamūrddhnitatsiṃvetpūjādravyeṣucātmanaḥ avekṣaṇaṃprokṣaṇaṃvavīkṣaṇaṃtāḍanaṃtathā arcanaṃpaivasarveṣāṃpāvanatvaṃprakalpayet pūtamevākhilaṃpūjāyogyaṃbhavatisārthakaṃ itiśaṃkhapratiṣṭhā pātrāṇitāmrahe- mādinirmitānijalāṃtare jalatānivicitrāṇibhavaṃtihyarhaṇādiṣu arghyapātrapradānārthaṃmadhuparkārthamayyatha tathā camanārthaṃcanyasetpātracatuṣṭayaṃ ātmanaḥpunatuḥśaṃkhaṃpūrvataḥsādhayetataḥ arghyapādyādipātreṣusaṃpūryyasalilaṃśubhaṃ ta trārghyapātredātavyāgaṃdhapuṣpayavākṣatāḥ kuśāgratiladūrvāścaśarṣapāścāryyasiddhaye pādyapātrepidātavyaṃśyāmākaṃpūrva mevaca arjavaviṣṇukrāṃtācapādyasiddhyaiḥprayojayet tathācamanapātrepidadyājjātīphalaṃmune lavaṃgamapikakolaṃśa stumācamanīyakaṃ daghnācamadhusarpibhyāṃmadhuparkobhaviṣyati ekasmikathavāpātrepādyārghyadīnikalpayet sarvo- pacāravastunāmalābhebhāvanaivahi nirmalenodakenaivapūrṇatetyāhatāradaḥ itipātrāsādanaṃ pātrāṇicaivamāsādya tatoṃtaryyāgamārabhet tathāhi dharmakaṃdasamudbhūtaṃjñānanālaṃsuśobhanaṃ aiśvaryyāṣṭadalaṃpadmaṃparaṃvairāgyakarṇikaṃ tasmi- npīṭhecidātmānaṃrāghavaṃsvasvarūpiṇaṃ dhyātvāyajeccaṃdanādyaimāṃniśairddhapadīpakaiḥbhojanāvamarekiṃcijjapaṃkṛtvānivedaye t guhyātiguhyagoptātvaṃgṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃjapaṃ sirddhirbhavatumedevatvatpraśādātvayisthiteti svādhiṣṭhānagatekuṃḍe trikoṇevahnimujvalet cidrūpaṃpraṇavenāthatatrahaṃtādikaṃhunet pūjāhomādikaṃdevakṛtaṃyatvadalugrahāt tenaprī
pṛ0 32ba) tobhavatvaṃbhoḥśuddhaṃmemānasaṃkuruḥniveṃdayāmicātmānatvaṃgatiḥparameśvara śvāsamārgagataṃtejityuktvātmānamarppayet tanmayasaccidānaṃdobhūtvātiṣṭetkiyatkṣayaṃ ityaṃtaryyagaḥmānasaiḥ kusumairarcāsātvikīsāśubhāmatā anirmālyā parāśuddhāmokṣadāsiddhidāśubhā tasmātsarvaprayatnenamānasayajanaṃdhuvaṃ ādaucaivaprakartavyaṃpaścādravyaiḥsuvistarai athā tmānaṃcinmayaṃcapṛthakkṛtaigaṃdhādibhiḥ oṃātmatatvāyanamaḥ oṃkalātatvāyanamaḥ oṃvidyātatvāyanamaḥ oṃśrīrāmata tvāyanamaḥ ityabhyarvyavahirthyāgaṃkuryyāt ādaulikhedyaṃtrarājaṃraghunaṃdanavigrahaṃ kāmakrodhādidoṣāṃtthadīrghaduḥkhani yaṃtraṇāt yaṃtramityāhuretasminrāmaḥprīṇātipūjitaḥ yaṃtraṃmaṃtramayaṃproktaṃmaṃtrātmādevatetica dehātmanoyathābhedo maṃtradevatayostathā tasmātpīṭheyaṃtrarājaṃlikhitvātatrapūjayet sauvarṇerājatetāmrepaṭhabhūrjethavābhuvi vināyaṃtre ṇavetpūjādevatānaprasīdati śrīrāmaḥpūjitoyaṃtresītayāsahayaṃtritaḥ yadiṣṭaṃtatkarotyevatattanmaṃtravarādṛte tāpa nīyopaniṣadiśrutyuktaṃyaṃtranāyakaṃ uvyatekāmadaṃnṛṇāṃmokṣadaṃdhāraṇādapi trirekhāpuṭamālikhyamadhyetāradvayaṃ likhet tanmadhyevījamālikhyatadadhaḥsādhyamālikhet dvitīyāṃtaṃcatasyorddhaṣaṣṭāntaṃtathā kurudvayaṃcata tpārśvelikhedvījāṃtareramāṃ tatsarvaṃpraṇavābhyāṃcaveṣṭayechucivuddhimān dīrghabhājiṣaḍasreṣulikhedvījaṃhṛdādibhiḥ koṇapārśveramāyāyetadagrenaṃgamālikhet krodhaṃkoṇāṃgāṃtareṣulikhyamaṃtrabhitvogiraṃ vṛttatrayaṃsāṣṭapatraṃsarojaṃ
pṛ0 33a) vilikhetsvarān keśarecāṣṭapatrevargāṣṭakamathālikhet teṣunārāyaṇāṣṭārṇaṃlikhetatkeśareramāṃ tadvahirdvādaśadalaṃvili kheddvādaśākṣaraṃ tathānamobhagavatevāsudevāyityayaṃ ādikṣāṃtānkeśareṣuvṛttākāreṇasaṃlikhet tadvahiḥṣoḍaśadalaṃlikhe tatkeśareśriyaṃ varmāstranatisaṃyuktaṃdaleṣudvādaśākṣaraṃ tatsaṃdhiṣṭirañjādīnāṃmaṃtrīsamālikhet hṛṃsṛṃbhṛṃnṛṃḷṃaṃjṛṃścali khetsamyaktatodvātriṃśāraṃmahāpadmenādaviṃdusamāyutaṃ vilikhenmaṃtrarājārṇānteṣupatreṣuyatnataḥ tatracānuṣṭubhaṃ ragho'itivāpāṭhaḥ śrutyanuktamapigrāhyaṃyadetatsāṃpradāyakaṃ dhyāyedaṣṭavasūtekādaśarudrāṃścatatravai dvādaśākāṃśca dhāttāraṃvaṣaṭkāraṃcatadvahibhūgṛhaṃvajraśūlāṃḍhyaṃreravātrayasamanvitaṃ dvāropetaṃrāśyādibhūṣinaṃphaṇisaṃyutaṃ anaṃtovā sukīścaivatakṣakaḥkolapadmakāḥmahāpadmastathāśaṃkhaḥpulikoṣṭaukulānica anaṃtakulikauviprauvahnivarṇāvu dāhṛtau pratyekaṃtusahasreṇaphaṇānāṃsamalaṃkṛtau vāsukiḥśaṃkhapālaścakṣatriyaupītavarṇakau pratyekaṃtuphaṇā saptaśatasaṃkhyāvirājitau takṣakaścamahāpadmauvaiśyāvetāvahīsmṛtau nīlavarṇauphaṇāṃpaṃcaśatatuṃgottamāṃmakau padmakarkoṭakausūdrauphaṇātriṃśatakausitau evaṃmaṃḍalamālikhyatasyadikṣuvidikṣuca nārasiṃhaṃvarāhaṃcalikhe- nmaṃtradvayaṃtathā idaṃsarvātmakaṃyaṃtraṃprāguktamṛṣisevitaṃ idaṃrahasyaṃparamamīśvareṇāpidurgamaṃ evaṃyaṃtraṃsamākhyātaṃnade yaṃprākṛtetane gurudarśinamārgeṇasavuddhyānaivataṃlikhet gurvanuktāḥkriyāḥsarvāniḥphalāḥsyuryatodhruvaṃ rāma
pṛ0 33ba) pūrvantāpanīyaṃṭīkāyāṃyaṃtranāyakaḥprapaṃcitoyathāsmābhirdraṣṭavyasiddhikāṃkṣibhiḥ itipūrvarāmatāpanīyoṣaniṣadyuktoyaṃyaṃtrarājo ddhāraḥ asminpūjāmahācakrerāghavasyādhunocyate pīṭhaṃtatpūjayetvādausevakramucyate svevāmabhāgeśrīgurubhyonamaḥ para magurubhyonamaḥ parāparagurubhyonamaḥ parātparagurubhyonamaḥ ityabhyarcya svadakṣiṇabhāgegaṃgaṇapatayenamaḥ saṃsara svatyainamaḥ duṃdurgāyainamaḥ kṣaṃkṣetrapālāyanamaḥ ityabhyarcya tatovāstupuruṣāyanamaḥ itiyāgagṛhamadhye oṃmaṃmadbhakā yanamaḥ itipīṭhamadhye kālāgnirudrāyanamaḥ krūrmāyanamaḥ ādhāraśaktyainamaḥ ityupariuparyyabhyarcya oṃratnadvīpāyanamaḥ oṃratnamaṃḍapāyanamaḥ oṃkalpavṛkṣebhyonamaḥ oṃratnavedikāyainamaḥ oṃratnasiṃhāsanāyanamaḥ ityabhyarcya agnyādipīṭha- pādeṣudharmādīścaturoyajet pīṭhagātreṣupūrvādiadharmādīṃstathaivaca karṇikāyāṃtathānaṃdakaṃnānaroruhaṃ patrāṇikeśa roścaivakarṇikāṃcatathāyajet tārārkeṃdvaranparṇaṃpūrvamakīgnīṃdutrimaṃḍalaṃ guṇatrayaṃcasatvāditataścātmacatuṣṭayaṃ māyātatvaṃkā latatvaṃvidyātatvaṃparaṃtathā ekaikoparisaṃpūjyatataḥśaktīryajennava vimalotkaṣiṇījñānākriyāyogācapaṃcamīprahvīsatyā tatheśānānugrahānavamīparā pūrvādyaṣṭasupatreṣukarṇikāyāṃyajetbhramāt catuthyānamasāyuktaiḥsvaisvairevacanāmataḥkarṇi kāyāṃyajetpaścātpīṭhamaṃtreṇamaṃtravit praṇabaṃpūrvamuccāryyanamaśavdaṃtatovadet bhagavatepadamābhāṣyaviṣṇuvetipadaṃvadet sarvabhūtātmanecetivāsudevāyitpati tataḥsarvātmasaṃyogayogapīṭhātmanenamaḥ mūlayuktenacānenadadyātpuṣpāṃjaliṃpunaḥ

pṛ0 34ba) dhyamā 10 aṣṭāṃmuṣṭadvayāṃnmadhyetatvāpiparitaṣkarau maṃḍalīkaraṇaṃsamyagagaṃgulīnāṃtapodhana padmamudrābhavedeṣā 11 dhenumudrāta taḥparaṃ anāmikekaniṣṭhābhyāṃtarjanībhyāṃcamadhyame anyonyābhimukhāśliṣṭe 12 tataḥkaustubhasaṃjñakāḥkaniṣṭenyonyasaṃ- lagnebhimukhepiparasparaṃ vāmasyatarjanīmadhyemadhyamānāmikayorapi vāmānāmikasaṃspṛṣṭatarjanīmadhyaśobhitā paryyāyeṇanatāṃguṣṭadvayīkaustuṃbhalakṣaṇā 13 kaniṣṭhānyonyasaṃlagnāviparītaṃviyojitā adhastātprāpitāṃguṣṭhāmu drāgāruḍasaṃjñakā 14 tarjanyaṃguṣṭhamadhyasthāmadhyamānāmikādvayī kaniṣṭhānāmikāmadhyātarjanyagrakaradvayī mune śrīvatsumudreyaṃ 15 vanamālābhavetataḥkaniṣṭhānāmikāmadhyāmuṣṭirunnatatarjjanī paribhrāṃtāśirasyuccaistarjjanībhyāṃ divaukasaḥ 16 mudrāyoniḥsamākhyātādyotatkaradvayīritā tarjjanyāṃguṣṭhamabhyāṃtasthitānāmikayugmakā madhyamūlā sthitauguṣṭhāgeyaṃśastārcane 17 itimudrālakṣaṇaṃ śāligrāmesthārverevāvāhanaṃnavisarjanaṃ śāligrāmaśilādautunityaṃ sannihatohariḥ mulamuccāryyatathārāmayaṃtrīcasāyudhāyasavāhanāyasaparivārāyasvaśaktiyuktāyapuṣpāṃjaliṃparikalpayā minamaḥ itipratipuṣpāṃjaliṃpādyādupacāreṣusarvetradadyāt ādaupuṣpāṃdatvāpādārcanamataḥparaṃ pādyamarghyetvācamanaṃmadhuparkaṃ yathocitaṃ abhyaṃdvartanedatvāmahāsnānaṃsamācaret abhiṣekāṃgavastraṃcadatvātīrājayeddhariṃ snānaṃpuruṣasukteneśuddha śaṃkhodakenaca kṣīradadhyājyamadhubhiḥkhaṃḍenacapṛthakpṛthak nālikerodakenāpitathātālaphalāṃvunā gaṃdhadravyai
pṛ0 35a) ścabahubhistathāgaṃdhodakenaca aiṃkavenodakenāpikarpūrādisugaṃdhinā kadalīpanasāmrotthajalenāpisugaṃdhinā śataṃsa hasramayutaṃśaktyāvāpyabhiṣivayet śaṃkhaṃsaṃpūryyatenaivasapuṣpeṇarathūttamaṃ sakṛṣṇāgurudhūpenadhūpadyannaṃtarāṃtarā tataḥśuddha jalenaivasnāpayetamananyadhīḥrājyārthīrājyasiddhyarthaṃnityaṃvatsaramādarāt evamevābhiṣicyaivarājābhavatinānyathā datvā pyācamanīyaṃcavāsasīparidhāpayet dadyādācamanaṃbhūyautaryyaṃsaupavītakaṃ pīṭhamānīyasaṃsthāpyapādukāmudrayāha riṃ bhūṣaṇairbhūṣayedyogyaṃtulasīdalasaṃśritaṃ mūlenāthārpayedgaṃdhaṃpuṣpāṃjalpaṣṭakaṃtataḥvāmabhāgesasīnāṃsītāṃkāṃ- canasaṃnibhāṃ śrīṃsītāyaisvāhetimaṃtreṇābhyarcyayeccatāṃ tatodakṣiṇakoṇāgreśakhāyāṃlakṣaṇaṃyajet oṃlaṃlakṣmaṇāya namastatmaṃtreṇatrikoṇake evaṃtrikoṇarūpaṃsyāditiśrutiḥvāmapārśvetrikoṇasyaśārṅgedakṣiṇakeśarāt oṃśaṃ śarṅgāyanamaḥoṃśaṃśarebhyonamostvitipūjānujñāṃtatolavdhvāvahiraṃgātathoyajet itipradhānapūjā oṃrāṃhṛdayāyana0 oṃrīṃśirasesvāhā oṃrūṃśikhāyainamaḥ oṃraiṃkavacāyanamaḥ oṃrauṃnetratrayāyanamaḥoṃraḥastrāyanamaḥṣaṭkoṇeprathamā vṛttiḥsyādaṃgairhṛdayādidhiḥvaradābhayadhāriṇyovadbhyāśārabhyapūjayet hāraiṃduśyāmanīlābhāḥkṛṣṇāsasyahavistriyaḥ tatauhastauprakṣālyarāmāyagaṃdhaṃdatvāpuṣpāṃjaliṃdakṣiṇahastāṃguṣṭhatarjanīmadhyamāṃgulibhirgṛhītvāmadhyeśaṃkho dakaṃca dayācetyāhisaṃsārasarpyānmāṃśaraṇārthiṃnaṃ bhaktyāsamarpayetvāhamāghamāvaraṇārcanaṃ ityuccāryyatajjalaṃtya-
pṛ0 35ba) ktvāpuṣpāṃjaliṃsamarpayet hastaprakṣālanaṃkṛtvādvitīyāvaraṇārcanaṃ caturthāvaraṇārvanaṃ paṃcamāvaraṇārcanaṃ ṣaṣṭaṃcāvaraṇārcanaṃ sapta māvaraṇārcanaṃ aṣṭamāvaraṇārcanaṃ navamāvaraṇārvanaṃ daśamāvaraṇārcanaṃ ityāvaraṇaṃkuryāt śaṃkhādyaikaikamudrādarśanaṃceti itiprathamāvaraṇārcanaṃ oṃāṃātmanenamaḥ oṃniṃnivṛtyainamaḥ oṃaṃaṃtarātmanenamaḥ oṃpraḥpratiṣṭhāyainamaḥ oṃpaḥparamā tmanenamaḥ oṃviṃvidyāyainamaḥ oṃjñāṃjñānātmanenamaḥ oṃśāṃśāṃtyainamaḥ dvitīyātmādikedevairaṣṭāvjamūlaketathā ya thārāmastathaivaiteśaktayaścakarāṃvujāḥ itidvitīyaṃ oṃvāṃvāsudevāyanamaḥ oṃśrīṃśriyainamaḥoṃśaṃsaṃkarṣaṇāyana0 oṃśāṃśāṃtyainamaḥ oṃpraṃpradyumnāyanamaḥ oṃprīṃprītyainamaḥ oṃaṃaniruddhāyanamaḥ oṃraṃratyainamaḥ tṛtīyāvāsudevādyai raṣṭapatretathaivaca capagaśadharastvādyarāmaḥśarāpacasmṛtaḥ pradyumnaḥpacaśagavānśacapagaśraścaturthakaḥ dakṣiṇyādhaḥ karāhveryaṣkramāyevyaḥkarāṃvujāḥsphaṭikasvarṇedūrveṃdranīlābhāstridaśāḥkramāt svarṇāṣṭapadmakiṃjalkaśyāmalāstā yādayaḥ ititṛtīyaṃ oṃhaṃhanumatenamaḥ oṃsuṃsugrīvāyanamaḥ oṃbhaṃbharatāyanamaḥ oṃviṃvibhīṣaṇāyanamaḥ laṃlakṣma ṇāyanamaḥ oṃaṃaṃgadāyanamaḥ oṃśaṃśatrughnāyanamaḥ oṃjāṃjāvavaṃtāyanamaḥ caturthīvāyuputrādyaiḥpatrāgrepūrvataḥkra māt devāgresvasvacāpāgreprācīukāvicakṣaṇaiḥ prācīvaprācīcoddiṣṭāmuktvātudevapūjanaṃ svarṇābhaunīlabhaukramā t vācayaṃtahanūmaṃtaṃdevasyāgresupustakaṃramyaubharataśatrughnaupārśvayordhṛtacāmarau dhṛtātupatraṃsaumitriṃkṛtāṃjalipu
pṛ0 36a) ṭānparān priyatvātpunarlakṣmaṇagrahaṇaṃ sahasraphaṇātapatradharaḥśeṣeva lakṣmaṇaśavdenapunarucyatityarthaḥ oṃsṛṃsṛṣṭayenamaḥ oṃnaṃjayaṃtāyanamaḥ oṃviṃvijayānamaḥ oṃsauṃsaurāṣṭrāyanamaḥ oṃrāṃrāṣṭravardhanāyanamaḥ oṃaṃakopāyanamaḥ oṃdhaṃdharmā pālāyanamaḥ oṃsuṃsumaṃtāyanamaḥ sṛṣṭyādimaṃtriṇaḥpūrvadiṣkrameṇakṛtāṃjalīn anvīkṣikīmaṃtrayatodvitīyāṣṭada lervayet itipaṃcamaṃ oṃvaṃvaśiṣṭāyanamaḥ oṃvāṃvāmadevāyanamaḥ oṃjāṃjāvālayenamaḥoṃgauṃgautamāyanamaḥoṃbhaṃbhara dvājāyanamaḥoṃkaukaumikāyanamaḥoṃvāṃvālmīkayenamaḥoṃnāṃnāradāyanamaḥoṃsaṃsanakāyanamaḥoṃsaṃsanaṃda nāyanamaḥ oṃsaṃsanānanāyanamaḥ oṃsaṃsanatkumārāyanamaḥ kamaṃḍaludharānsarvānmaṃtramuccaratomunīn dvādaśāvjervaye tpūrvarikkrameṇacatanyarān itiṣaṣṭaṃ oṃnīṃnīlāyanamaḥ oṃnaṃnalāyanamaḥ oṃsuṃsuṣeṇāyanamaḥ oṃmaiṃmaiṃdāyanamaḥ oṃ saṃmaṃrabhāyanamaḥ oṃdviṃdvividāyanamaḥ oṃcaṃcaṃdanāyanamaḥ oṃgaṃgavākṣāyanamaḥ oṃkiṃkīrīṭāyanamaḥ oṃkuṃkuṃḍalā yanamaḥ oṃśrīṃśrīvatsāyanamaḥ oṃkauṃkaustubhāyanamaḥ oṃpaṃpadmāyanamaḥ oṃṣoḍaśāvjercayetpūrvadikrameṇakṛtāṃjalī n itisaptamaṃ oṃdhuṃdhruvāyanamaḥ oṃdhaṃdharāyanamaḥ oṃsauṃsomāyanamaḥ oṃaṃapāyanamaḥ oṃaṃanilāyanamaḥ oṃaṃa nalāpanamaḥ oṃpraṃpratyūṣāyanamaḥ oṃpraṃprabhāsāyanamaḥ oṃvīṃvīrabhadrāyanamaḥ oṃśaṃśaṃbhavenamaḥ oṃgiṃgiriśāyanamaḥ oṃsraṃstrajaikapadenamaḥ oṃstraṃahirvudhnyāyanamaḥ oṃkaṃkapālinenamaḥ oṃdiṃdikpatayenamaḥ oṃsthāṃsthāṇvenamaḥ oṃbhaṃ
pṛ0 36ba) bhargāyanamaḥ oṃvaṃvaruṇāyanamaḥ oṃsūṃsūryyāyanamaḥ oṃveṃvedāyanamaḥ oṃbhāṃbhānavenamaḥ oṃiṃindrāyanamaḥ oṃriṃravayenamaḥ oṃgaṃ gabhatsinenamaḥ oṃyaṃyamāyanamaḥ oṃhiṃhiraṇyaretasenamaḥ oṃdiṃdivākarāyanamaḥ oṃmiṃmitrāyanamaḥ oṃviṃviṣṇuvenamaḥ oṃdhāṃdhātrenamaḥ dhruvādyairaṣṭamāṃvṛtirdvātriṃśadvaśapatrake dhruvodharaścasomaścāpaścaivānilonalaḥ pratyūṣaścaprabhāsaśca vasavoṣṭauprakīrttitāḥ śūlaṃkhaḍgaṃtathātakraṃpadiśaṃkamalaṃchuriṃ kodaṃḍaṃmudgaraṃcaivavasūnāmāyudhaṣkramaḥ vīrabhadraścaśaṃ bhuścagirīśaścamahāpaśāḥ ajaikapādadirvudhnyaḥpinākīcāparājitaḥ bhuvanādhīśvaraścaivakapālīcadiśāṃpatiḥ sthāṇurbhagaścabhaṃgavānrudrāścaikādaśasmṛtāḥsallarkamararaṃśūlaṃśikharaṃyamadaṃṣṭrakaṃkṛṣṇāhikaṃpinākaṃcaa- ghorāstraṃtathāṃkuśaṃ khaṭvāṃgaṃcasthāṇuparaṃśaktihetidharāstathā rudrāṃyudhānicaināniproktavānkramataḥśivaḥvaruṇaḥ sūryavedāṃgaubhānuriṃdroravistathā gabhastistuyamaḥsvarṇaretaścāthadivākaraḥ mitroviṣṇuritiproktāādityāditaḥkra māt pāśaṃtumudgaraṃśaṃṣaṃśalyaṃśrṛṃgaṃkṛpāṇakaṃ gadāṃdaṃḍaṃvajramabjaṃtathāsarppaṃsudarśanaṃ ādityānāṃdvādaśānāmāyudhā nividuḥkramāt ityuṣṭamaṃ oṃlamiṃdrāyasurādhipatayesāyudhāyasavāhanāyasaparivārāyasvaśaktiyuktāyanamaḥ oṃraṃagnayetejodhipatayenamaḥ oṃyaṃyamāyapretādhipatayenamaḥ oṃkṣaṃniṛtayetejodhipatayenamaḥ oṃvaṃvaruṇāyaja- lādhipatayenamaḥ oṃyaṃvāyaveprāṇādhipatayenamaḥ oṃsaṃsomāyanakṣatrādhipatayenamaḥ oṃhaṃīśānāyavidyādhipataye
pṛ0 37a) itipūrvādyaṣṭadikṣu oṃāṃbrahmaṇelokādhipatayenamaḥ itipūrveśānayormadhye oṃhrīṃviṣṇuvebhūtādhipatayenamaḥ itinaiṛtya paścimayormadhye iṃdrāyairbhūgṛhecādyenavamāvaraṇaṃbhavet itinavamaṃ oṃvaṃjrāṃyanamaḥ oṃśaktayenamaḥ oṃdaṃḍāyanamaḥ oṃkhaṅgāyanamaḥ oṃpāśāyanamaḥ oṃaṃkuśāyanamaḥ oṃgadāyainamaḥ oṃtriśūlāyanamaḥ oṃaṃvajāyanamaḥ oṃvakrāyanamaḥdvitīyebhūgṛhercayet itidaśam ṣaṭkoṇeprathamāvṛtistthādaṃgairagnitaḥkramāt dvitīyātmādikerdevairaṣṭāvjamūlaketathā tṛtīyāvāsudevādyaira ṣṭapatretathaivaca caturthīṃvāyuputrādyaipatrāgnepūrvataḥkramāt sṛṣṭyādyaiḥpaṃcamāvṛtirdvitīyāṣṭadaletathā ṣaṣṭīṃdvādaśapatreṣuva siṣṭādyaiḥsaptamī ṣoḍaśāvjesyānnīlādyaiḥkapiṃyugavaiḥdhruvādyairaṣṭamījñeyādvātriṃśadachapatrakeiṃdrādyairbhūgṛhevāhyenavamā varaṇaṃbhavet tadastrairvajramukhyādyairdaśamāvaraṇaṃśubhaṃ daśāvaraṇapūjeyaṃkarbhavyāsādhakottamai ārādhanāsamarthaścedadyā darcanasādhanaṃ yodāṃtunaivaśaknotikuryyādarcanadarśanaṃ nistārāpatadevālaṃbhavādhvermunisattamaḥnaikaṃcayasyavidyaitasodhoyā tyevanānyathā yastubhaktyāprayatnenasvayaṃsaṃpādyacākhilaṃ sādhanaṃcāryayedvidvānsassamagraphalaṃbhavet oṃśrīrāmapārṣadebhyo namatṛtīyebhūgṛhe tatovahirnnāgebhyaḥpuṣpāṃjaliṃdatvāsaparivārāyabhagavatedhūpādyapacārānkalpayet ityāvaraṇapūjā tataḥsamarppayedvayaṃghaṃṭāvādyajayassvanaiḥdhūpasthānaṃsamabhyarcyatarjjanyāvā sahiṇe vanaspatirasotpannogaṃdhāḍhyogaṃdha uttamaḥāśreṃyaḥsarvadevānāṃdhūpoyaṃpratigṛhyatāṃ saṃkalpye vaṃtataḥpuṣpāṃjaliṃdatvāṃyaśaḥpaṭhet tathāca pariśiṣṭe dhūpa
pṛ0 37ba) syavyajanenaivadhūpenāṃgaṃvidhūpayet nīrājaneṣusarveṣuviṣṇornāmānikīrttayet japayoṣaṃprakurvītakalyāṇaṃcābhikīrtayet tathāmaṃgaladyoṣuṃcajagadvījasyacastutimiti vāmekodaṃḍadaṃḍaṃnijakarakamaledakṣiṇevāṇamekaṃpaścādbhāgeca nityaṃdadhatamabhimataṃsāsitūṇīrabhāraṃvāmevāmelasadbhyāṃsahamilitatanuṃjānakīlakṣmaṇābhyāṃśyāmaṃrāmaṃbhaje traṇatajanamanaḥkhedavikṣedadarkṣajayanārasiṃhetyādi ghṛtāktaṃgugguluṃyasturāghavāyanivedayet nabhayaṃvidyatetasya janmamṛtyujarādikaṃ itidhūpaṃ ārārtikaṃtuviṣamaṃvahuvartisamanvitaṃ abhyarcyarāmacaṃdrāyavāmamadhyamayārppayet suprakāśomahādīpassarvatastimirāpahaḥ abhyarcyabharāmacaṃdrāyavāmamadhyamayārpayet suprakāśomahāndīpaḥ sarvatastimirāpahaḥ savāhyābhyaṃtarejyotirdīpoyaṃpratigṛhyatāṃ iti namodīpośvarāyetidadyātpuṣpāṃjaliṃtataḥa vadhūpyābhyarcyavādyairmūrddhninīrājayetprabhuṃdhyāyerājānuvāhuṃdhṛtaśaraṃdhanubaṃvaddhapadmāṃsanatthaṃpītaṃvāsovasānaṃnavaka maladalaṃsyarddhinetraṃprasannaṃ vābhāgārūḍhasītāmukhakamalamilallocanaṃnīradābhaṃnānālaṃkāradīptaṃdadhanamurujaṭā maṃḍalaṃrāmabhadraṃ śrīrāmajapetyādipaṭhet hairaṇyaṃjanaṃtāmraṃkāṃśyaṃpālāśapatrakaṃ naivedyāyābjapatraṃvāpātraṃviṣṇo i tipriyaṃ bhakṣyaṃbhojyaṃlehyacoṣyeṣeyamannaṃguṇānvitaṃ dadyāchīharayenityaṃlabhetpuṇyamanaṃtakaṃ prakṣipyatulasīṃ prokṣyasaptakṛtvābhimaṃtrayet pradarśyadhenucakrāstraṃvāmāṃguṣṭhenasaṃspṛśan pānīpaṃcāmṛtīkṛtyapareśāpaniveda
pṛ0 38a) yet śālībhaktaṃsubhaṃktāṃśaśikarasitarukyāyasāśyasūpaṃlehyaṃyeyaṃsucoṣyaṃsitamamṛtaphalaṃparikādyaṃsukhādyaṃ ā jyaṃprājyaṃsamījyaṃprājyaṃnayanarucikaraṃrājikailāmarīcaḥsvādīpaḥśākarājīparikaramamatāhārajñoṣaṃjuṣasveti nivedanamaṃtraḥ brāhmeśādyaipariturubhiḥsūpaviṣṭaissamenolakṣmyāsijidvalayakarayāsādaraṃvījyamānaḥ narmmakrīḍā prahasanamukhairhāsayanpaṃktimonkṛnbhaṃktepātrepavitrekanakasuṣuṭiteṣaḍrasaṃśrīrameśaḥ yaścintāratnakāmadramavibhavabhu vāmaṃḍanamaṃḍanānāṃsarvāsāṃpastrijagatijagatāmaṃgalānāṃ haimāmatrasthadarvādadhimadhulavaṇairdṛṣṭimutāryyacāyyainī rājyorāmacaṃdrodinakarakarugratnadīpāvalībhiḥ lakṣmīnārāyaṇagoviṃdadevetyādipaṭhet paścādyathāśaktijapaṃvidhā ya guhyātiguhyetiharayenivedya gajāsyādityapaṃcāsyaśaktisiṃhāsyarūpavān samatkṛtenasarvātmārāmaṣprīṇātuci dvayuḥkuṃḍeyathāvadvihitesumṛṣṭesaṃsthāpyavahniṃjuhuyādavaśyaṃ itinaivedyāṃtopacārāḥ vidhivadvihitekuṃḍesthaṃḍilecatu rasrake āvahanīyagārhyaṃvālaukikaṃcāgnimujvalam ānīyāstreṇanaiṛtyekravyādāṃrāṃparityajet devāṃśaṃmūla maṃtreṇasthāpayetpuranaḥagnyādhānābhidhaṃkarmanityahomenavidyate vīkṣaṇaṃmūlamaṃtreṇaśareṇaprokṣaṇaṃmataṃ tebhavetā ḍanaṃdarbhervvarmmṇābhyukṣaṇaṃsmṛtaṃ anvādhāyāthaparyyakṣyaparistīryyayathāvidhi prāṇānāyamyalakṣmīśaṃsāṃgasāyudhama vyayaṃ siddhānnadravyatoyakṣyeitisaṃkalpyavāgyataḥ nyāsaṃkṛtvāpraṇītāṃvuprokṣayenmūlamaṃtrataḥ pavitrotpavanāntatuku
