pṛ0 42ba) svānnaṃsaptābhimāṃtritaṃ tejasvīsvabhagaḥśrīmānarogāyuścajāyate annaṃbrahmarasoviṣṇurbhoktadevomaheśvaraḥevaṃjñātvātuyo bhuṃktesonnadoṣernalipyate aṃtaścarasibhūteṣuguhāyāṃviśvatomukhaḥ tvaṃyajñastvaṃvaṣaṭkārastvaṃviṣṇoḥparamaṃpadaṃ tva yopayuktaḥsragāṃdhavāsolaṃkāracarcitāḥ uchiṣṭabhojinodāsāstavamāyāṃjayemahi japannevaṃbhagavataḥśrītī rthaṃtulasīyutaṃ amṛtoyastaraṇamasītyagnataḥprāśayedvudhaḥmadhyeṃdravaruṇaśaśiyamadiggatātihṛdikuṃḍalāni anvāhāryyāhavanīyagārhaspatyasabhyāvasathyāni oṃgārhayatyeprāṇāyasvāhetihiraṇyāyātuhvāprāṇāgniho traṃsyādanāmāṃguṣṭataḥkramāt anvāhāryyaitvapānāyasvāhetirāganastvacā kaniṣṭāṃguṣṭayugmenadvitīyāmāhutiṃ hunet vyānāyāhavanīyegnauraktayācasruvāsudhīḥ madhyamāṃguṣṭayugmenatṛtīyāmāhutiṃhunet sabhyetūṭānasaṃ jñāyakṛṣṇavarṇāśrucātathā tarjanyaṃguṣṭayugmenacaturthīmāhutiṃhunet āvasathyesamānāyasuprabhāvarṇayāśruca juhuyādaṃgulībhistusavībhiḥpaṃcamāhutiṃ naivedyaśeṣaṃtulasīvimiśritaṃviśeṣataḥ pādajalenaviṣṇoḥyośnā tinityaṃpurāreḥprāpnotiyajñāyutapuṇyakoṭiḥpratiṣiddhaṃnacāśnīyātpavitramayināghṛtaṃ tathācaskaṃde saṃdhyayoru bhayorjāpyebhojamedāṃdhānai pitṛkāryeṣudevecatathāmūtrapurīṣayoḥgurūṇāṃsannidhaudānestānecaiṣaviśeṣataḥe ṣubhaunaṃsamātiṣṭansvargaṃprāpnotimānavaḥhastāvṛteṃvunānyenanāśnanpātrāvṛtepicet dakṣiṇaṃtuparityajyavāmenī
pṛ0 43a) raṃnidhāpayet abhojyaṃtadbhavedamnaṃyānīyaṃcasurāsaptaṃ tṛptodadyādannaśeṣaṃbhūmaudurgatatṛptaye yatrakvacanasaṃsthānaṃkṣudtṛṣṇoyahṛ tātmanāṃ durgatānāṃmayādattamakṣapyamupatiṣṭatuḥamṛtāthidhānamasipidadyātīrthavāriṇā arddhaṃtaraṃbubhūbhāgedadyā ddurgataitṛptaye samyagācamyadakṣāṃghneraṃguṣṭevārinikṣipet aṃguṣṭamātraḥpuruṣonyaguṃṣṭacasamāśritaḥ īśaṣkṛtsnasyaja gataḥprabhuprāṇātuviśvabhuk tataḥsatyacasaṃtuṣṭaḥpuṣṭidāmiṣṭadevatāṃ sanniṣkṛṣṭaiḥvṛtaḥśivyairjapedannapatermanūn a nnapatennasyatodhehinyādi agastiagnivadavānalaścabhunnaṃmayānnaṃjarayatvaśeṣaṃ sukhaṃcametatpariṇāmasaṃbhavaṃda datvārogaṃcasadāyurastume viṣṇuḥsamasteṃdriyadehīpradhānabhūtobhagavānyathaikaḥsatyenatenānnasaśeṣasannamārogyadaṃ mepariṇāmamastu bhakṣayedathatāṃvūlaṃprasādājjānakīpateḥ śiṣṭairiṣṭaiḥjapeddivyaṃbhagavānnāmamaṃgalaṃ itiprāṇā gnihotraṃ mṛdbhiḥśaucavidhiṃvidhāyacaraṇaiprakṣālyacopaspṛśedviḥsaṃsmṛtyajagatpatiṃśrīkośalaidraṃnṛpaṃ ayaṣṇāni miṣaṃpivaśriyasudhādhārāyamāṇaṃgiraṃvastreṇāṃghiyugaṃpramṛjyaśayanaṃtvāsādyasadyaḥsvapet rāmaṃskaṃdaṃhanūmaṃtaṃcai nateyaṃvṛkodaraṃ śayaneyaḥsmarennityaṃsaduḥsvapnaṃnapaśyati mūlaṃsmṛtvājapedrāmarakṣāṃvighnopaśāṃtaye gurvaryetipu naḥpadyaṃstriyāvyagrasvapetsukhaṃ skaṃde ṛtukalābhigāmīyassvadāranirataścayaḥ sasadābrahmacārīhavijñeyassagra hāśramī ṛtuḥṣoḍaśayāminyaścatasrastāsugārhitāḥputryāstāsvapiyāyugmāyugmāṣkanyakāpradāḥtyaktvācaṃdra-
pṛ0 43ba) masaṃdusyaṃmaghāmūlaṃvihāyaca śuciḥsanniviśetpatnīṃpunnāmakṣeṃviśeṣataḥśuciṃputraṃprasūyetapuruṣārthaprasādhakaṃ ityā dimanvādimuniprarṇātaśāstrapraṇīṃtepathivarttamānaḥnavādhyatenirmitakāmapāśaiḥśrīrāmacaṃdrasyapadaṃsameti itiśayanavidhiḥ itirātriprathamayāmakṛtyaṃ śrīrāmacaṃdrāyāṇamastu athāsyaṃmaṃtrarājasyapuraścaraṇamucyate vināyenanasiddhaḥsyānmaṃtrīvarṣaśatairapi bhaktiśraddheṣṭadānāviciroyāstiprasāditāt gurormatravaraṃlaghvāsa rvābhīṣṭapradaṃvudhaḥpūrvavatpūjayennityaṃjapeccaniyatavrataḥṣaṭsahasraṃsahasraṃvāśataṃcāṣṭottaraṃśuciḥevamārādhito rāmoyadābhaktiṃpravodhayet puraścaraṇakṛtvāyāṃpūrvāṃtevāvidhīyatāṃ yathāśaktiniyamyāṃtarvahirātmānamātmavi t puraścaraṇavatsarvaṃkuryyāddhomaṃvihāyatat itipūrvakṛtyaṃ tataḥsaṃkalpyakurvītapuraścaraṇamādarāt ciraṃniraṃ tareṇaivaniyatātmādṛḍhavratāḥśailāgrejalamadhyevātīrevālavaṇāṃbudheḥnadītaṭeśvatthamūleramyevilvavatāṃtarepra tyaṅmukhāśivasthāvṛṣabhādivavarjite aśvatthavilvatulasīvanepuṣpāṃtarāvṛte gavāṃgoṣṭeṣutīrtheṣupuṇyakṣetreṣu śasyate itisthānānivaidikācarayuktānāṃśucīnāṃśrīmatāṃkṣaye satkulasyanajātānāṃbhikṣāsyādagrajanmanāṃ bhuṃjā novāhaviṣpānnaṃśākaṃyāvakamevaca vācomūlaṃphalaṃvāpiyadyadyatroyapadyate gautamīye carumūlaphalakṣīradadhi bhikṣānnasaktadaḥsākaṃdāṣṭavidhaṃcānnaṃsādhakasyocyatevudhaiḥ itibhakṣyaniyamāḥ lavaṇaṃcapalaṃcaivakṣāraṃkṣaudraṃrasāṃ
pṛ0 44a) taraṃ māṣamuhumasūrādyānkodravāṃścaṇakānapi amadbhāṣaṇamanyānnaṃvarjayedanyapūjanaṃ vitāśnamocitannityaṃtathānaumi mitrikaṃcayet strīśūdrapatinavrātyanāstikoviṣṭabhāṣaṇaṃ āsatyabhāṣaṇaṃjaidsnyaṃbhāṣaṇaṃpavarjayet satyerapinabhāṣaṃta japahomārcanādiṣu vāṅmanaḥkarmabhirnityaṃnispṛhovanitādiṣu varjayeṃdgītakāvyādiśravaṇaṃnityadarśanam|| tāṃvūlaṃgaṃdhalepaṃcapuṣpadhāraṇamevaca maithunaṃtatkathālāpaṃtadgoṣṭīḥparivarjayet kauṭilyaṃkṣaudramabhyaṃgamanive ditabhojanaṃ asaṃkalpitakṛtyaṃcavarjayenmardanādikaṃ tyajaṃduṣṇodakasnānaṃsugaṃdhāmalakādikaṃ śiroṃgaṃpaṃcagavye napāvayedvahiraṃtaraṃ itivarjyāni snāṃyāccapaṃcagavyenakevalāmalakenaca śrutismṛtipurāṇoktamaṃtraisnāyādanaṃ taraṃ śaknautriṣavaṇasnānamanyathāsakadācaret itisnānaniyamāḥ varttulaṃnavakoṣṭaṃtatkṛtvākūrmākṛtiṃli khet svarayugmaṃkrameṇaivaiṃdrādyaṣṭasudikṣuca kādīnvargānkṣamīśāṃtyāntathāmadhyesthālādhipaṃ tannāṃmādya kṣaraṃyatrakūrmāsyaṃtaccadīpakaṃ tatpārśvakoṣṭauhastaudvāvadhodhaṣkukṣipādakau śeṣakoṣṭaṃbhavetpucchaṃmukhesi ddhiranuttamā karasthānemahānkleśakukṣauduḥkhamavāpnuyāt pādīhonistathāpuchepīḍāsyādvaṃdhanādibhiḥ mokṣārthīvadanekuryyāddakṣiṇetvābhicārakaṃ śrīkāmaḥpaścimebhūtvāuttareśāṃdidaṃbhavet īśāneśatrunāśasyādāṃ gneyeśatradīpakaḥ naiṛteśatrubhitiḥsyādvāyavyetupalāyanaṃ grāmevāvipinevāpiyetrakutrāvalokayet nadīsthā
pṛ0 44ba) nejapaṃkuryyātsarvakāryamabhīpsubhiḥkūrmacakramavijāyayaḥkuyajjipayaṃjñakaṃ tasyajāpyaphalaṃnāstisarvānarthāyakalpyate itikūrmacakraṃ kuśājināṃvareṇādyaṃkalpayedāsanaṃvudhaḥsvastikādikrameṇārthaṃviśettattanirākulaḥstaṃbhanegajacarmā- thamāraṇemāhiṣaṃtathā meṣīcarmatathoccāṭekhaḍgajaṃvaśyakarmaṇi vastrāsanaṃrogakaraṃvetrajevipulāṃśriyaṃ kauśeyaṃpau ṣṭikekāryyaṃkaṃbalaṃduḥmocanaṃ vaṃśāmanaṃcadāridryaṃdaurbhāgyaṃdārukāsane dharaṇyāṃduḥkhasaṃbhṛtyaipāṣāṇeduḥkhasaṃbha vaḥ tṛṇāsateyaśohāriretatsādhāraṇejape ityāsanaṃ rudrākṣaṃśakhāpadmākṣaputrajīvakamauktitaiḥsphāṭikairmaṇi raścasauvarṇaiḥvidrumaistathā kuśauḥparvaiḥdvādaśasyurgṛhasthasyākṣamālikāḥ aṃgulīgaṇanādekaṃrekhayāṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet putrajīvairdaśaguṇaṃśataṃśaṃkhaiḥsahasrakaṃ pravālairmāṇiratnaiścadaśasāhasrakaṃsmṛtaṃ tadevasphāṭikaiḥpro ktaṃmauktikairlakṣamucyate padmākṣaidaśalakṣaṃsyātsuvarṇaiḥkoṭirucyate kuśagraṃthyākoṭiśataṃrudrākṣaisyādanaṃtakaṃ tu lasīkāṣṭaghaṭitairmaṇibhirjapamālikā sarvakarmāṇisarveṣāmīpsitārthaphalapradā aṣṭottaraśatairmālāpaṃcāśa ccaturādhikaiḥ saptarviṃśatibhiḥkāryāsarvasādhāraṇejape mokṣārthīpaṃcaviṃśatyādhanārthītriṃśatājapet puṣṭārthī saptaviṃśatyāpaṃcadaśyābhicārake anulomavilomārṇairmātṛkāyāmaviṃdukaiḥkṣamerukaismāṣṭavargairmālā- syādyonināṃśubhā gopuchasadṛrśākāryyāekagrīvāsamerukā mukhaṃmukhenasaṃyojyaṃpuchaṃpucheniyojayet prāpta
pṛ0 45a) vyāsitaraktādyaiḥsūtraistatkarmasiddhaye japamālāṃvidhāyetthaṃtataḥsaṃskāramārabhet kṣālayetpaṃcagavyaistāṃsadyojātenasa jjalaiḥ caṃdanāgasagaṃdhādyaivīmadevenagharvayet dhūpayettāmaghoreṇalepayetpuruṣeṇatu maṃtrayetpaṃcamenaivapratyekaṃtuśataṃ śataṃ meruṃcapaṃcamenaivatathāmaṃtreṇamaṃtrayet yenapratiṣṭitāmālātamevatumanuṃjapet anyamaṃtrajayāvidvānakāryyā- karhicidvadhaiḥnaspṛśevdāmahastenakarabhraṣṭāṃnakārayet aṃguṣṭaṃmokṣadaṃviṃdyāttarjanīśatrunāśinī madhyamādhanasiddhausyā cchāṃtikarmaṇyanāmikākaniṣṭākarṣaṇejeyājapakarmaṇisiddhidā aṃguṣṭenavinākarmakṛtaṃdaphalaṃbhavet tarjanyā naspṛśetsūtraṃkapayennauvidhūnayet aṃguṣṭaparvamadhyasthaparivarttaṃsamācaret ārabhyānāmikāmūlāṃtprādakṣiṇye navaikramāt madhyamāmūlaparyaṃtaṃjapedaśasuparvasu oṃsadyojātaṃprapadyāmisadyojātāyavainamaḥbhavebhavenātibhavebha jasvamāṃbhavodbhavāyanamaḥ 1 oṃvāmadevāyanamojyeṣṭāyanamaḥ śreṣṭāyanamorudrāyanamaḥkālāyanamaṣkalavikara ṇāyanamobalavikaraṇāyanamovalāyanamovalapramathanāyanamaḥsarvabhūtadamanāyanamomanonmanamaḥ 2 argho rabhyothaghorebhyoghoraghoratarebhyaḥsarvebhyaḥśarvasarvebhyonamasteasturūpebhyaḥ oṃtatpuruṣāyavidmahemahādevāyadhī mahitannorudraḥpracodayāt oṃīśānaḥsarvavidyānāmīśvaraḥsarvabhūtānāṃbrahmādhipatibrahmaṇodhipatirbrahmā śivomeastusadāśivau itijapamālālakṣaṇaṃ japasyādakṣarāvṛttiḥsuccopāṃśumānamaḥyuccanīcesvaritaiḥ
pṛ0 45ba) śavdaiḥspaṣṭapadākṣaraiḥmaṃtramuccārayedvācājayajñaḥsavācikaḥśatairuccārayanmaṃtramīṣadoṣvaṃpracālayet kiṃcicchravaṇayogyaḥsyādu pāṃśusajapasmṛtaḥ dhiyāyadakṣaraśreṇīṃvarṇasvarapadātmikāṃ uccaredathaṃsaṃsmṛtyāsaṃsmṛtomānamojapaḥ uccaiḥjapādvisṛṣṭa ssyādupāṃśurdaśabhirguṇaiḥjijapaḥśanaguṇaḥsahasromānasaḥsmṛtaḥpaśubhavesthitāmaṃtrāḥkevalāvarṇarūpiṇā sauṣu mnedhvanyurccaratāḥprabhatvaṃprāpnuvaṃtite ekasyamaṃtranāthaḥsyānnavohyoditasyaca yadekaṃtaṃjapaviddhilakṣasaṃkhyāvidhaṃmune ma trākṣarāṇimaṇivachaktauprotānibhāvayet tāmevaparameyyomniparamāmṛtaṃvṛhitāṃ darśayatyātmasadbhāvaṃpūjāhomaṃ vināpisā nadoṣomānasejāpyesarvadeśepisarvadā japaniṣṭodvijaśreṣṭatsarvayajñaphalaṃlabhet sarveṣāmevayajñā nāṃjapayajñaḥpraśasyate ahiṃsadyāhibhūtānāṃjāyatesaumahāphalaḥ yajñānāṃjapayajñohamityāhabhagavānhariḥ padmanā bhīye yāvannaḥkarmayajñāssyuḥpradīptānituyāṃsica sarvetejapayajñasyakalāṃnārhaṃtiṣoḍaśīṃ japenadevatānityaṃstūyamā nāprasīdati prasannāvipulānbhogāndadyānmuktiṃcaśāśvatīmitiḥmānasaḥsiddhikāmānāṃpuṣṭikāmairupāṃśukaḥvā cikomāraṇaṃcaivapraśastojapīritaḥmaṃtradevaprakāśikāyāṃ sūryyasyāgneguroriṃhodīṃyasyacajalasyaca viprāṇāṃcaga vāṃcaivaśastojapīritasannidhausanmukhojapet maṃtrārṇake manaḥsaṃharaṇaṃśaicaṃmaunaṃmaṃtrārthaciṃtanaṃ avyagratvamanivo dojapasaṃpattihetavaḥuṣṇīṣīkaṃcukīnaktomuktakeśomalāvṛtaḥapavitrakarośuddhapralapannajapetkvacit aprāvṛ
pṛ0 46a) takaraukṛtvāśirasāprāvṛtopica ciṃtāvyākulacittovākruddhobhrāṃtaḥkṣudhānvitaḥanāśanaḥsayānovāgachaṃtutthitevacā rathyā yāmaśivasthānenajapettimiṃrāṃtare upānadgūḍhapādovāyānaśayyāgatastathā prasāryyanajapetpādaukukruṭāsanevaca pa titānāmaṃtyajānāṃdarśanebhāṣaṇeśrute kṣato'dhovāyugamanejṛṃbhaṇejapamṛtsṛjet prāptāvācamyeteṣāṃprāṇāyāmaṃṣaḍaṃ gakaṃ kṛtvājapetsamyagacheṣaṃyahāsūryādidarśanaṃ mārjāraṃkukruṭaṃkrauṃcaśvānaṃśūdraṃkharaṃkapiṃ dṛṣṭvācamyacaretkarmaspṛṣṭvāsnānaṃvidhī yate aśucirvāśucirvāpigachaṃstiṣṭansvapannapi maṃtraikaśaraṇovidvānmanasaivasadābhyaset gṛhejapaḥsamaḥproktogoṣṭośatagu ṇaḥsmṛtaḥārāmecatathāramyesahasraguṇucyate ayutaṃparvatepuṇyaṃnadyāṃdaśaguṇaṃtutat koṭidevālayeprāhuranaṃtaṃśi vasaṃnidhau śaktaścetsarvamevaitadaśaktaḥśaktitojapet niniṣṇukāmovānabhaktauvāniṣevidhigocaraḥtathācoktaṃśrīma dbhāgavate tāvatkarmāṇikurvītananividyetayāvatā matkathāśravaṇādauvāśrāddhāyāvannajāyate sutarāṃrāmamaṃtroyaṃ saskṛtoyathā itijāpalakṣaṇaṃ japecaniyatonityaṃtrikālaṃpuruṣottamaṃ arcayennevacāvyagroyāvanvallakṣamāditāḥ tarpa yeccavidhānenadaśāṃśaṃśuddhacāriṇā puṣpākṣatādiyuktenajalesaṃpūjyapūrvavat tatovilvaphalaiḥpuṣpaiḥpatrairapihutāśanepūrvo- ktetaprakāreṇarāmamāvāhyapūjayet madhuratraiyasaṃyuktaiḥpadmaivārpaṃyamenavā tilairvānyatamaireṣābrāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ pūjatraikālikīnityaṃjapastarpaṇamevaca homobrahmāṇabhuktiścapuraścaraṇamucyate gurorlavdhasyamaṃtrasyaprasannacayathāvidhi
pṛ0 46ba) paṃcāṃmoyāsanaṃsiddheḥpuraccaitadvidhīyate niṣkāmānāmanenaivasākṣātkārobhavedyaṃdidapi arthasiddhiḥsakāmānāṃsarvitaṃniḥphalaṃ nacet paṃcāgametatkurvītayaḥpuraṇaṃvudhaḥ savaivijayatelokevidyaiśvaryasutādibhiḥ ādārvatecamadhyecabrahmaṇānbhojaye dvahun dinedineyathāśaktyārāmamuddiśyabhaktitaḥsubhojiteṣuvipreṣutatsāṅgaṃsaphalaṃbhavet saṃsāreduḥkhabhūyiṣṭeyiche- tsukhamātmanaḥ paṃcāṃgopāsanenaivarāmaṃbhajatubhaktitaḥ paṃcāṃpāsanaṃbhaktyāpuraṇamucyate etaddhividuṣāṃśreṣṭaṃsaṃsāro chedakāraṇaṃ nānenamadṛśodharmonānenasadṛśaṃtapaḥ nānenasādhanaṃkiṃcidiṣṭārthasyatapodhana itipuraścaraṇaṃ yadihome tvaśaktaḥsyātpūjāyāṃtarpaṇepivā tāvatsaṃkhyājapenavaibrāhmaṇārādhanenava bhavedaṅgaddhavenairapuraścaraṇamāryyavai yadyadaṃgaṃvi hīyenatatsaṃkhyādviguṇojapaḥkarttavyaḥsāṃgasiddhyarthaṃtadaśaktenabhaktitaḥ yadyadaṃṅgaṃvihīyetatatoteṣṭamavāpnuyāt aṃga hīnaṃbhavedyadyatkarmameṣṭārthasādhanaṃ sarvarthābhojayedviprānkṛtasāṃgatvasiddhaye viprārādhanamātreṇavyaṃgaṃsāṃgatvamāpnuyāt japāddaśāṃśatohomataddaśāṃśatohomataddaśāṃśenatarpaṇaṃ mārjanaṃtaddaśāṃśenataddaśāṃśenabhojanaṃ itivā drāpatiriktapū rṇatāṃevaṃsiddhemaṃtrarājeprayogānsādhayedatha graṃthanaṃcavidarbhaṃcasaṃpuṭorodhanaṃtathā yogaḥpallavityetevidreyaḥṣaṭsukarma su maṃtrārṇantaritānkṛtvānābhavarṇānyathāvidhi graṃthanaṃtadvijānīyātpraśastaṃśānikarmāṇi maṃtrārṇadvaṃdvamadhyasthaṃ sādhyanāmākṣaraṃlikhet vidarbheṣavijñeyomaṃtribhirvaśyakarmāṇi ādāvaṃtecamadhyasyānnāmnosausaṃpuṭaḥsmṛtaḥ
pṛ0 47a) eṣasaṃstaṃbhanejñeyityuktaṃmaṃtravedibhiḥ ādāvaṃtebhavennāmasanostadrodhanaṃmanaṃ vidveṣaṇavidhāneṣupraśastamidamīritaṃ maṃtrasyāṃ nebhavennāmayogyaḥproccāṭanemataḥ aṃtenāmnobhavenmaṃtraḥpallavomāraṇemataḥ itiṣaḍapallavavajñānaṃ tatvodayaṃparijñā yakarmakuryā dyathocitaṃ kṣmātatvestaṃbhanaṃkuryyādaṃbhastutvenaśāṃtikaṃ vaśyamākarṣaṇaṃcaivatejastatvodayesati uccāṭa taṃmaruttatvevyomatatvecamāraṇaṃ jānīyoduvitaṃtatvaṃvarṇairviduṃgataiḥpṛthuk ititatvajñānam vedāsraṃyonimeṃrddhaṃdratryasraṃ vṛttaṃṣaḍasrakaṃ paṃkajākāramaṣṭāsraṃśāṃtikādauniyojayet itikuṃḍāni laukikegnauśāṃtikaṃsyātpauṣṭikaṃcaśu bhaṃtathā vaṭajestaṃbhanaṃproktaṃśmaśānasthetumāraṇe vibhītakāgnauvidveṣaṃṣaṭkarmasvagrayomatāḥ ityagnayaḥ aṃgu ṣṭānāmikābhyāṃcajapedutnasakarmaṇi aṃguṣṭamadhyamābhyāṃtujapedākṛṣṭasiddhaye tarjanyaṃguṣṭasaṃyogādvidveṣoccāṭa naṃbhavet kaniṣṭāguṣṭakābhyāṃtujapenmāraṇakarmaṇi itijapajñānaṃ udayādyāmaparyaṃtaṃhemaṃtepauṣṭikaṃjapet yāma dvayaṃpūrvarātraṃśiśiremāraṇaṃjapet vasaṃtepraharādūrdhvaṃyāvanmadhyāhnikaṃjapet kāryamākarṣaṇaṃtatramaṃtrairiṣṭasyavastutaḥ grai ṣmastṛtīyakoyāmohitovidveṣakarmaṇi tatostamanaparyaṃtamuccāṭetoyadāgame ardharātreniyatavākjapecharadiśāṃ tikaṃ tathācāhavasiṣṭaḥ yasminkasminṛtaukāryyamaṃtrāṇāṃsādhanaṃśubhaṃ pūrvāhnevaśyapauṣṭārthaṃmadhyāhneprītināśa naṃ uccāṭamaparāhnetasaṃdhyāyāṃmāraṇaṃtathā śāṃtikaṃcārddharātrevaitadūrddhaṃsarvakarmaca itiṛtujñānaṃ pūrvāmukhebhavedvaśyaṃ
pṛ0 47ba) dakṣiṇehyābhicārikaṃ paścimaṃcadhanaṃviṃdyāduttarāsyetuśāṃtikaṃ ākarṣamathākṣepenaiṛtemāraṇaṃtathā uccāṭanaṃcavāyavyeī śānyemokṣadāyakaṃ itidiṅtiyamaḥ śuklapakṣedvitīyācatṛtīyāpaṃcamītathā vudhadevagurūpetāśāṃtikecāthasaptamī ṣaṣṭītrayodaśīcaivacaturthīnavamītathā somadevagurūpetāpoṃṣṭikesaṃśitāvudhaiḥ aṣṭamīnavamīcaivadaśamyekādaśītathā śukrabhānusutopetāśastāvidveṣakarmaṇi ataścaturdaśīkṛṣṇāśānevāre tathāṣṭamī uccaṭatetiśastoyajayaḥśaṃkarabhā ṣitāḥamāvasyāṣṭamīkṛṣṇātādṛkceṃvacaturdaśī bhānunātatsutopetāṃbhūsvarenāpisaṃyutā māraṇestaṃbhanecaivajapehome praśaṃsitā ititithinirṇayaḥ lakṣaṃtadarddhamathavājapitvātaddaśāṃśataḥ nilairvākamalairhātvāyadyadiṣṭaṃtadaśruta vilva prasūnairaiśvaryyamarcite'gnauhatairbhavet pālāśakusumairhutvāmedhārvāvedavidbhavet dūrvābhiścaguḍūrcābhiḥpratyekamapi cākṣataiḥ nirāmayopidīrghāyurbhavanyevataponidhi ārogyakāmorbhujīyādannaṃmaṃtrābhimaṃtritaṃ sumedhāmaṃtrapūtāṃbhaḥpī tvāddaṃvakavirbhavet rogoktoṣadhihomenarogānmucyetatatkṣaṇāt samyakcaṃdanatoyenapratyagnaiścasamukṣitaiḥ jātīprasūnairhu tvānurājānaṃvaśamānayet dhyātvāpimanmathaṃrāmaṃsītāmapiratiṃsmaran sarvavaśyaprayogeṣujapahomādikarmasu vāṃ chitaṃdhanamāpnotihutvāraktotpalainavaiḥ hutvānīlotpalaiḥsamyakvaśapedakhilaṃjagat rāmaṃvidhivadārādhyajvalitaigrauprayo gavit hutvāmīlotpalaiḥsamyakvaśayedakhilaṃjagat rāmaṃvidhivadārādhyajvalite'gnauprayogavit madhusrayayuktenapā
pṛ0 48a) yasenahutenatu sarvādhipatyaṃvaidruṣyaṃbhavatyevanasaṃśayaḥvilvaprasūnaiḥkumudaistathāvilvadalairapi hutvāsalabhatelakṣmīmacirātmaṃtra sādhakaḥārādhyarāmaṃcaṃdrāśumaṃḍalevatsaraṃmune udayādastamānaṃtaṃjapanmaṃtramananyadhīḥ phalaṃbhavatitasyāśudevānāmapi durlabhaṃ rājyaiśvaryyauyabhogārthījapellakṣamananyadhīḥ padmairvilvaprasūnairvādaśāṃśaṃjuhuyātmane samudratīregoṣṭevā lakṣajāpīpayobrataḥ pāyasenājyayuktenahutvāvidyānidhirbhavet parikṣīṇādhipatyoyaḥśākāhārojalāṃtare jape llakṣaṃcajuhuyārvilvapuṣpairdaśāṃśataḥ tadevapunarāyānisvādhipatyaṃnasaṃśayaḥ upoṣyagaṃgādijalāṃtarasthorāmaṃsamā rādhyajapeccalakṣaṃ hutvādaśāṃśaṃkamalaistilairvāvilvaprasūnairmadhuratrayuktaiḥ rājyaṃśriyaṃviṃdatimaṃdabhāgyopāmuṣyadāsyaṃ paravāṃchitaṃsyāt māghamāsejalesthitvākandamūlaphalāśanaḥjapellakṣaṃcajuhuyātpāyasemārcinemale daśāṃśaṃputra pautrāptyaitacheṣaṃprāyaśotpriyāṃ śrīrāmamadṛśaḥputropautraupyasyaprajāpate baliṣṭaiḥśatrubhirmaṃtrīparibhūtovamānitaḥ tadāhatahanetyuktvānāmāṃtaivairiṇojapet dhyātvāraghuyātiṃkruddhaṃkālānalāmivāparaṃ ākīrṇasaśarākṛṣṭakodaṃḍa bhujamaṃḍalaṃ raṇāṃganeripūnsarvāṃstīkṣṇamāgāṇavṛṣṭibhiḥsaṃharaṃtaṃmahāvīramugnamaiṃdrarathāsthitaṃ lakṣmaṇādimahāvīraiḥśai lavṛkṣakaroddhṛtaiḥ cegātkarālahuṃkārabhobhokāramahāravaiḥnadadbhiḥparidhāvadbhiḥsamarerāvaṇaṃpratievaṃdhyātvānirāhāro maṇāyariyoḥpunaḥjuhuyāchālmalīpuṣpairdaśāṃśaṃmaṃtrasādhakaḥ atyaiśvaryyasamṛddhopinaśatruravāśiṣyate vairiṇaṃrāva
pṛ0 48ba) ṇaṃdhyātvātathātmānaṃraghūdvahaṃ vidhāyapūrvatatsarvamanāyāsenasārayet śītāharaṇaśokādhistaṃbhibhūtamacejanaṃ japedraghu patiṃdhyāyannirāhārojalevasan daśāṃśatastilairhutvāstaṃbhayechatrusaṃhatiṃ nidhāyavāyuvījāṃtetannāmadhyātvādiṣa ṣṇaṃcasītānveṣaṇakātaraṃ bhramayatyaciraṃsākṣāddhamādrimapivairiṇaṃ anyerpicahavaḥsītiprayogāmaṃtrarājake kiṃca prayogakartṛṇāṃparalokonavidyate prayogasiddhirevaivāṃphalaṃnānvaditobhavet niḥkāmātāṃcabhaktānāṃjapahomā dikarmasu muktirevaphalaṃteṣāmihakicinnavidyate vidvanbrahmāstramādāyaśaśādaumāvimocaya nāyaṃmuktipradomaṃ tromāraṇādauprayujyatāṃ itiprayogasādhanam athātaḥsaṃpravakṣyāminānāyaṃtrāṇimaṃtriṇāṃ nānārthadānirāma syanānākalpāgamātpṛthak paṃcarātrebrahmasaṃhitāyāmuktiṃpratatpate tathāhi ṣaṭkoṇaṃcakramālikhyasvarake- śarasaṃyutaṃ koṇeṣumaṃtravarṇāścavahiraṣṭadalāṃvujaṃ daleṣuvilikhenmūlaṃtataḥpraṇayasaṃyutaṃ punaḥpūrvaṃpunaḥpadmaṃ dvādaśāraṃdaledyathatrailokyamohanaṃvījaṃnāmasaṃyuktasālikhet karṇikāyāṃlikhennāmatāramanvavidarbhitaṃ mahāsudarśanenedaṃśeṣṭitaṃcakramuttamaṃ pṛthivyāsaṃpuṭaṃvāhyevajrāṣṭakavibhūṣitaṃ catuṣkaṇaṃśubhamathoṃkuśayā- śāvaniprayuk bhūrjapatrolikhedetarocanādyaiḥśubhehani vilikhyadhāsyenmaṃtrīmūrdhniyādakṣiṇebhuje natasya vidyatepāyaṃyāvanvatradhṛtesthite vyādhibhirnnābhibhūyenanāhibhirnacataskaraiḥ nāribhirnagajairmaṃtrairnacānyaiḥkṣudra-
pṛ0 49a) jaṃtubhiḥ striyovaśyābhavaṃtyevadarśanāttasyamaṃtriṇaḥrājānomaṃḍalīkāścasāmaṃtārājamaṃtriṇaḥ dhanadhānyasamṛddhiḥsyā tsarvānkāmāṃścaviṃdati tvayāputranavaktavyaṃyaṃtrarājaṃmahovayaṃ nāśiṣyāyatapāyāyanāśāṃtāyapriyāyaca śiṣyāyamaṃ traniṣṭāyaśraddhābhaktiyutāyaca vamupradāyadātavyamanyathānarakepatet ityasyārthaḥ ṣaṭkoṇaṃcakranālikhetparaspa raṃcaimukhyena trikoṇayugmaṃlikhet tataścaiṃdryāgneyanaiṛtyavāruṇavāyavyeśātāṃtāmadhyemadhyesamaṣaṭḍamaru kāseyaṃṣaṭkoṇanoditā svarakesarasaṃyutamityetadvahiraṣṭadalāṃvujamityatenasaṃvadhyanekoṇeṣumaṃtravarṇātpūrvā diṣaṭkoṇeṣu oṃrāmāyahūṃphaṭsvāhetimaṃtraḥ tataḥśrīṃśrīṃrāmāyahuṃphaṭsvāheti rāṃrāmāyasvāhetivāphaṭ svāheti rāṃrāmāyasvāhetivāṣaṭ maṃtravarṇānyathākramaṃlikhitvātatovarttulaṃrekhādvayaṃlikhevahiraṣṭadalāṃvujaṃ tadvahiraṣṭayatrapadmaṃsvarakeśarasaṃyutaṃṣoḍaśakeśarasahitaṃdaleṣuvilikhetmūlaṃ tatheṣṭasudaleṣuca oṃnamonā rāyaṇāyetimūlamaṃtraṃlikhet tataḥpraṇavasaṃpuṭaṃekaikamakṣarapraṇavadvayamadhyagataṃyathābhavettathālikhet punaḥpū rvaṃpūrvaṃṣaṭkoṇaṃpūrvavanmaṃtrārṇakṣarasahitaṃlikhet tatokoṇāgrasyāvarttalaṃrekhādvayaṃkuryāt punaḥpadmaṃdvādaśāraṃdvā daśadaleṣu trailokyamohanaṃvījaṃklīmitināmasaṃyuktamālikhet tadvījaṃsādhyānāmasahitaṃpratidalaṃlikhet ta tokarṇikāyāṃlikhet ādyaṣaṭkoṇamadhyevarttulaṃrekhādvayaṃlikhet karṇikāvatkarṇikātasyāṃsādhyasyavastutonā
pṛ0 49ba) malikhet kathaṃbhūtaṃtāramaṃtravidarbhitaṃtārādinavasaṃkhyākamaṃtrākṣarairvidarbhitaṃ ādaumaṃtrākṣaredvayaṃanaṃtaraṃsādhyanāmākṣaramaikai kaṃpunarmaṃśakṣaradvayaṃ anaṃtaraṃnāmnokṣarasamāptiryyāvattāvallikhet etaddhidarbhinaṃ tathācamaṃtrāṃśakedvedvemaṃtrākṣareyatrerke kaṃnāmasādhyakaṃ vidarbhitaṃtutatproktaṃsarvarakṣākaraṃparaṃ itiśāṃtiketvādaumaṃtraṃsamagraṃlikhitvāstranaṃtaraṃsādhyanā masamagraṃvilikhetpunarmaṃtraṃsamagramālikhet etatsaṃpuṭamityucyate tathāmaṃtramālikhyapūrvaṃvaisādhyaṃcatadanaṃtaraṃ punaścāṃtebhavenmaṃtrasaṃpuṭaṃśāṃtikarmaṇītivaśye ādaumaṃtraprathamākṣaraṃtatonāmnaḥ prathamākṣaraṃpunarmaṃtradvitīyākṣaraṃtato nāmnodvitīyākṣaraṃ evaṃsamāptistāvallikhedvividhakusumagrathitamālāvat etaccagraṃthitaṃtathāca ekaikaṃsādhya varṇaṃtumālāvatsaṃpuṭīkṛtaṃ maṃtrārṇaugraṃthitaṃcaitadvaśyākṛṣṭividhausmṛtaṃ yamaṃtrabhevanetuādaumaṃtrasamagraṃlikhitvāpa ścānnāvākṣarāṇisāvaśeṣāṇilikhyapunarmaṃtraṃsamagraṃlikhitvāpunarnāmnovaśiṣṭākṣarāṇivilikhyapunarmaṃtraṃsaṃma- grāṃlikhet etadgrastaṃ tathāca ādaumadhyetathācāṃtemaṃtraṃkuryyādvicakṣaṇaḥmadhyemadhyebhavetsaṃjñādgrastamityabhidhīyate iti ayamevarodhitikecivāhuḥyogastvevaṃ ādyaimaṃtrasumagraṃlikhitvāpaścānnāmākṣarāṇi 4 samagrāṇilikheditipalla vastu ādaunāmasamagraṃlikhitvāpaścātmaṃtraṃsamaṃgraṃlikhiditi tathāca tatrodoyogudiṣṭaratnecetpallavasmṛta iti ta yoścaviniyogastathaivoktaḥ tathāhi śāṃtikepauṣṭikedivyeprāyaścittaviśodhane mohanedīpaneyogeprayuṃjaṃtimanīṣiṇaḥ

pṛ0 50ba) maṃtraṃvibhajyālikhet padmasthakesararddhaddheṣucayathāsaṃkhyenaṣoḍaśasvarān tadanaṃtararekhādvayamadhyekādīnkṣanāṃtānpunaḥṣa ṭkoṇeṣumūlamaṃtravarṇān tatonaṃtaravartularekhādvayamadhye oṃamuṣyaprāṇāihaprāṇāḥ amuṣyajīvihasthitaḥ amu ṣyasarvendriyoṇivāḍmanaḥprāṇāihāyaṃtutvakcakṣuśrotraghrāṇasvastayesukhetasuciraṃmiṣṭaṃtusvāhā itiprāṇaprati ṣṭāmaṃtraṃlikhet asyatuviśeṣogurumukhādaucajñeyaḥkṛṣṇavallabhaṃcoktaṃ tatodvādaśadaleṣutrailokyamohanaṃvījaṃ sādhyanāmasahitaṃtatovarttularekhādvayamadhyesudarśanaṃmaṃtraṃ aṣṭasukoṇeṣupratikoṇaṃchakāraṃlikhet tatovahiśca tuṣkoṇeṣu pratikoṇaṃpāśāṃkuśāvanivījānilikhet itivilikhyadhārayedityādispaṣṭarthiḥ atrasarvatrayaṃsā- dhāraṇamuhūrttādiviśeṣaḥ maṃtrāṃśakoktaḥkathyateḥ tathācasudineśubhanakṣatresudeśeśalyavarjite saśiṣyastatrā cāryyaḥśiṣyovātadabhāvataḥ udaṅmukhaṃḥprāṅmukhovāupaviśyapraṇamyaca guruṃviśveśvaraṃdevaṃtatoyaṃtraṃsamālikhet kāmanābhedetukālaviśeṣuktaḥkathyate vaśyā kṛṣṭaulikhetpuṣṭauditauvidveṣaṇaṃsmṛtaṃ ārdrāyāṃmāraṇaṃprāktaṃma ghāsūccāṭanaṃbhavet tathācakāmanādhīnolekhanīviśeṣopi tathāca lekhanyācalikhedyaṃtraṃvaśyaiddarvāṃkarotthayā ākṛṣṭautukaraṃjotthāmāraṇepinarāsmitā staṃbhakarmaṇivijñeyārājavṛkṣoruvātathā śāṃtikepauṣṭikecaivava hyāyuḥkāmavidhautathā sārpyāpaśasanaicaivajalpanestaṃbhatepivā vibhrāmoyādanecaivaśilāyāṃtupraśasyate kharaca
pṛ0 51a) rmāṇividveṣemahaduccāṭamaṃdhvaje kṣīrodevatathāsamyaguktaṃvāsādhayeddhruvaṃ jvarasaṃtāpaśokaṃcaśatrūṇāṃmāraṇaṃtathā likhitvāsā dhayetsarvaṃpītavastreṇanānyathā tathādravyabhedopi dravyaiścavividhaistadvaccaṃdraṃcaṃdanarocanaiḥ uśīrakṣīrayuktaistunātrakāryā vicāraṇā nāgeṃdramadayuktāvaitathāvaśyecarocanā viṣadhatūrayuktenacitāṃgāreṇaseṣmaṇā tāḍanoccāṭanādīnikṣudra kārmāṇisādhayet viṣārkakṣīraguṃjāyāḥsaṃyogesāraṇaṃsmṛtaṃ maṃtreśādyaṃtrarājannamevaṃsaṃlikhyayatnataḥ pūjayedgaṃdhapu ṣpādyairdhyātvādevaṃjagadguruṃ trilohaveṣṭanaṃkṛtvātataḥpūjāṃtukārayet devahastagutaṃlavdhāsādhayansādhakottamaḥkarekaṃ ṭheśikhāyāṃvāyathāsannihitobhaveviniśeṣaṃsugamaṃ athadvitīyayaṃtraṃ nāmasapraṇavaṃmadhyeṣaṭkoṇaṃvāhyatolikhet maṃtrākṣarāṇikoṇeṣukoṇayorviśvamohanaṃ māheṃdramaṃḍalevāhyekapālevilikhedidaṃ raktenānāmikotthenatāpayedvā dirāgninā saptabhiḥdivasairyaṃtraṃraṃbhāpivaśagābhavet asyārthaḥnāmasapraṇavaṃmadhyeitiādaulikhitavarttularekhādvayama dhyesādhyasyavastunonāmapraṇavadvayamadhyagataṃlikhet ṣaṭkoṇavāhyatolikhet etaccaprāṇaṃvāhyatolikhet yuktapra kāreṇakarṇikākhyavarttularekhādvahilikhet maṃtrākṣarāṇikoṇeṣurāṃrāmāyahuṃphaṭ rāṃrāmāyasvāhetivāṣaḍakṣarāṃṇi ṣaṭkoṇeṣuyathākramaṃlikhet koṇayorviśvamohanaṃ dvayordvayoṣkoṇayormadhyeviśvamohanaṃ oṃśrīṃdrāṃśrīṃdāsarathāṃyasītā vallabhāyatrailokyamohanāyanamaḥ itimaṃtrayathasaṃbhavaṃlikhet tatovarttulaṃrekhādvayaṃlikhet klīmitivājaganmohanaṃ
pṛ0 51ba) bījaṃlikhet māheṃdraṃmaṃḍalaṃvāhyeṣaṭkoṇavahirbhāgeaṣṭakoṇaṃcakraṃlikhet sarveṣucakoṇeṣuchakāraṃlikhet kapolevili khedidaṃ idaṃyaṃtraṃnaraśiraḥkapālelikhedityarthaḥ kairdravyairityāha raktenāṃnāmikotthainakaniṣṭīkāyāsannihitāṃgulīni rgatenaraktenalikhedityarthaḥmāpayetkhadirāgnināsādhyamanusmaret maṃtraṃcāṣṭasahasraṃjapet saptavivasaṃkhādirasami dbhisamiddhenakhādirāgninātāpayet śeṣaṃvyaktaṃ athatṛtīyaṃ idastveparaṃyaṃtraṃmāyāvījenaveṣṭitaṃ hrīmitivījenaniraṃtaraṃ likhitaṃvedyaṃprātaraṃbhavatikutityāha bhūrjevilikhyavidhivabhūrjjapatreyatreyathāśāstrāṃlikhitvetyarthaḥ sādhyamūrttyattamāli khet ṣaṭkoṇamadhyasthakarṇikāyāṃsādhyapuruṣarūpaṃstrīrūpaṃmūttyeṃtaṃhastapādādyavayavayuktaṃmaṃtrasaṃpuṭaṃlikhet kṛtvāśma śānekhananaṃprāguktemārgaṃṇayaṃtraṃsaṃpādyaśavadāhabhūmaukhananaṃnikṣepanaṃkuryāt kutityāha saṃdhyāyāṃvijipedvālāṃ sūryyāstasamayeevaṃkṛtekiṃbhavati balaṃvālavattaṃpratipakṣaṃjayaṃtītiityarthaḥsādhyākarṣaṇamāvahet sādhyasvāpekṣi tasyavastutaḥsvamamīpamānayanaṃsādhayedityarthaḥ athacaturthadvitīyākṣarasaṃyuktaṃnāmamadhyelikhenmune koṇeṣuuddharedva rṇānvahirvaruṇamaṃḍalaṃ vāruṇaṃparitolikhyagaṃgādyaiḥkalaśodake tanmukhekalpitaṃdevadīpaṃkapilājyenapūritaṃ maṃtreṇā vāhyadeveśaṃdīpamadhyevidhānataḥtatramaṃlakṣayenmaṃtraṃrūpaṃbhagavatasphuṭaṃ atītānāgataṃsarvaṃspṛṣṭaṃvadatimaṃtriṇā kumā rīpaśyatikṣipraṃmumānyadinapaśyati asyārthaḥ dvitīyākṣarasaṃyuktaṃnāmamadhyelikhenmune rāmityanenasaṃpuṭitasā
pṛ0 52a) dhyaṃvasthānonāmaṣaṭkoṇāṃtaḥkarṇikāmadhyelikhet munetisaṃvodhanaṃ koṇeṣuruddharedvarṇānṣaṭsukoṇeṣurāmāyahuṃsvāheti ṣaṭvarṇānuddharelikhet vahirvāruṇaṃmaṃḍalaṣaṭkoṇādvahivāruṇamaṃḍalaṃdhanurākāramaṃḍalaṃlikhet vāruṇaṃparitolekhyaṃvaṃiti vījaṃsarvataḥniraṃtaraṃlikhet tataścatuṣkoṇaṃmaṃḍalaṃsarvasādhāraṇaṃbhūpurākhyaṃpāśāṃkuśāvanivījayuktaṃlikhitvālākṣāra senāveṣṭayet gaṃgādyaiḥkalaśodakegaṃgādisarijjalaiḥ kuṃbhaṃpūrayitvātasminkalaśodake gaṃgāṃ tadyaṃtraṃnikṣipet tanmu khekalpitaṃdīpaṃkapilājyenapūritaṃ tasyakuṃbhasyamukhekalpitaṃdīpaṃkuryāt kapilāghṛtenapūritaṃcaśarārvakṛtvetya rthaḥ maṃtreṇāvāhyadeveśaṃdīpamadhyedeveśaṃśrīrāmadīpākhyasthaṃddhileāvāhyavidhānatityatasyāyamarthaḥśrīrāmaparamā tmādevatā rāitivījaṃsvāhetiḥśaktiḥakṣarāṇāṃtubrahmābhṛgurbharadvājoviśvāmitrothagautamaḥpulastyovāmadeścṛ ṣayaḥparikīrtitāḥtathāchaṃdāṃsyapiyathākrameṇaiva gāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭupvṛhatīpaṃktirevaca triṣṭupcajagatīcetichaṃdāṃsyu ktānisūribhiḥ devatākṣarakrameṇaivaparamātmāharodurgāsūryaskaṃdaḥpitāmahaḥ etāstudevatāḥprāktāvītihovastusapta maḥvarṇāstuprathamaḥśvetavarṇaḥsyādvitīyognisamaprabhaḥtṛtīyāpiṃgavarṇastucaturtheharitaprabhaḥpaṃcamaḥpiṃgavarṇa- stuṣaṣṭāpītasamaprabhaḥsaptamonīlavarṇassyādetevarṇāḥprakīrtitāḥcaturṇāmādyavarṇānāmudāttaḥkathitaḥsvari taḥpaṃcamovarṇaḥṣaṣṭovarṇonudāttakaḥudāttaḥsaptamīvarṇaḥsvarāḥproktāmayānaghityetatprāṇāṃyāmādiviniyogaṃ
pṛ0 52ba) saṃkīrttyamaṃtreṇavyāpakaṃnyāsaṃkṛtvāsvāhetyanenakaraśuddhiṃkṛtvārāmāyahuṃphaṭitiśiraḥśikhākavacanetreṣupaṃcākṣarāṇinya set svāhāstrāyaphaḍityastraṃdikṣuvinyaset eṣaṣaḍaṃgonyāsaḥ tatoyogaiśaracopamudrāḥpradarśyapraṇaveno rddhamukhaṃkṛtvātatovyāhṛtyāvikamitaṃkṛtvātataḥśrīrāmaṃdhyāyet nīlānpaladalasyāmaṃjaṭāmukuṭamaṃḍitaṃ pītāṃ varadharaṃdevaṃdivyakuṃḍalabhūṣitaṃ dakṣiṇelakṣmaṇaṃdhyāyetkanakābhaṃkirīṭitaṃ vāmabhāgejagadyoniṃprakṛtiṃparameśvarīṃ sī tāṃcaṃpakagaurāṃgīṃśvetavastravibhūṣitāṃ sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃdvibhujāṃraktakuṃḍalāṃ dhyātvālakṣyatrayaṃjāptvāśokakusumai rhunet anenavidhināsiddhamaṃtraḥsatkuṃbhamukhasthaśarāvekalpitapradīpesvahṛtkamalasthaṃdevamāvāhanamudrayāṃāvāhyasthāpa nasannidhīkaraṇādimudrāṃtradarśyaṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃkṛtvāyogaśaracāpamudrāḥṣaṭrarśyubhayataḥsītālakṣmaṇauvagaṃdharvāṣṭakaṃta togurugaṇapatidurgākṣetrapālān tatolokapālāṣṭakaṃpuratoviṣvaksenagaruḍanāradādibhaktān tatohanumatsugrīvā dīnāmāvāhayet etatparivārasahitaṃṣoḍaśopacārairabhyarcya purataḥkumāraṃkumārīṃvābhyarcyadīpamadhyekiṃtiṣṭhati pa- śyetyuktātasyadīpaṃpradarśayet tatrasaṃlakṣayenmaṃtrīrūpaṃbhagavasphuṭaṃ ityādisugamaṃ athapaṃcamaṃyaṃtraṃ kārṇikāṃtargataṃnāmatṛ tīyākṣaragarbhitaṃ śiṣṭāṃtareṣusaṃlikhyatatotyaupariveṣṭayet pārthivaṃmaṃḍalaṃvāhyevilikhedyatnavānniśijatuketāja vṛkṣasyakoṭaretadviniḥkṣipet mukhestaṃbhogatistaṃbhojihvāstaṃbhobhadaṃtyataḥ itiasyārthaḥ karṇikāṃtargatamiti ṣa
pṛ0 53a) ṭkoṇāṃtargatabarttularekhādvayaṃmadhyagataṃnāmatṛtīyākṣaragarbhitaṃ sādhyasyavastutonāmamaṃtrasyarmityanenatṛtīyākṣareṇasaṃpuṭitaṃ likhedityarthaḥ śiṣṭāṃtareṣusaṃlikhya oṃrāmāyahūṃphaḍitiśiṣṭānṣaḍvarṣānṣakoṇeṣulikhe tatonyaiḥpariveṣṭayet anaṃtaraṃ svāhetivarṇadvābhyāṃpariveṣṭayet pārthivaṃmaṃḍalaṃvāhyepāśāṃkuśāvanivījasahitaṃcatuḥkoṇaṃvahirlikhet yatnavānnyā sādikaṃkṛtvāātmanorakṣāṃvidhāyalikhetkāmyakamaratasyadevādyairabhibhavasaṃbhavān tathācakāmyakarmapraśaktasya śaktasyāsyaśubhamyaca aritvaṃbhajatemitraḥsiddhatvaṃtadviparyayāt ititasyopāyāṃtarāparihāryyasaṃkaṭeprāptesāvadhāno bhūtvākāryyakarmakuryāt kasminkāleniśirātrausārddhayāmāduparicaturthādyāmādarvāk yaṃtraṃsaṃpādyaprāṇapratiṣṭāṃkṛtvāpū jāṃvidhāyajatukenalākṣayāveṣṭyasahasravāramabhimaṃtryaprujavṛkṣasyakoṭarepalāśavdakṣasyodaretadyaṃtraṃnikṣipediti śe ṣaṃsugamaṃ agastisaṃhitāyāṃ dveyaṃtrekathyaṃteiṣṭavesarveṣāṃrāmamaṃtrāṇāṃtayoḥpūjāpraśaṃsyate ādauṣaṭkoṇamuneda- lānivilikhedaṣṭautataḥsyāccaturasrakaṃsarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃvyaktaṃsarvamanoharaṃ tadaṃtarepisuvyaktaṃsādhyākhyakarmagarbhitaṃ tadvījaṃvilikhedbhūyastaktroḍīkṛtamanmatha tataḥsatyaṃcavījānipunarāvarttayensute punardaśākṣareṇaivatadevapariveṣṭayet ṣaḍaṃgānyagnikoṇādikoṇeṣvevakramāllikhet tathākoṇakapoleṣu hrīṃśrīdvevilikhettataḥhuṃvījaṃpratikoṇā gnekesarāgneṣucasvarān mālāmaṃtrasyavarṇāsyuścatvāriṃśaccasaptaca varṇāḥsaptadaleṣvevaṣaḍaṣaṭpaṃcāṣṭamedale pūrva
pṛ0 53ba) toveṣṭayatkādyaitatsarvaṃcatapodhana digvidikṣulikhedvījenārasiṃhevarāhayoḥ hūṃcetipūrvadibhūgṛhecaturake yaṃtresminsamyagārā dhyabhuktiṃmukticaviṃdati etadyaṃtraṃsamālikhyagulikīkṛtyadhārayet aputrolabhateputrānadhanodhanamāpnuyāt kimatrabahu noktenasarvasiddhiṃpradaṃnṛṇāṃ yaṃtrametatsamākhyātaṃdhāraṇātpātakāpahaṃ asyārthaḥ ṣaṭkoṇādidharaṃṇyaṃtamanoharaṃyaṃtraṃ tasyāyaṃtrasyamadhyesuttyaktaṃyathābhavatitathāsādhyākhyākarmagarbhitaṃ tasyaśrīrāmasyabījaṃlikhet tatsarvaṃmanmathena kroḍukṛtyaavaśiṣṭairmaṃtrārṇaimaṃnmarthaveṣṭrayet punardaśākṣareṇacapunaṣṭamanmathaṃveṣṭavet aṣṭadalādvahirdaśākṣarevaiṣṭanami tivasiṣṭakalpebhedaḥśeṣaṃspaṣṭaṃ itiṣaṣṭaṃ ṣaṭkoṇādidharaṇyaṃtepūrvavadvilikhedatha tasyamadhyelikhettāraṃṣaḍsukoṇe ṣvapikramāt mūlamaṃtrākṣarāṇyevaṃsaṃdhiṣvaṃgaṃcamānmathaṃ moyāṃgaṃḍeṣukiṃjalkesvarāṇāṃlekhanamataṃ patreṣupūrvavanmā lāmaṃtrolekhyaḥ krameṇahi daśākṣareṇasaṃreṣṭyakādyātivyaṃjanānica digvidikṣulikhedvījenārasiṃhavarāhayoḥ etayaṃ trāṃtaraṃcātrasaṃgāvaraṇamacayet sauvarṇerajatebhūrjelikhitvārcatatācaret phalaṃtupūrvahreyaṃyaṃtrasyāsyavicakṣaṇaiḥ asyā rthaḥ caturasyaveṣṭidalasyakārṇikamadhyeṣaṭkoṇaṃtanmadhyepraṇavaṃ ṣaṭkoṇeṣuṣaṇmaṃtravarṇikāmadhyeṣaṭkoṇaṃtanma- dhyepraṇabaṃṣaṭkoṇeṣuṣaṇmaṃtravarṇān rāṃrīṃrūraiṃrauṃraḥ ityaṃgāgneyādikoṇasaṃdhiṣuklīṃhnīṃkoṇagaṃḍeṣu aṣṭadalakiṃ jalkeṣusvarān tatpatreṣvaṣṭasupūrvādikrameṇasaptacatvāriṃśanmālāmaṃṇāṃṣaṭṣaṭsaṃkhyākānaṣṭamepaṃcasaṃkhyākāṃlli
pṛ0 54a) khet huṃjānakīvallabhāyasvāhetidaśākṣareṇavahirveṣṭiyitvātarthevakādikṣāṃtaiścadigvidikṣokṣauṃhuṃitinṛsiṃhavarāhavīje likhet śeṣaṃspaṣṭaṃ itisaptamaṃyaṃtraṃ mahatyāṃsahitāyāṃyaṭuktaṃpratanyate agastyaḥvakṣyāmirāmabhadrasyayaṃtraṃkavacasaṃjñi taṃ dhāraṇāttasyamarttyānāṃjāyaṃtesarvasiddhayaḥnaśyaṃtisarvapāpānivipadoyāṃtisaṃkṣayaṃ bhūtapretapiśācādyaḥpalā yaṃtecadarśanāt maṃtrāṇisthiratāṃyāṃtiśatravoyāṃtimitratāṃ grahāḥprasādasāṃyāṃtidāsyaṃyāṃtimahībhṛtaḥki matravahunoktenanāstyanenasudurlabhaṃ yaṃtreṇarāmabhadrasyavajrapaṃjarasaṃjñino koṣṭaiḥsahaikaviṃśatyāpaṃktihayavibhūṣi taṃ vinyasyeduttamaṃcakrametasminkavacaṃlikhet dvādaśākṣaravarṇānigrahādyaṃteṣuvinyaset anulomavilomābhyāṃprāda kṣiṇyakrameṇaca rāghavādīnināmāninamaskāreṇayojayet meśiraḥyātvitīcasyātsarvatovākyayojanā sā dhyākhyāṃsaṃyutāṃṣaṣṭyāhyāhetyekādaśegṛhe svakāśamaśaktivāgvarṇaṃnārasiṃhamataḥparaṃ lakṣmīpāśāṃkuśaṇāṃmivā rāhaṃphaṭasvarūpakaṃ svāhotirāmabhadrasyadvādaśākṣaramīritaṃ sauvarṇerājatepatrebhūrjevāsamyagālikhet athavātāmra patrecagulakīkṛtyadhāraryet yāvajjīvaṃtusauvarṇeraupyeviṃśativārṣikaṃ bhūrjedvādaśavarṣāṇitadardhaṃtāmrapatrake evaṃlekhyaṃviśeṣeṇayaṃtraśaktiḥpratiṣṭitā etāṃrāmavalopetāmityādiślokaṣaṭkaṃyaṃtrādvahiḥpradeśetuvṛttākāraṃvṛ ttālikhet sarvaduṣṭopaśamanaṃsarvopadravanāśanaṃ āyurārogyamaiśvaryyaṃputrapautravarddhanaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnotiviṣṇu
pṛ0 54ba) lokaṃsacchati asyārthaḥ vakṣyāmītyārabhyavallapaṃjarasaṃjñitetītyevaṃspaṣṭaṃdakṣiṇokṣararekhātrayasyopariprākpaścimāgrārekhādvādaśa kerpitedvāviṃśatikoṣṭakānibhavaṃti aṃtimakoṣṭadvayamadhyagatarekhāyākaraṇenaikaviṃśatisārddhaṃpaṃktidvayavibhūṣitaṃ uttamaṃ cakrāṃvinyaset śrīrāmakavacaṃlikhet tadyathādvādaśākṣaramaṃtravarṇānāṃmadhyeekaikenarāghavāyanamaḥ meśiraḥpātuitiyo jitaṃsaṃpuṭitanaikaikapadamekaikasminkoprādakṣiṇyenalikhet evamaparipaṃktāvānulomyenadaśapadānāṃsamādeśaḥadha stanapaṃktauprātilomyenapunarviparīparītaṃnaivamaṃtravarṇanaikaikesaṃpuṭitānāṃuparitanānāṃdaśapadānāṃsamādeśaḥ ekāda śakoṣṭedvādaśapūritaṃvarṇadvarṇadvayaṃtato'mukasyarakṣāmadhyepāṃrśvayoḥ kurukurutadevavarṇadvayaṃviparitaṃlikhet evame- kaviṃśatikoṣṭakānāṃviniyogaḥ tadevadvādaśavarṇātmakaṃmaṃtraṃdarśayaṃti svetyādinā sauvarṇityādiyaṃtraśaktiḥpra tiṣṭitetyaṃbhaṃspaṣṭaṃ tatrayāvajjīvamityāditāmrapatrityetaṃsarvayaṃtrasādhāraṇaṃ etāmityādiślokaṣaṭkaṃyaṃtrādvahiḥsthālaṃvṛ ttaṃyathābhavatitathālikhet śeṣaṃsyahaṃ nasaṃtiguravoyasyanaivadīkṣāvidhikramaḥ rāmarakṣāṃvadantetattulaśīdalamarpayet dīkṣāṃtaraśatenāpinaitatphalamavāpyate ityagastyenacoktatvāt rāmarakṣāsamaṃnahi prādakṣiṇyakrameṇacaiticakārasūcitā rthagraṃthāṃtaroktaṃdraṣṭavyaṃ hasauyaṃtrasyajīvasyātmadhyaṃvījādadhaunyaset haṃsaḥsohamitiprāṇaṃīśānyāvikramāllikhet iṃdranetrenyasetpārśveuḍaṃśrotretathaivaca viśeṣoṣṭadalādautugāyatrīlekhamesmṛtaḥ yaṃtrarājāyavidmahevarapradāyadhīmahi
pṛ0 55a) tannoyaṃtraḥpracodayāt ityarṇānmaṃtragāyatryāḥpratipatraṃtriśolikhet agnevāthāvakāśenapratiṣṭāṃprāṇadāṃlikhet prayogasāre bhūmispṛsṛṃśaṃkhaspṛṣṭaṃkliṣṭaṃnirmālyasaṃgataṃ dagdhamālaṃghinaṃśīrṇaṃyaṃtraṃjātunadhārayet itisarvayaṃtrasādhāraṇakramaḥitya ṣṭamaṃyaṃtraṃ itiśrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryyaśrīmanmukuṃdavanaśrīcaraṇaśiṣyānaṃdavanaviracitāyāṃśrīrāmārcana caṃdrikāyāṃcaturthaḥpaṭalaḥ 4 caitrādimāsakṛtyaṃyadhunātatprakāśyate rāmabhaktasyasiddharthaṃyaduktaṃnāradādibhiḥ madhu śuklāṃtṛtīyāṃcajānakīramaṇaṃprabhuṃ rājopacāraiḥsaṃpūjyamāsamāṃṭolayetkalau dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃdevaṃdolamānaṃsu reśvaraḥsupūjitaṃsakadṛṣṭvāsarvapāpaiḥpramucyate dolārūḍhaprapaśyaṃtiyekṛṣṇaṃmadhumādhave aparādhasahasraistumuktāstenātrasaṃ śayaḥ dolārūḍhasyadevesyayeḥgrekurvaṃtijāgaraṃ sarvapuṇyaphalāvāptirnirmiṣenimiṣebhavet itigāruḍedolotsavaḥ caitra śuklanavamyāṃtukarttavyaṃbratamuttamaṃ agastisahitāyāṃyanmahatyāṃsamudīritaṃ śrīrāmanavamīproktākoṭisūryagrahādhikā tasmindinemahāpuṇyerāmamuddiśyabhaktitaḥ yaktiṃcitkriyatekarmatadbhavadekṣayaṃdhruvaṃ upoṣaṇaṃjāgaraṇaṃpihanuddiśyatarpa ṇaṃ tasmindinetukarttṛvyaṃbrahmaprāptimabhīpsubhiḥrāmevaparaṃbrahmataditaṃrāmatoṣaṇaṃ ityādinaṃhimā nityaṃnemittikaṃkā myaṃbrataṃcetivicāryate niṣkāmānāṃvidhānāṃtannakāmyaṃtāvadiṣyate mumukṣavaupihisadāśrīrāmanavamībrataṃ natyajaṃtisu raśreṣṭādeveṃdropiviśeṣataḥitisadāyadasyagrahaṇādetatsutiparaṃnahi naimittikaṃcanatathāsadetiśrūyateyataḥyāvarjjāvavi

pṛ0 60ba) puṣpāṃjaliṃdatvābhivaṃdayet namostupuṣpavāṇāyajagadāhlādakāriṇe manmathāyajagannetreratipriyanamostuteiti āmaṃtritosi deveśapurāṇapuruṣottama prātastvāṃpūjayiṣmāmisānnidhyaṃkurukeśava kṣīrodadhimahānāgaśayyāvasthitavigraha prātastvāṃpūjayi ṣyāmisannidhaubhavatenamaḥ nivedayāmyahaṃtubhyaṃprātardamanarkaśubhaṃ sarvathāsarvadāviṣṇonamastestuprasīvame itthamānaṃtrya deveśaṃdatvāpuṣpāṃjaliṃpunaḥ pūjitaṃtadamanakaṃkuṃbhasyoparisaṃsthitaṃ astreṇasarvatorakṣetkavacaināvaguṃṭhayet rakṣedvācakramaṃ treṇanṛharemanunāthavā brāhmaṇebhyonamaskṛtyagurupādaupraṇamyaca gītamaṃgalanirghoṣaiḥkuryyājjāgaraṇaṃtataḥ itidamanādhi vāsanaṃ prātarnatvāthadeveśaṃkuryyātsnānaṃyathāvidhi nityapūjāṃpṛthakkṛtvākuryānnaimittikītataḥ damanaṃdūrvāyayuktaṃgaṃdhākṣa tasamanvitaṃ jayamaṃgalanirghoṣairdevadevesamarpayet oṃdevadevajagannāthavāṃchitārthapradāyaka hṛdisthāṃpūrayeḥkāmāṃnmamakā meśvarīpriya idaṃdamanakaṃdevagṛhāṇamadanugrahāt imāṃsāṃvatsarīṃpūjāṃbhagavatparipūraya mūlaṃsaṃpuṭitauhyeṣadamanīropaṇe manuḥevaṃsamarpyadevāyaprārthayedviṣṇumavyayaṃ maṇividrumamālābhirmaṃdārakusumādibhiḥ iyaṃsāṃvatsarīpūjātavāstugaruḍadhvaja vanamālāṃyathādevakaustubhaṃmatataṃhṛdi tadvadvāmanikīṃmālāpūjāṃcahṛdayecaha jānanājānatāvāpinakṛtaṃyattavārcanaṃ tatsarvaṃ pūrṇatāṃyāṃtutvatprasādādramāpate jitaṃtepuṃḍarīkākṣanamasteviśvabhāvana namastestuhṛṣīkeśamahāpuruṣapūrvaja maṃtrahīnaṃkri yāhīnaṃbhaktihīnaṃjanārdana yatpūjitaṃmayādevaparipūrṇaṃtadastume evaṃsaṃprārthyadeveśaṃnipateddaṃḍavadbhuvi athasaṃpūjayedbhaktyā

pṛ0 61ba) sarvaiḥsaṃpradāyānurodhataḥ asatanūrnatadāmoaśnutesṛtāsadradvahantastasmāmāśata tayoḥpavitraṃvitataṃdivyasyadeśocaṃtoa syaṃtaṃnavosthiran itiṛgvede sahovācayajñavalkyastasmātpumānātmahitāyapramṛgāhariṃbhajenmuślokamaulervamā- ṇyagnināsaṃdadhata itiśātapathīśrutiḥ pratidviṣṇoavjacakresutaptejanmāṃbhodhītarttavecarṣaṇīṃdrāḥ mūlervāhvordadhatyepurā ṇāliṅgānyaṅgetaptāyudhānyarpayaṃtitisāmavede agnihotraṃyathānityaṃvedasyādhyayanaṃyathā brāhmaṇasyatathaivedaṃtaptaca- krādidhāraṇamitipādmaspṛtiḥ śrutismṛtiśanairuktastatprakāraḥpratanyate bahucapariśiṣṭeṣvaproktoyaḥśaunakādi bhiḥ ṣoḍaśopacārairbhagavaṃtamabhyarcyṛkṣareparamennyoman śannomitraḥśaṃvaruṇityetābhyāṃcakraṃśaṃkhaṃcābhyarcyadvā daśāraṃnahinajjarāyāgnermarutveprathamasyapracetasityetābhyāmagnāvādadhyāt vaiśvānarasyasumatausyāmetyatyagniṃ paricaret puruṣasūktenaṣoḍaśāhutīrhutvābhagavaṃtaṃpuruṣasūktenopastutyayobrahmāṇāmitipuratodaṃḍavannipatet athasudarśanamahājvālasūryyakoṭisamaprabha ajñānāṃdhasyamenityaṃviṣṇomārgaṃpradarśaya itiādāya oṃsudarśanā yaviṣṇahemahājvālāyadhīmahi tannaścakraṃpracodayāt iticakrādhānaṃ paṃcajanyaṃnijadhvāṃtastapātakasaṃcayaṃ pāhimāṃ pāpināṃghoraṃsaṃsārārṇāvapāninaṃityādāya paṃcajanyāyavidmahehayavāmanāyadhīmahi tannośaṃkhaḥpracodayātiti śaṃkhadhānamiti yevaṃkurutevidvānbrahmaṇaḥśrotriyaḥśuciḥ sarvapāpaiḥpramucyetaviṣṇulokaṃcagacchati śayanyāṃcaiva
pṛ0 62a) vodhanyāṃcakratīrthetathaivaca śaṃkhacakravidhānenavahnipūtobhavennaraḥ itimudrādhāraṇavidhiḥ nīrājyanarayānethāraupyarāmaṃsavaiṣṇavaiḥ gītavāditraghoṣeṇedevīṃnītvājalāśayaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃpradāyāthapānāduttārayetprabhuṃ tīreṃghrinyāsamāśāsyahastaṃdatvopaveśa yet dhautāṃghripāṇirācāṃtaḥkuryātsaṃkalpamāvṛtaḥnyāsaṃkṛtvāthadevecasvarṇagharmānuvākataḥtathāpuruṣasūktenottaranārā yaṇenaca paṃcāmṛtenasaṃsnāpyapūjābhyarthāraghūttamaṃatodaivaitimaṃtreṇajaleprasvāpayetprabhuṃ śeṣeparyaṃkavaryyesminphalāma ṇigaṇāmale śvetadvīpāṃtaredevakurunidrāṃnamostviti athakṛtvāmahāṃpūjāṃgaṃdhasragdhūpadīpakaiḥ annatāṃvūlanatpāpairā śāsyānugrahaṃhareḥ svaptetvayijagannāthajagatsuptaṃbhavedidaṃ vivuddhecavivuddhetaprasannomebhavāvyayaḥ itisaṃprārthyatasyāgregṛhṇī yānniyamānimān śvetadveyebhoginātheyogināthesthitetvāyi cāturmāsyabratenujāṃdehilakṣmīpatemama 1 lavdhānujñāṃ śaṃkhahastoyathāproṣitabhartṛkācaturovārṣikānmāsāśrāghavosthāpanāvadhi imaṃkariṣyenirvighnaṃkurumecyuta idaṃbrataṃmayā devagṛhītaṃpuratastavanirvighnaṃsiddhimāyātuprasādātteramāpate gṛhetesminbratedevahīnapuṃraruttavanirvighnaṃsiddhi paṃcatvaṃyadime bhavet tadābhavatusaṃpūrṇaṃprasādātteraghūdvaha ityabhyarthyāthadevāyaśaṃkhenārghaṃnivedayet śrāvaṇevarjayechākaṃdadhibhādrapadeta thā dugdhāmāśvayujemāsikārttikecāmiṣaṃtyajet prāṇyaṃgacūrṇaṃcarmāṃvujaṃvīraṃvīcapūrakaṃ ayajñaśiṣṭamannādyaṃyadviṣṇora niveditaṃ dagdhamannaṃmasūraṃcamāṣaṃcetyaṣṭadhāmiṣaṃ rucyaṃtaddeśalabhyaṃphalamūlādivarjayet niṣpavīnnājasāṣāṃścamasūraṃ
pṛ0 62ba) saṃdhitānica vṛṃtāṃkaṃcakaliṃgaṃcasuptedevenabhakṣayeditismṛteḥ caturthyapīhamāseṣuhaviṣyāśītapāyabhāk haimāṃtikaṃsi tāsvinnaṃdhānyaṃmudgāyavāstilāḥ kalāyakaṃgunīcāstūkaṃhimalocikā ṣaṣṭikākālaśākaṃcamūlakaṃkemuketarat kaṃdhaṃsaiṃdhavasāṣudregavyecadadhisarpiṣī payomuddhṛtasāraṃcapanasāmraharītakī pippalījīrakaṃcaivanāgaraṃgaṃcatittiḍī kadalīlavalīdhātrīphalānyaguḍamaikṣavaṃ atailapakvaṃmunayohaviṣyāṇiprakṣate anyānvapipurāṇeṣudraṣṭavyānivratānitu tatastutvāprajāpālerājanyāśāsyamaṃgalaṃ śaṃkhatīrthaṃcasaṃprāpyagītanṛtyādināhariṃ paritoṣyāthasaṃpūjyavaiṣṇavānarayā nakaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃsamāropyagītavāditraghoṣataḥ āgatyamaṃdirekṛtvāmahānīrājanaṃprabhoḥ visṛjyavaiṣṇavāndevamupaveśya sukhaṃsvapet ityāṣāḍheśayanotsavaḥ śrāvaṇasyaśitepakṣedvādaśyāṃśaunakādibhiḥuktaḥsadāprakarttavyaḥpavitrāropaṇotsavaḥ tathācavahvṛcapariśiṣṭe sasnātaḥsarvatīrtheṣusarvayajñeṣudīkṣitaḥ hariścaprītimāpnotiyaḥpavitraṃsamācaret vidhināśā strādṛṣṭenayonakuryātpavitrakaṃ haraṃtirākṣasāstasyavarṣapūjādikaṃphalamiti pādme ūrjebrataṃmadhaudolāśrāvaṇetaṃtupū janaṃcaitrecadamanāropamakurvāṇobrajanyadhiti pavitrāropaṇaṃvighnāchrāvaṇenabhavedyadi kārttikyavadhiśukrāstekarttavyami tināradaḥ itipavitranityatā prayogasārādutpattiḥpavitrasyapratanyate kanīyānvāsukenāṃmnāpavitronāmanāgarāṭ nirāhārabratobhūtvāvaidikaṃśaradaṃśataṃ tapastepesamāśrityadevadevaṃmaheśvaraṃ prasannatapasātasyapurastātpuruṣottamaḥ
pṛ0 63a) praṇatārtiharaḥśaṃbhurāvirāśīvumāpatiḥprasādābhimukhaṃdṛṣṭvādevaṃsabhujageśvaraḥkaṃṭhābharaṇanāṃprāptuṃvavrevaramanuttamaṃ tathetyābhāṣyataṃ tadvaddhārayaṃstripurāṃtakaḥprādāttasmaivaraṃcānyatpavitrāyātmayogine yetvāvahunamanyaṃteyathāsaṃbhāvitomayā japahomādikaṃte ṣāṃphalaṃtvāmetuniścayān atraivaśrāvaṇemāsinakṣatrevāpivaiṣṇave tasmādārādhayaṃtutvāṃnityanaimittikodyatāḥ vaidikāḥ śaktahomenapūjāṃkurvaṃtutenagha tvatsādṛśyānukāreṇanivītenaivatāṃtrikāḥ ārādhyāropyapūjyāyaidevatāyaipavitrakamiti itipavitrotpattiḥnānāgamoktamārgeṇatasyakarttavyatocyate haimyaraupyatāmra kṣaubhaiḥsūtraiḥkauśeyapadmajaiḥkuśaiścakāryyā karpāsaiḥbrāhmaṇyākartitaiḥśubhaiḥkanyayāpavitraṃsyātnapuṃścatyādibhiḥkṛtaiḥsnātvātriguṇitaṃsūtraṃtriguṇīkṛtyaśodhaye t hṛnmaṃtreṇapaṃcagavyairaḍbhiḥprakṣāntayaittataḥmūlenāṣṭottaraśataṃgāyatryārāmasaṃjñayā śaṃkhodakenābhimaṃtryāpavitrāṇivi nirmamet dugdhadadhyājyaviṇmūtraiḥpaṃcagavyakramaṃviduḥāpyāyasvadadhikrānṇastejosiśukramasyathā gāyatryāṃtogaṃdhadvārāṃmaṃ trāḥsyuḥpaṃcagavyake madhuvātetigāyatrīkramaḥpaṃcāmṛtetathā itisūtraśuddhiḥ tatrottamaṃpavitraṃtuṣaṣṭyāsahaśataustribhiḥsa ptanyāsahitaṃdvābhyāṃśatābhyāṃmadhyamaṃsmṛtaṃ sāśītināśatenaivakaniṣṭaṃtatsamācaret aṣṭottaraṃtadarddhārddhaṃnavasūtrīkrameṇa vā jānūrunābhiparyaṃtamuttamāvitrayaṃbhavet aṣṭottarasahasreṇavanamālāṃsamācaret uttamasyapavitrasyadvaiguṇyenāpibhāvaye t ārabhyamukuraṃyāvatsūtreviracitāśubhā āpādalaṃvinīmālāvanamālāprakīrttitā yajamānapavitraṃvādhivāsanapa

pṛ0 64a) krodhādayopyetenamesyurbrahmaghātakāḥ adyaprabhṛtideveśayāvadvaiśeṣikaṃdinaṃ tāvadrakṣātvayākāryāsarvasyāsyanamostute evaṃvi- jñāpyadeveśaṃgurupādaupraṇamyaca kurvītavaiṣṇavaiḥsārddhaṃpavitrāropaṇaṃhariḥ kuṃbhaṃpuṇyāṃvunāpūryyasarvatobhadrakeśubhaṃ sthāpa yenpuratoviṣṇostatrasūtrāṇipūjayet oṃsāṃvatsarasyayāgasyapavitrīkaraṇāyabhoḥ viṣṇulokātpavitrādyāgacchehana- mostute anenavāhayetsūtraṃmūlamaṃtrayatenaca uttamāditrayevidvānsmareddevatrayaṃtathā guṇānvedatrayaṃcaivadhyāyellokaprayaṃ tathā prakṛtiṃvanapūrvāyāṃmālāyāṃnikhilātmikāṃ dyulokaṃmaukuṭesūtredhyāyetadgāvaśālini oṃsarvābharaṇacitrāṃgasarva devatānamaskṛta lāvaṇyarūpaviśvātmanjyeṣṭasūtraṃsamāśrayaṃ oṃsarvalakṣmīkaraśrīśasarvajñānasamātmak sarvādhāradha rārūpasarvakarttāprajāpate sarvagātmeśasūtresminsānnidhyaṃkurutenamaḥ sarvaratnojvalākārabrahmāṃḍabrahmarociṣā mukuṭotta masarvāṃgaśiraḥsūtrihaihibho prakṛtejagataḥkatriṃsarvālāvaṇyadāyini śrīmūtresarvakalyāṇisānidhyaṃkurutenamaḥ uttamādīnisūtrāṇikramādālabhyapāṇinā munibhirmaṃtrayedetaiḥpūjayenmūlamaṃtrataḥ brahmāviṣṇurmahādevātrisūtrīdevatā smṛtāḥ oṃkāramāmavahnīcabrahmānāgāśaśīraviḥ śivaścaviśvedevāścanavasūtryadhidevatāḥ kriyācapauruṣīvīrāvija yeśāparājitā manonmayījayābhadrāmuktiścidgraṃthidevatāḥ dhyātvāvāhyāmṛtīkṛtyagaṃdhapuṣpākṣatāṃkuraiḥdhūpadīpānnatāṃ būlaiḥpavitraṃvivudhāṃyajet athadevakarevidvānpadṛsūtrasamudbhavaṃ vitāstimānakaṃhoraṃvadhnīyātmaṃgalātmakaṃ oṃsaṃvatsara
pṛ0 64ba) kṛtāṃvāṃyāḥsaṃpūrṇaṃphaladopiyat pavitrāropaṇāyaitatkurukaṃdharutenamaḥmūlasaṃpuṭitādasmādhṛtdhopavitrakaṃ nīrājayettatodevaṃ maṃgalāghoṣapūrvakaṃ naivedyaṃvividhaṃdadyāttāṃvūlaṃmanulepanaṃ upattiṣṭettatodevaṃjitamityādibhistavaiḥ maṃtreṇāthasureśānaṃde vadevaṃnimaṃtrayet āmaṃtritosmideveśapurāṇapuruṣottama prātastvāṃpūjayiṣyāmisānidhyaṃkurukeśava oṃkṣīrodadhimahā nāgaśayyāvāsthitavigraha prātastvāṃpūjayiṣyāmisannidhaubhavatenamaḥ nivedayāmyahaṃtubhyaṃprātaretatpavitrakaṃ sarvathāsarva dāviṣṇonamastestuprasīdame nipatedaṃḍavadbhamaukṣiptāpuṣpāṃjaliṃpunaḥ pūjitāṇyathasūtrāṇikuṃbhaṃtaṃcapuraḥsthitaṃ astreṇasa rvatorakṣetkavacenāvaguṃṭhayet rakṣedvācakramaṃtreṇanṛharermanunāthavā brāhmaṇebhyonamaskṛtyagurupādaupraṇamyaca gītamaṃgala nirghoṣaiḥkuryyā'jāgaraṇaṃtataḥ adhivāsavidhiḥproktaḥkathitonāradāvidhiḥ itipavitrāvāsanaṃ tataḥprātaḥsamutthāyadhyā todevaṃyathoditaṃnityaṃpūjāṃtataḥkṛtvāpavitrāṇāṃtathaivaca nīrājayecchubhaiḥdīpairmaṃgalāghoṣapūrvakaṃ stutvācavividhaistotrai- rnatvādevaṃsurārcitaṃ tatomaṃgalanirghoṣaiḥśaṃkhaturyādiniḥsvanaiḥ gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatāyuktaṃdadyādevāyasūtrakaṃ oṃrāmarāmanamastubhyaṃ gṛhāṇedaṃpavitrakaṃpavitrīkaraṇārthāyavarṣapūjāphalapradaṃ pavitrakaṃkuruṣvādyayanmayāduṣkṛtaṃkṛtaṃ śuddhobhavāmyahaṃdevatva tprasādātsureśvara mūlasaṃpuṭitohyeṣapavitrāropaṇemanuḥ aṃpādyāṃvṛttidevebhyastatodadyātsvanāmabhiḥ naivedyaṃtumahāpū rvaṃtatodadyāccabhaktitaḥ nīrājayettatodevaṃrāmakāṃtaṃsamaṃgalaṃ saṃvījyacāmaraiḥpuṇyairdarpaṇaṃdarśayettataḥ vividhānica
pṛ0 65a) puṣpāṇidadyātpuṣpāṃjaliṃtathā prārthayeddevadeveśaṃmaṃtrairebhiryathāvidhi maṇividrusamālābhirmaṃdārakusumādibhiḥ iyaṃsāṃva tsarīpūjātavāstugaruḍadhvaja vanamālāṃyathādevakusuṃbhaṃsatataṃhṛdi tadvatpacitrataṃtūṃścapūjāṃcahṛdayevaha jānatājānatāvā- pinakṛtaṃyattavārcanaṃ kenacidvighnadoṣeṇaparipūrṇaṃtadastume maṃtrahīnaṃkriyāhīnaṃbhaktihīnaṃjanārdana yatpūjitaṃmayā devaparipūrṇaṃtadastume aparādhasahasrāṇikriyaṃteharnniśaṃmayā dāsoyaṃitimāṃmatvākṣamasvamadhusūdana niyatpadaṃ dravadbhūmaubhaktiyuktenacetasā praṇamedevadeveśaṃrāmamiṣṭārthadaṃvudhaḥ tataḥpavitraṃguravedadyādgaṃdhādipūrvakaṃ athainaṃpūja yedbhaktyāsvarṇavastrāṃtulepanaiḥ vrāhmaṇānvaiṣṇavāṃścaivagaṃdhapuṣpādinārcayet bhaktyāpratoṣayettāṃścavastrabhojanakāṃca naiḥ māsaṃpakṣamahorātraṃtrirātraṃdhārayettathā devetaṃsūtrasaṃdarbhaṃdeśakālavivakṣayā pratyahaṃsnānakāryyādisūtrāṇyuttā ryyakārayet abhiṣicyārghyatoyenapunardeveniviṃśayet athāṃtedevamabhyarcyaviśeṣyātpuṣpacaṃdanaiḥ naivedyaṃvividhaṃ datvātataḥsūtraṃvisarjayet oṃsāṃvatsarīṃśubhāṃpūjāṃsaṃpādyavidhivanmayā brajedānīṃpavitratvaṃviṣṇulokaṃvisarjitaṃ yāvaddevepavitrāṇitāvattiṣṭetsamāhitaḥ brahmacārīhaviṣyāśīdevapūjāparāyaṇaḥ pavitrāropaṇaṃkālenakaro- tikadācana tadāyutaṃjapenmaṃtraṃstotraṃvāpisamācaret itipavitrāropaṇaṃ itiśrāvaṇakṛtyaṃ athabhādrapadeśukladvā daśyāṃkarṇikotsavaḥ karttavyovaiṣṇavaiḥsārddhaṃśayanyutsavavaddhareḥ tathāvabhaviṣyottare prāptebhādrapademāsiekādaśyāṃsi
pṛ0 65ba) tehani kaṭadānaṃbhavedviṣṇomahāpātakanāśanamiti śayanyutsavarītpātudevaṃnītvājanāśayaṃ kaṭadānotsavaṃku rveitisaṃkalpapūjayet devadevaṃjagannāthayogigamyaniraṃjana kaṭadānaṃkuruṣvādyaprāptebhādrapadeśubhe anekaka rṇikāvṛttiṃdakṣiṇāṃgeprakalpayet mahāpūjāṃtataḥkṛtvāpūrvavatsvagṛhaṃvrajet itikaṭadānotsavaḥ itibhādrapadaṃ kṛtyaṃ āśvinasyasitepakṣedaśamyāṃvijayotsavaḥkarttavyaḥsujanaiḥsārddhaṃsarvatravijayārthibhiḥhanūmadvākyamāka- rṇyahṛṣṭātijanakātmajā ānaṃdapūrṇaiḥkapibhirvijñāpitamupasthitaṃ rathamāropyadeveśaṃsarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaṃ sāsi tṛṇadhanurvāṇapāṇiṃtaktāṃcarāṃtakaṃ svalīlayājagattrātumāvirbhūtamajaṃvibhuṃ rathairaśvaiḥgajaiḥpadbhisaumitrī- sugrīvādibhiḥ yutaṃgajopacāraistaṃśamīṃpratisamāpayet śamīviṣṇurcanaṃkurvitisaṃkalpapūjayet viṣṇudharmo ktamārgeṇayātrānirvighnasiddhaye śamīyuktaṃsitārāmaṃbhaktānāmabhayaṃkaraṃ arcayitvāśamīvṛkṣasarcayeccatataḥpumā n śamīśamayatīpāyaṃśamīlohitakaṭhaṃkī dharitryarjunavāṇānāṃrāmasyapriyavādinī kariṣyamāṇāvāyā trāyathākālaṃsukhaṃmayā tatranirvighnakartrītvaṃbhavaśrīrāmapūjinai gṛhītvāsākṣatārdraṃcaśamīmūlagatāṃmṛdaṃ gī tavāditranirghoṣaistatodevaṃgṛhaṃnayet kaiścidṛkṣaistatrabhāvyaṃkaiścidbhāvyaṃtuvānaraiḥ kaiścidraktamukhairbhāvyaṃkośaleṃ drasyatuṣṭaye nirjiṃtārākṣasāddaityāvairiṇojagatītale rāmarājyaṃrāmarājyaṃrāmarājyamitivruvan ānīyasthā

pṛ0 66ba) npravṛddhaḥpremasmitenanayanāṃvuruhaṃvijṛṃbhan utthāyaviśvavijayāyacanāviṣādaṃmadhyāgnirāpanayatātpuruṣaḥpurāṇaḥ i tipuṣpāṃjaliṃdatvāsaktamātharvaṇaṃjapet snāpayedrāghavaṃpaṃcāmṛtaiḥpuruṣasūktenanīrājyamaṃtravinyasyavastrālaṃkāra caṃdanaiḥ sragdhūpadīpadivyāntatāṃvūlaistāṣayedvibhuṃ evaṃkṛtvāmahāpūjāṃgṛhītvāsākṣataṃjalaṃ pratimāsabratānkṛtvārā ghavāyanivedayet adhiṣṭataimayānānācāturmāsyabrajaiḥprabhuḥprabhūtayātakasyāṃterāghavaḥprīyatāṃmama evaṃbratānparya yitvāstuvītaparamādrutaḥ śrutistutyāvedavaṃdivodhamānaṃramāpatiṃ jayabrayetyādivedastutiḥ svastyastuviśvasyakhalaḥ prasīdatāṃdhyāyaṃtubhūtāniśivaṃmithodhiyā manaścabhadraṃbhajatāmadhokṣajeāveśyatāṃnaumitirayyahaitukī ityāśivaḥsa mabhyarthyagītavādyajayaḥsvanaiḥ pūjāṃcākhilapāpebhyomuktvāyāṃtihareḥpradaṃyuktaṃsainyādivāhairmarakataraṇātkiṃkiṇī jālamālā ratnādyairmoṃktikānāmaviratamaṇibhiḥsaṃbhṛtaiścaivahāraiḥhaimaiḥkuṃbhaiḥpātakāśivatārucibhiḥbhūṣitaiḥke tumukhyaiḥchatrairbrahmaśavaṃdyoduritaharaharaiḥpātujaitrorathovaḥpalāyadhvapalāyadhvaṃrereditijadānavāḥ saṃrakṣaṇāyalokānāṃ rathārūḍhaunṛkeśaśī ityādiviṣṇudharmoktamaṃtraiḥ saṃtoṣyasādaraṃ prasādamālāṃnṛharergṛhīyādbhaktibhāvitaḥ jayadeva mahādevajayarāmākhileśvarāt varadeśākhilaṃrakṣarakṣajagatpate jayasītāpatedevajayadaityaniṣūdana devadevākhi lādhārapāhinaḥśaraṇāgatān nṛtyairvādyairbhagavatighaṃṭāvādajayasvanaiḥ bhrāmayetspaṃdanaṃviṣṇoḥpuramadhyaṃsamaṃtataḥ
pṛ0 67a) rathasyākarṣaṇaṃpūrvaṃpuratodaityanāyakāḥsurāścasiddhasaṃghāścamunigaṃdharvamānavāḥyāvatpadānikṛṣṇasyarathasyākarṣaṇaṃnaraḥ karotikratubhistānitulyāninaranāyakaḥ rathenamahagachaṃtipurataḥpṛṣṭatogrataḥmahāviṣṇusamāhyetebhavatyāṃghribhavā pi śrīkṛṣṇarathaśobhāṃyeprakurvaṃtivadaṃtica jayeticapunaryevaiteṣāṃlokāḥsanātanāḥ rathasthitonaraiṃrviprapūjitoma dhusūdanaḥ dadātivāṃchitaṃteṣāmaṃtecaparamāṃgatiṃ dolāyamānagovidaṃrathasthaṃmadhusūdanaṃ nṛṇābhaktyāsakṛdṛṣṭvā punarjanmanavidyate rathenabhramamāṇaṃyenagachaṃtijanārdanaṃ viprāvedavidastepivijñeyāḥśvapacādhamāḥ yeṣāṃgṛhāgato yātirathasthaḥśrīnṛkesarī pūjātaistaiḥprakarttavyāvittaśāṭhyavivarjitaiḥ anarcitīyadāyātipramādātsvagṛhādvahiḥ pitarastasyavimukhāyāvatsaṃvatsaraṃnṛpa striyopimuktimāyāṃtirathayātrāparāyaṇāḥ nīrājanenagītenajāyaṃtemaṃḍale śvarāḥ rathotsavasyamāhatmyaṃkalauvittanutehiyaḥsaśailavanadeśāḍhyatenadattāvasuṃdharā itipadmapurāṇokterbhrāmayitvā rathaṃgṛhaṃ gatvānīrājyadeveśaṃśayītarāghavaṃsmaran itirathemahotsavaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃtusaṃdhyāyāṃkarttavyastraipurotsavaḥ dṛṣṭvāpradīyaṃnoviprajanmitaḥ śvapacāpi itiskāṃdetraipurotsavaḥitikārttikakṛtyaṃ mārgaśīrṣekabhuktaṃkṛtvāyobhya rcayeddhariṃ bhojayitvādvijānmuktaḥsyādityāhakalipriyaḥ naktabratenayomāsaṃmārgaśīrṣaṃharipriyaṃ nayedasaunaroyā tiviṣṇulokaṃsanātanaṃ itiviṣṇudharmemārgaśīrṣakṛtyaṃ pauṣasyaikādaśīṃśuktāṃmārabhyasthaṃḍileśayaḥmāsamātraṃraghu
pṛ0 67ba) prītyaidvivāraṃsnānamācaret trikālamarcayedrāmaṃtyaktabhogojiteṃdriyaḥmāghasyadvādaśīśuklāyāvatpṛthuphalapradā māsama rddhaṃtavarddhaṃvādaśāhaṃvātadarddhakaṃ kṛtvāyātihareḥsthānaṃpūjāṃcadamanotsavaṃ viṣṇurniveditānnenayaṣṭavyaṃdevatāṃtaraṃ pitṛ bhyaścaivataddeyaṃtadānaṃtyāyakalpyate pitṛśeṣaṃtuyodadyāddhārayeparamātmane retodāḥpitarastasyaṃbhavaṃtikleśabhā- ginaḥ gītairvādyaiścanṛtyaiścadadhibhaktaṃsamarpayet arcayitvāharobhaktyāprasādādanayettataḥyaḥprasādaṃharerbhaktyāgṛ hṇātipradadātica bhunaktivaiṣṇavaiḥsārddhaṃmonaṃtuphalamaśnute itiviṣṇudharmemāghapuṣyayodadhyodanotsavaḥ tapasyepau rṇamāsyāṃtukuryādvaiholikotsavaṃḥvasaṃtotsavaṃprakurvītaparamānaṃdarūpiṇe prabhātevimalejātepratipadbhāskaroda ye kṛtvācāvaśyakaṃkarmasaṃtarpyapitṛdevatāḥ vaṃdayeddholibhūtiṃcasarvaduṣṭopaśāṃtayet vaṃditāsisureṃdreṇabrahmaṇā śaṃkareṇaca atastvāṃpāhibhūtebhyobhūtebhūtipradābhava prātarvasaṃtasamayeramaṇaṃramāyā abhyarcacaṃdanaramālamṛdupravā laiḥ prārthyānicūtakusumāninivedyadevaṃsaṃtoṣadvividhagītavinodanṛtyaiḥ maṃḍitecaciṃteśuddheupaliptegṛhājire catuṣkaṃ kārayekubhraṃvarṇakaiścākṣataiḥśubhaiḥtanmadhyesthāpayetpīṭhaṃśuklavastrotarachadaṃ agrataḥpūrṇakalaśaṃsthāpayetpallavairyutaṃ āsanecopaviṣṭasyabrahmaghoṣeṇabhārata abhiṣekaprakarttavyaḥsadūrvaiścūtapallavaiḥ kusumaṃcūtavṛkṣasyavasaṃtanavapallavaiḥsaṃ śayāmisukhadamāyurārogyavarddhanaṃ yepivaṃtivasaṃtādaucūtapuṣpaṃsacaṃdanaṃ samyakhṛdisthakāmasyapūjāṃtekurvatejanāḥ anaṃtaraṃdvijeṃdrāṇāṃsūtamāgadhavaṃdināṃ dadyādvānaṃyathāśaktyākāmātmāprīyatomiti tatobhojanavelāyāṃśrutaṃprā
pṛ0 68a) gevatahine prāśayetprathamaṃcānnaṃtatobhuṃjītakāmataḥsāyaṃcatuṣkagaśvetachadapīṭhagatāṃchiśūn nūtnakuṃbhāṃbhasācyūtapalla- vairabhiṣecayet evaṃyaḥkurutepārthaśāstroktaṃphālgunotsavaṃ matprasādāccasidhyaṃtitasyasarvemanorathāḥ vṛttetuṣārasamaye sitapaṃcadaśyāṃprātavaṃsaṃtasamayesamupasthiteca saṃprāśyacūtakusumaṃsahacaṃdanenasatyaṃhipārthapuruṣovdaśataṃsukhīsyāt itibhaviṣyottareśrībhagavaduktovasaṃtotsavaḥ itiphālgunavṛtyaṃ adhimāsetusaṃprāptesmṛtvāsītāpatiṃhariṃ suvarṇaṃ cājyasaṃyuktaṃtrayastriṃśavapūpakaṃ dadyāccavedavidveṣeśrotriyāyakuṭuṃvinaṃ naśyaṃtyakaraṇeśīghraṃpuṇyaṃdvādaśamāsajaṃ itibhaviṣyottareadhikamāsakṛtyaṃ dvādaśasvapimāseṣupakṣayorubhayorapi vidyutsavaḥprakarttavyekādaśyāṃcajāgaraḥ daśamyāṃprātarutthāyakṛtamaitrādikobrabīt devārcanakriyāṃkṛtvākuryyātsaṃkalpamādṛtaḥdaśamīdinamārabhyakariṣye haṃbrataṃtava tridinaṃdevadevadeveśanirvighnaṃkurukeśava ityuccāryarpayetpuṣpāṃjaliṃśrīrāmapādayoḥ śaṃkhodakenasaṃkalpyapraṇame ddaṃḍavadvibhuṃ itidaśamīsaṃkalpaḥ ekādaśyāṃtuparṇāyairnirvarttyadaṃtadhāvanaṃ snātvādevārcanaṃkṛtvābratasaṃkalpamācaret ekā daśyāṃnirāhārasthitvāhamaparehani bhokṣyāmipuṃḍarīkākṣaśaraṇaṃmebhavācyuta iticāṃjalipātreṇārpayeddevalavākyataḥ gṛhītvoduṃvaraṃpātraṃvāripūrṇamudaṅmukhaḥ upavāsaṃgṛhītvāthamaṃtrapūtaṃjalaṃpivet ityekādaśisaṃkalpaḥ kṛtvātvāvaśyakaṃ sarvaṃdvādaśyābratamarpayet ajñānaṃtimirāṃdhasyabratenātenakeśava prasīdasumukhonāthajñānadṛṣṭipradobhava itidvādaśī saṃkalpaḥ bhaviṣyoktaprakāreṇakuryādvitridinaṃbrataṃ prasiddhatvāttadasmābhiḥkartṛtvaṃnaprapaṃcitaṃ kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīmukhyādharma
pṛ0 68ba) tonāgamoditā tattachāstrāttuvijñeyāvaiṣṇavīvaiṣṇavairnaraiḥ prasiddhatvānnacocyaṃtegraṃthavistarabhītitaḥ prasiddhasyaṃtusaṃkocerepra siddhasyavistaraḥ caitrādiṣūditosvābhiḥkartṛtvasyeśatuṣṭaye vrahmānaṃdenimagnasyatālaṃmesyātsthiraṃmanaḥ tvatpādapadmagaṃ dhenayathāsyājjānakīpate nakāmatāponatatostimeyataḥ prakāśitātecaṃnacaṃdrikeyaṃ tuṣṭobhavatvaṃsukṛtenayasmātta smāttvadanyaṃnahirāmacaṃdra rāmosmītpatiyatnadhīranirataṃrāmaṃbhajettadṛdheyadrāmeṇaniyuktametadakhilaṃrāmāyataccārpaye rāmādetadabhinnamevacaritaṃkovettirāmasyatadrāmaṃsarvamidaṃvilīyatitomerāmasāmyaṃtanu kārkvaśyaṃdaśakaṃdharorakya yatesanmārdavaṃmaithilīdātṛtvaṃcavibhīṣaṇovahuvidhaṃsnehaṃpunaḥsāṃprataṃ saṃsāradārbanalatāpaśāṃtyaiśrīrāmacaṃdrārcana caṃdrikeyaṃ syātsaṃhitāmārṣamupāśrayadbhirbhavādibhinnirṇitamauṣadhaṃyyā paṭalaiḥpaṃcabhiḥproktaṃśrīrāmārcanacaṃdrikāṃ ā naṃdavananāmnāhikavināharituṣṭaye || itiśrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryyaśrīmanmukuṃdavanaśrīcaraṇaśiṣyānaṃdava naviracitāyāṃśrīrāmārcanacaṃdrikāyāṃpaṃcamaḥpaṭalaḥ saṃpūrṇaḥ samāptāceyaṃrāmārcanacaṃdrikā || saṃvat 1929 ||
